A flight conducted in accordance with the visual flight rules.
A flight that takes place in accordance with an airlines published regular timetable, as opposed to a charter flight or special flight.
Charter or Special flights not published in a regular timetable.
A flight operated by an individual or corporation, rather than a State or a public body.
A flight conducted by Armed Forces of a nation or State.
A flight not conducted by the military.

definicion: A designator permitting the identification of any Air Traffic Service (ATS) route.
descripcion: The route designator shall be specified in accordance with ICAO Annex 11.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that contains only non-lexical characters and is unconstrained in length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Essential Significant Point
definicion: An indication that at a point along an enroute Air Traffic Service (ATS) route either a change in course is required or the route intersects another enroute ATS route.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Location Designator
definicion: A structured textual description of the country of origin and destination of the Air Traffic Service (ATS) route.

datatype.nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Location Designator Structured Text
datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying an air traffic service route location designator.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: The 2 letter pair ICAO nationality designation of the country of origin as specified in ICAO Doc7910, followed by a dash, then the 2 letter pair ICAO nationality designation of the country of destination as specified in ICAO doc.7910.

nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Segment Availability
definicion: The condition in which a Air Traffic Service (ATS) route segment may be flown.
descripcion: Factors include conditions such as traffic flow and time constraints. For example: CDR1 or SPECIAL.

datatype.nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Segment Availability Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an air traffic service route segment availability.

dominio.definicion: The route segment is always available for use.
The airway is used on a seasonal basis.
The airway is used as an alternate airway for backup purposes.
A special condition exists and should be explained in a free text annotation.
dominio.observaciones: This value is needed as long as 'special' types of routes exist. For example: routes which are closed during some time periods, but still may be used for landings on a specified aerodrome; flights that may be performed below the minimum level of the route in special circumstances.

dominio.definicion: Route segment is not available for use.
Permanently plannable Conditional Route (CDR) during the times published in AIPs.
dominio.observaciones: Available most of the times, not available on specific conditions (for example: activation of a military training zone).

dominio.definicion: Non-permanently plannable Conditional Route (CDR).
dominio.observaciones: Available on specific conditions such as facilitating traffic flow and increasing ATC capacity.

dominio.definicion: Not plannable Conditional Route (CDR).
dominio.observaciones: Available on short notice, useable only on ATC instructions.

dominio.definicion: The route segment should be flown only according to its own timetable.

nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Segment Length
definicion: The distance between the two ends of the Air Traffic Service (ATS) route segment, as published by the appropriate authority.
descripcion: Measured in Nautical Miles or Kilometres.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 1,852.0 metres.

nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Segment Path Basis
definicion: The geodetic basis for the path between the two ends of the Air Traffic Service (ATS) route segment, as published by the appropriate authority.
descripcion: For example: great circle, rhumbline, or geodesic line.

datatype.nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Segment Path Basis Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an air traffic service route segment path basis.

dominio.definicion: The shortest path between any two points on a mathematically defined ellipsoidal surface.
The shortest path between any two points on the surface of a sphere.
A rhumbline is a line following a constant angle of the compass (that is, a line of constant direction).
A three point arc.
An arc designed in a counter-clockwise direction.
An arc designed in a clockwise direction.
The path that follows the border of a state.

nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Segment Usage Direction
definicion: The direction of the usage condition of the Air Traffic Service (ATS) route segment in relation to the start point and end point.
descripcion: For example: forward, backward or both.

datatype.nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Segment Usage Direction Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an air traffic service route segment usage direction.

dominio.definicion: The direction from the end point to the start point.
The direction from the start point to the end point.
Route segment usage can be both forward and backward.

nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Segment Width
definicion: The declared dimension of an Air Traffic Service (ATS) route segment taken perpendicular to its path, as published by the appropriate authority.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 1,852.0 metres.

definicion: A classification of the Air Traffic Service (ATS) route segment describing the characteristics and requirements for its usage.
descripcion: For example: Conventional or Area Navigation (RNAV) Routes.

datatype.nombre: Air Traffic Service (ATS) Route Type Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an air traffic service route type.

dominio.definicion: An ATS route defined by conventional radio navigational aids (non area navigation).
dominio.observaciones: Examples of conventional radio navigation aids include: VOR, NDB, and TACAN.

dominio.definicion: An ATS route established for the use of aircraft capable of employing area navigation.
dominio.observaciones: Area Navigation is a method of navigation which permits aircraft operation on any desired flight path within the coverage of station-referenced navigation aids or within the limits of the capability of self-contained aids, or a combination of these.

dominio.definicion: An ATS designated route along which air traffic advisory service is available.
A charted track allowing direct flight between two navigational aids, fixes, point or any combination thereof.

An ATS route providing the main routings through critical areas which will be accessible to aircraft regardless of point of departure but at the same time will prevent aircraft criss-crossing the main routes and/or airspace.
A route designated primarily for military purposes.
A low level route established for use primarily by helicopters.
A route that has been established for use by aircraft operating in accordance with the Visual Flight Rules (VFR).

definicion: The setting to be used by the Airborne Identification Radar beacon during aerial refuelling operations.

datatype.nombre: Airborne Identification Radar Beacon Code (APX) Structured Text
datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying an airborne identification radar beacon code.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: First digit allowable values: '2', '3', '4', '5', '6'; Second digit allowable values: '1'; OR No values entered in both positions.

definicion: The setting to be used by the Airborne Navigation Radar beacon during aerial refuelling operations.

datatype.nombre: Airborne Navigation Radar Beacon Code (APN) Structured Text
datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying an airborne navigation radar beacon code.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: First digit allowable values: '1', '2', '3'; Second digit allowable values: '0', '1', '2', '3', '4'; Third digit allowable values - '0', '1', '2', '3', '4'; OR No values entered in all three positions.

definicion: A grouping of aircraft based on a speed of 1.3 times the stall speed in the landing configuration at maximum gross landing weight.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aircraft approach category.

dominio.definicion: Less than 169 kilometres/hour (91 knots) Indicated Air Speed (IAS).
169 kilometres/hour (91 knots) or more but less than 224 kilometres/hour (121 knots) Indicated Air Speed (IAS).
224 kilometres/hour (121 knots) or more but less than 261 kilometres/hour (141 knots) Indicated Air Speed (IAS).
261 kilometres/hour (141 knots) or more but less than 307 kilometres/hour (166 knots) Indicated Air Speed (IAS).
307 kilometres/hour (166 knots) Indicated Air Speed (IAS) or more.
dominio.observaciones: ICAO specifies an upper limit of 390 kilometres/hour (211 knots) Indicated Air Speed (IAS).

dominio.definicion: Helicopter only.
dominio.observaciones: The stall speed method of calculating aircraft category does not apply.

definicion: The recommended or required lateral inclination of the aircraft in the turn.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

definicion: The designed number of aircraft bays contained by an aircraft hangar or hardened aircraft shelter.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type(s) of fluid available for removal or prevention of ice, snow, shush or frost build-up from aircraft or aircraft engine on the ground.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aircraft de-icing fluid type.

dominio.definicion: Anti-freeze Aircraft Engine.
Deicing/Defrosting Fluid.
Methanol, reagent grade.
Inhibitor, icing, fuel system.
De-icing and Anti-icing Fluid (Type II).
Anti-Icing/De-Icing/Defrosting fluid.
Air compressors rated 3000 psi or higher used to blow contaminants off aircraft surfaces.

definicion: The number of trucks, carts, and/or stands at an aerodrome that are available for aircraft refuelling.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type(s) of trucks, carts, and/or stands that are available for aircraft refuelling at an aerodrome.

datatype.nombre: Aircraft Fuel Service Unit Type Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aircraft fuel service unit type.

dominio.definicion: A stationary unit, located at a designated refuelling position on an aerodrome surface, in which fuel is pumped into the aircraft via a hose and nozzle.
dominio.observaciones: A stationary fuelling unit has a filtering mechanism in which contaminants such as water are separated from fuel.

dominio.definicion: A hose cart or truck which is used to connect a stationary fueling port to an aircraft.
A trailer which has a fuel tank and dispenser, designed to be towed to the aircraft for purposes of refuelling.

definicion: The type(s) of infrastructure and/or equipment that are available at an aerodrome for refuelling an aircraft according to the fueling configuration of that aircraft.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aircraft fuel transfer infrastructure.

dominio.definicion: Infrastructure and/or equipment are available to enable refuelling of aircraft whose fuel tank access is located on the top side of the wing.
Infrastructure and/or equipment are available to enable refuelling of aircraft whose fuel tank access is located on the underside of the wing.
A standard fuel drum or set of fuel drums and associated infrastructure and/or equipment are available to refuel an aircraft whose fuel tank access is located on the top side of the wing.

definicion: The measured speed at which fuel can be dispensed into an aircraft for a specified fuelling unit.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value that is restricted to be non-negative.
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity (volume) of fluid which passes through a given surface per unit time.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of volume flow that is approximately 0.000016667 cubic metres per second.

definicion: The types of maintenance, support and/or supply operation(s) that are available to aircraft at an aerodrome.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aircraft ground service type.

dominio.definicion: The availability of services and fluids to remove ice, snow, slush or frost from aircraft surfaces.
The availability of services to organize and provide ground support for aircraft and flight crew.
dominio.observaciones: For example: catering, aircraft cleaning, ground transportation, and lavatory service.

dominio.definicion: The availability of services to organize and provide ground support for aircraft cargo.
The availability of shelter and/or indoor storage for aircraft.
The availability of services for the removal of disabled or damaged aircraft.
The availability of services to perform repairs to aircraft.
The availability of services of routine maintenance and inspection of aircraft.
The availability of services to guard against acts of unlawful interference at the aerodrome.

definicion: The largest wingspan aircraft of the highest Load Classification Number (LCN) known to have used a runway in the last five years.
descripcion: An aircraft with a shorter wingspan and the higher LCN will be identified in preference to an aircraft with a longer wingspan but lower LCN.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that contains only non-lexical characters and is 10 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The reference system used for an aircraft speed value.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aircraft speed reference.

dominio.definicion: The speed of an aircraft as shown on its pitot static airspeed indicator calibrated to reflect standard atmosphere adiabatic compressible flow at sea level uncorrected for airspeed system errors.
The speed of the aircraft relative to undisturbed air.
The calibrated airspeed is equal to the airspeed indicator reading corrected for position and instrument error.
The airspeed at sea level that would produce the same incompressible dynamic pressure as the true airspeed at the altitude at which the aircraft is flying.
The speed of an aircraft relative to the surface of the earth.

definicion: The designator of an aircraft stand used to uniquely identify it at an aerodrome.
descripcion: For example: '13' or '84 A'.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that contains only non-lexical characters and is unconstrained in length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The characteristics of an aircraft parking position, as a category.
descripcion: For example: a parking position on the apron, an isolated aircraft stand, or a terminal building gate.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aircraft stand type.

dominio.definicion: Angled nose-in parking position.
Angled nose-out parking position.
Isolated parking position.
Nose-in parking position.
Parallel (to building) parking position.
Remote parking position.

definicion: The category of an aircraft based on its wing configuration.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aircraft wing configuration.

dominio.definicion: A type of vehicle which is able to fly by being supported in the air using one of more fixed engines and fixed wing surfaces.
Aircraft capable of flight having rotor blades, which revolve around a mast that produce lift.

definicion: The type of an airfield based on the size and/or paving of its runways.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an airfield type.

dominio.definicion: Runways are greater than or equal to 910 metres in length and hard-surfaced.
Runways are less than 910 metres in length and hard-surfaced.
Runways are soft-surfaced.
Runways are either less than 910 metres in length or are soft-surfaced.

definicion: The primary use(s) of an airfield.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an airfield use.

dominio.definicion: An aerodrome that has the facilities, equipment, and services to support the operations of large commercial aircraft.
An aerodrome that has the facilities, equipment, and services to support the operations of mid-sized regional type aircraft or general aviation aircraft.
An aerodrome that has the necessary equipment for the takeoff, landing, maintenance, and storage needs of general aviation (sometimes referred to as 'light') aircraft.
An aerodrome that has the necessary equipment for the launch, landing, maintenance, and storage of manned gliders.
An aerodrome specifically designed to accommodate the special takeoff, landing, maintenance, and storage needs of a microlight- or ultralight-class aircraft.
An aerodrome that is specifically designed to accommodate the special takeoff, landing, maintenance, and storage needs of hang glider type aircraft.
An aerodrome that has the necessary equipment for the launch, landing, maintenance, and storage of hang gliders that are launched by a winch.
An aerodrome that has been reserved for emergency purposes, such as landing of distressed aircraft, landing of hazardous aircraft, or military operations during time of exercise or conflict.
An aerodrome that is specifically designed to accommodate the special takeoff, landing, maintenance, and storage needs of parasailing aircraft or individuals engaged in parascending sport.
An airfield that is equipped with search and rescue aircraft and facilities.
An airfield intended for the takeoff and landing of airships.
A site designated for the takeoff of balloons.

definicion: The primary situation(s) or reason(s) on the ground or in the air, which may have an impact on air traffic.
descripcion: For example: a missile firing range or air refuelling.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an airspace activity.

dominio.definicion: Airspace which is dependent upon every participant having 8.33 VHF voice receivers channel spacing equipment.
dominio.observaciones: A type of procedure/service.

dominio.definicion: Airspace needing a protective status due to an investigation of a flight catastrophe.
dominio.observaciones: A type of protection.

dominio.definicion: The usage of unusual or artful flying maneuvers for recreation, competition, or entertainment.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: The delivery of air to air or air to ground weapons for the destruction of a target.
dominio.observaciones: A type of military activity (usually).

dominio.definicion: The competition or practice by an individual or a group to achieve the best aerial performance.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic. This could be an air race or aerobatic training or competition.

dominio.definicion: Operations in which an aircraft is used for specialized services.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic. For example, services such as: agriculture, construction, photography, surveying, observation and patrol, search and rescue, and aerial advertisement.

dominio.definicion: All traffic on the manouevring area of an aerodrome and all aircraft flying in the vicinity of an aerodrome.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: Intercepting and destroying of hostile aircraft or conducting similar training activities.
dominio.observaciones: A type of military activity (usually).

dominio.definicion: A show at which aircraft are on view and featuring aerial displays.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: Custom specific flight information service, alerting service, air traffic advisory service, air traffic control service, area control service, approach control service, or airport control service is provided.
dominio.observaciones: A type of procedure/service. This could be a service in the air or on the ground.

dominio.definicion: The use of small rockets to protect crops by seeding clouds with small particles that prevent hailstorms from forming.
dominio.observaciones: A type of hazard.

dominio.definicion: The discharge of a projectile into the air for the destruction of a target.
dominio.observaciones: A type of military activity (usually).

dominio.definicion: The lifting of devices through the atmosphere, which are tied to a helium or hydrogen filled balloon.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic. For example: radio probes and meteorological balloons.
dominio.aliases: Ascent of Radio Probe, Radiosonde, Meteorological Balloon

dominio.definicion: High concentration of birds.
dominio.observaciones: A type of hazard.

dominio.definicion: A high number of bird species as they fly instinctual routes based on breeding or diverse environmental urges.
dominio.observaciones: A type of hazard. For example, large scale movements of migrating birds occur during various months in the European-Mediterranean and UK areas. There are also large concentrations of nesting, breeding, and wintering birds, often numbering in the millions, that may create a hazard to air traffic.

dominio.definicion: Controlled use of explosives to excavate or remove rock.
dominio.observaciones: A type of hazard.

dominio.definicion: A facility utilizing a chemical process for manufacturing.
dominio.observaciones: A type of industrial hazard.

dominio.definicion: Climb-out of jet aircraft via predefined and common tracks.
dominio.observaciones: A type of military activity (usually).

dominio.definicion: The dropping of troops, supplies, and/or bombs, from an aircraft.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: Launching of pyrotechnic devices.
dominio.observaciones: A type of hazard.

dominio.definicion: The launch, transit, and targeting of guided missiles.
dominio.observaciones: A type of military activity (usually). A guided missile is an unmanned self-propelled vehicle whose trajectory or course, while in flight, is controlled.

dominio.definicion: Pumping natural gas from the ground or converting gasoline into vapour.
dominio.observaciones: A type of industrial hazard.

dominio.definicion: Flying a non-power-driven heavier-than-air aircraft.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic. A glider derives its lift in flight chiefly from aerodynamic reactions on surfaces which remain fixed under given conditions of flight.

dominio.definicion: Recreational and competitive flying sport using a small glider from which the operator is suspended in a frame and which is controlled by movements of the body.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: Intense fire fighting activity involving chemical agents being laid down from fire fighting aircraft.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: Helicopter or gyrocopter operations.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: Non-navigational lights with high visibility potential.
dominio.observaciones: A type of hazard.

dominio.definicion: Electromagnetic fields produced by high intensity radio transmission.
dominio.observaciones: A type of hazard.

dominio.definicion: An area with a high concentration of inhabitants.
dominio.observaciones: A type of protection.

dominio.definicion: Flight activity involving a bag called the envelope that is capable of containing heated air, with a gondola or basket suspended beneath.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: The emission of photons in a coherent beam by an optical source.
dominio.observaciones: A type of hazard. For example: a laser light show. Laser stands for Light Amplification by Stimulated Emission of Radiation.

dominio.definicion: The execution of operations by the military.
dominio.observaciones: A type of military activity (usually).

dominio.definicion: Wildlife, flora, fauna or features of geological or other special interest which is reserved and managed for conservation.
dominio.observaciones: A type of protection. This is given a protective status. This could provide special opportunities for study or research. For example: a national park.

dominio.definicion: Airspace in which special procedures or other precautionary measures are established for reducing noise.
dominio.observaciones: A type of protection.

dominio.definicion: An installation which provides power derived from fission or fusion of atomic nuclei.
dominio.observaciones: A type of industrial hazard.

dominio.definicion: An area in which oil occurs in quantities worthy of exploitation.
dominio.observaciones: A type of industrial hazard.

dominio.definicion: A facility where petroleum and/or petroleum products are refined.
dominio.observaciones: A type of industrial hazard.

dominio.definicion: Exiting a flying aircraft by an individual using a parachute.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic. A parachute is a soft fabric device used to slow the motion through the atmosphere by generating drag.

dominio.definicion: Recreational and competitive flying sport using a free-flying, foot launched aircraft.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic. When paragliding, the pilot sits in a harness suspended below a fabric wing, whose shape is formed by the pressure of air entering vents in the front of the wing. It is known in some countries as parapenting.

dominio.definicion: The presence of an individual with status of head of state.
dominio.observaciones: A type of protection.

dominio.definicion: Transfer of fuel between aircraft in the air.
dominio.observaciones: A type of military activity (usually).

dominio.definicion: Every aircraft must have Area Navigation (RNAV) equipment.
dominio.observaciones: A type of procedure/service.

dominio.definicion: Every aircraft must have Reduced Vertical Separation Minimum (RVSM) equipment.
dominio.observaciones: A type of procedure/service.

dominio.definicion: Spraying crops with fertilizers, pesticides, and fungicides from an agricultural aircraft.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: The animals or animal life of a given area, habitat, or epoch which is easily and dangerously aroused by excessive aerial noise such as from an aircraft.
dominio.observaciones: A type of protection. For example: mink farms, turkey farms, and zoos.

dominio.definicion: Naval forces (for example: vessels or aircraft) conduct firing and/or munitions exercises.
dominio.observaciones: Distinguished from areas where Naval forces conduct general operations and manoeuvers.

dominio.definicion: The discharge of a gun or bow to propel arrows, bullets, etc swiftly or violently direct and sharply in specified directions.
dominio.observaciones: A type of military activity (usually). For example: a shooting range or hunting area.

dominio.definicion: Vertical launch for space flight operations.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: Operations requiring the aircraft to use special equipment.
dominio.observaciones: A type of procedure/service.

dominio.definicion: Special procedures established for use by operational personnel in execution of their flight.
dominio.observaciones: A type of procedure/service. An overhead approach is an example of a special procedure.

dominio.definicion: Drawing or pulling through the air a target for aerial shooting practice.
dominio.observaciones: A type of military activity (usually).

dominio.definicion: Generic technical activity affecting air traffic.
dominio.observaciones: A type of industrial hazard.

dominio.definicion: Flights conducted for the purpose of training.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: Operations of lightweight, slow-flying aircraft.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic.

dominio.definicion: The action or an act of forcing out or emitting something suddenly underwater.
dominio.observaciones: A type of hazard. Usually involving violence and noise.

dominio.definicion: The operation of a powered, aerial vehicle that does not carry a human operator.
dominio.observaciones: A type of special air traffic. An Unmanned Aerial Vehicle uses aerodynamic forces to provide vehicle lift, can fly autonomously or be piloted remotely, can be expendable or recoverable, and can carry a lethal or non-lethal payload.

dominio.definicion: The presence of an individual with status of Vice-Head of State.
dominio.observaciones: A type of protection.

dominio.definicion: The presence of an individual of renowned status and considered as a very important person.
dominio.observaciones: A type of protection.

definicion: A categorization of airspace which determines the operating rules, flight requirements, and services provided.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an airspace class.

dominio.definicion: IFR flights only are permitted, all flights are provided with air traffic control service and are separated from each other.
IFR and VFR flights are permitted, all flights are provided with air traffic control service and are separated from each other.
IFR and VFR flights are permitted, all flights are provided with air traffic control service and IFR flights are separated from other IFR flights and from VFR flights.
dominio.observaciones: VFR flights are separated from IFR flights and receive traffic information in respect of other VFR flights.

dominio.definicion: IFR and VFR flights are permitted and all flights are provided with air traffic control service, IFR flights are separated from other IFR flights and receive traffic information in respect of VFR flights, VFR flights receive traffic information in respect of all other flights.
IFR and VFR flights are permitted, IFR flights are provided with air traffic control service and are separated from other IFR flights.
dominio.observaciones: All flights receive traffic information as far as is practical. Class E shall not be used for control zones.

dominio.definicion: IFR and VFR flights are permitted, all participating IFR flights receive an air traffic advisory service and all flights receive flight information service if requested.
dominio.observaciones: Where air traffic advisory service is implemented, this is considered normally as a temporary measure only until such time as it can be replaced by air traffic control.

dominio.definicion: IFR and VFR flights are permitted and receive flight information service if requested.

definicion: The primary organization type providing air traffic services within a designated airspace.
descripcion: For example: civil and/or military organizations.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an airspace control.

dominio.definicion: The Military provides air traffic services within the designated airspace.
A Civilian organization provides air traffic services within the designated airspace.
Both Military and Civilian organizations provide air traffic services within the designated airspace.

definicion: A published sequence of characters allowing the unique identification of the airspace.
descripcion: For example, the identifier of the Danger Area, Prohibited Area, or Temporary Segregated Area.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that contains only non-lexical characters and is unconstrained in length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The name given to an airspace by a responsible authority.
descripcion: It should be written as published, with no significance to upper or lower case letters.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that contains only non-lexical characters and is unconstrained in length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The general structure or characteristics of a particular airspace, as a category.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an airspace type.

dominio.definicion: Special designated airspace of defined dimensions within which aircraft are required to comply with special identification and/or reporting procedures additional to those related to the provision of air traffic services (ATS).
dominio.observaciones: Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A control area or portion thereof established in the form of a corridor.
dominio.observaciones: NATO specifies that is must be marked with Radio Navigational Aids. Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: Airspace which may contain a high volume of pilot training activities or unusual type of aerial activity, neither of which is hazardous to aircraft.
dominio.observaciones: Mainly used in contiguous United States and its territories. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of defined dimensions within which standardized altimeter setting procedures apply.
dominio.observaciones: For example: during flight the altimeter shall be set to the current altimeter setting of the nearest station along the route of flight. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A danger area which is managed and allocated the day before operations of the Temporary Segregated Area.
dominio.observaciones: Mainly used in Europe under the Flexible Use of Airspace (FUA) concept. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A restricted area which is managed and allocated the day before operations of the Temporary Segregated Area.
dominio.observaciones: Mainly used in Europe under the Flexible Use of Airspace (FUA) concept. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A controlled airspace extending upwards from a specified limit above the earth.
dominio.observaciones: Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A subdivision of a designated control area within which responsibility is assigned to one controller or to a small group of controllers.
dominio.observaciones: Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A controlled airspace extending upwards from the surface of the earth to a specified upper limit.
dominio.observaciones: Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of defined dimensions, above the land areas or territorial waters of more than one state.
dominio.observaciones: Mainly used in Europe under the Flexible Use of Airspace (FUA) concept. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of defined dimensions within which activities dangerous to the flight of aircraft may exist at specified times.
dominio.observaciones: Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of defined dimensions within which flight information service and alerting service are provided.
dominio.observaciones: Might, for example, be used if service provided by more than one unit. Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: The lowest altitude to be used under instrument meteorological conditions (IMC) which will provide a minimum vertical clearance of 300 metres (1000 feet) or in designated mountainous terrain 600 metres (2000 feet) above all obstacles located in the area specified.
dominio.observaciones: Published by many States as rectangles of 1 x 1 degree on the ENR 6 charts. Note that in the exact calculation 984 feet can be used as an equivalent to 300 metres. Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A Control Area extending upwards in the upper airspace.
dominio.observaciones: Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of defined dimensions, above the land areas or territorial waters of a State, within which the flight of aircraft is prohibited.
dominio.observaciones: Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of defined dimensions, above the land areas or territorial waters of a State, within which the flight of aircraft is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.
dominio.observaciones: Also an area in which there are special restrictive measures employed to prevent or minimize interference between friendly forces, or which is under military jurisdiction in which special security measures are employed to prevent unauthorized entry. Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of pre-defined dimensions within which activities require the reservation of airspace for the exclusive use of specific users during a predetermined period of time.
dominio.observaciones: Mainly used in Europe under the Flexible Use of Airspace concept. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of pre-defined dimensions within which activities require the reservation of airspace during a predetermined period of time.
dominio.observaciones: Specific to the Flexible Use of Airspace concept in Europe. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A control area normally established at the confluence of ATS routes in the vicinity of one or more major aerodromes.
dominio.observaciones: Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A Control Area extending upwards in the upper airspace.
dominio.observaciones: Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An upper airspace of defined dimensions within which flight information service and alerting service are provided.
dominio.observaciones: Each state determines the definition for upper airspace. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: Control area established inside a flight information region, consisting of a fixed lower boundary and the lower boundary of the upper control region.
dominio.observaciones: For example: Flight information regions for Brest, Bordeaux, Marseille, Paris, and Reims above the highest of either FL115 or 3000 Feet AGL (900 metres), with some exceptions. Specific to French AIP. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An area of defined dimensions within which air traffic advisory service is available.
dominio.observaciones: Air traffic control service provides a much more complete service than air traffic advisory service; advisory areas and routes are therefore not established within controlled airspace, but air traffic advisory service may be provided below and above. Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An area of defined dimensions in upper airspace within which air traffic advisory service is available.
dominio.observaciones: Air traffic control service provides a much more complete service than air traffic advisory service; advisory areas and routes are therefore not established within controlled airspace, but air traffic advisory service may be provided below and above. Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of defined dimensions established around an military aerodrome for the protection of aerodrome traffic.
dominio.observaciones: Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of defined dimensions established around an aerodrome for the protection of aerodrome traffic.
dominio.observaciones: Recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A control area normally established at the confluence of ATS routes in the vicinity of one or more major military aerodromes.
dominio.observaciones: Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An airspace of defined dimensions within which the standard pressure altimeter setting applies.
dominio.observaciones: Standard Pressure setting is 29.92 inches Hg or 1013.2 hectoPascals (hPa). Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: An Airspace of defined dimensions within which GAT is permitted to fly 'off-route' without requiring GAT controllers to initiate co-ordination with OAT controllers.
dominio.observaciones: Mainly used in Europe under the Flexible Use of Airspace (FUA) concept. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A classification boundary before crossing which all French or foreign aircraft entering French airspace must be identified, for which purpose they must establish radio contact with the appropriate traffic coordination and control centre.
dominio.observaciones: Crossing the peripheral classification line should be carried out at a minimum flight altitude of 1500 feet. Specific to French airspace. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: A non-regulatory airspace of defined dimensions designated over international waters that contains activity which may be hazardous to aircraft not participating in the activity.
dominio.observaciones: Mainly used in contiguous United States and its territories. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: The night low flying system is situated exclusively in Class E controlled airspace with a lower limit of 1000 feet GND and a width of 5 nautical miles for all routes within the Federal Republic of Germany.
dominio.observaciones: It is used by jet combat aircraft, transport and liaison aircraft for night low level (terrain following) flights. Specific to German Airspace. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: Flights with the intention to land, exercises and flights carrying dangerous goods on board of military aircraft of foreign armed forces east of the deconfliction line are subject to authorization by Federal Ministry.
dominio.observaciones: Specific to German Airspace. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: The Low Flying Areas are special training areas used for air-to-ground attack exercises.
dominio.observaciones: Specific to German Airspace. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: In order to protect certain kinds of air traffic or special air activities, specified areas may be designated as a special rules zone with further regulations.
dominio.observaciones: The execution of a flight within an SRZ with non-participating aircraft is prohibited during activities. Specific to German Airspace. Not recognized by ICAO.

dominio.definicion: Airspace of defined vertical and lateral limits established for the purpose of separating certain military training operations from civilian air traffic.
dominio.observaciones: Whenever a Military Operations Area (MOA) is being used, non-participating Instrument Flight Rules (IFR) traffic may be cleared through a MOA if IFR separation can be provided by Air Traffic Control (ATC).

dominio.definicion: An airspace with defined dimensions in which flight of any type of aircraft is prohibited.
dominio.observaciones: No-fly areas are usually set up in a military context, somewhat like a demilitarized zone in the sky, and usually prohibit military aircraft of a belligerent nation from operating in the region.

definicion: The maximum total value of the weight of an aircraft that a movement area surface may support, regardless of the landing gear configuration of the aircraft.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of the property of a body that causes it to have weight in a gravitational field.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "mass", defined as equal to the mass of the international prototype of the kilogram.

definicion: The general categorization of aircraft that may use the route segment.
descripcion: For example: jet, helicopter, or propeller.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an allowed aircraft on route.

dominio.definicion: Jet aircraft, propeller aircraft as well as helicopter aircraft are allowed to operate on the route segment.
Only jet aircraft are allowed to operate on the route segment.
Both jet aircraft and propeller aircraft are allowed to operate on the route segment.
Only propeller aircraft are allowed to operate on the route segment.
Both propeller aircraft and helicopter aircraft are allowed to operate on the route segment.
Only helicopter aircraft are allowed to operate on the route segment.

definicion: An indication that a feature is an alternate.
descripcion: An alternate feature is one that may be used when the primary feature is unavailable.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: An indication that an instrument approach procedure may be used when the aerodrome is serving as an alternate to the original destination of the aircraft.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The applicable interpretation of the stated altitude.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an altitude description.

dominio.definicion: Aircraft shall be flown between the lower and the upper specified altitudes/flight levels.
Aircraft shall be flown at the specified altitude/flight level or higher.
Aircraft shall be flown at the specified altitude/flight level or lower.
Aircraft must be flown only at the specified altitude/flight level.
Aircraft should be flown at the specified altitude/flight level.
Aircraft should be flown at the specified altitude/flight level, unless otherwise instructed by air traffic control.
Aircraft shall be flown at an altitude/flight level determined by Air Traffic Control.

definicion: The type of an amusement park attraction based on its geometric form, appearance, configuration, and/or use.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an amusement attraction type.

dominio.definicion: Having the general form of a mountain (for example: conical and peaked, but smaller) and occupied by amusement attractions.
A giant, vertical revolving wheel with passenger cars on its periphery.
A switchback railway that goes up and down and/or changes direction repeatedly and/or suddenly.
Having the form of a sphere and occupied by amusement attractions.
dominio.observaciones: For example, Epcot Center.

dominio.definicion: An amusement ride or activity normally located in an amusement park or water park that involves water as an essential part of the amusement.
dominio.observaciones: For example, water slides, splash pads, spraygrounds (water playgrounds), lazy rivers, or other recreational bathing environments. Parks in more current states of development may also be equipped with some type of artificial surfing or bodyboarding environment such as a wave pool or a FlowRider(R).

dominio.definicion: Amusement rides with passenger cars or apparatus that travel up, down, around or between one or more tall fixed vertical structures.
dominio.observaciones: For example, drop towers, pendulum rides, bungee jump and reverse bungee rides.

definicion: The type(s) of an anchorage based on the size, type, or duration of craft that may be anchored.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an anchorage type.

dominio.definicion: An area in which vessels anchor or may anchor without restriction.
An area in which vessels of deep draught anchor or may anchor.
An area in which tankers anchor or may anchor.
An area set apart for anchored ships discharging or receiving explosives.
An area where a vessel anchors when satisfying quarantine regulations.
An area in which seaplanes anchor or may anchor.
An area in which yachts and/or small boats anchor or may anchor.
An area in which yachts and small boats moor.
An area in which vessels anchor or may anchor for periods of up to 24 hours.
An area in which vessels may anchor for a period of time not to exceed a specific limit.
dominio.observaciones: Restricted in duration or to a specific period of time.

dominio.definicion: A specified area designated by an appropriate authority within which vessels anchor or may anchor in accordance with certain specified conditions.
An anchorage for a reserve fleet.
dominio.observaciones: A reserve fleet is a collection of naval vessels that are fully equipped for fighting but are not currently needed. They may be modified, for instance by having rust prone areas sealed off or wrapped in plastic. Ships of the reserve fleet are usually moored in backwater areas near naval bases or shipyards, to speed the reactivation process.

dominio.definicion: A designated area of water where a single vessel may anchor.
dominio.observaciones: In general the anchorage berth is defined by the centre point and a swinging circle.

definicion: The initial angular limit, expressed as a radial or bearing from an object.
descripcion: The order of the angle initial limit and terminal limit are always ordered clockwise around the central object, as viewed from above.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value that is restricted to fall in the range from 0 to 359.9, inclusive.
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

definicion: The angular distance in the horizontal plane measured from true north (0 degrees) clockwise to the major axis of the feature.
descripcion: If the feature is square, the axis 0 up to 90 degrees is recorded. If the feature is circular, 360 degrees is recorded.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

definicion: The angular distance measured from True North clockwise to the reflective side of the radar reflector.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

definicion: The navigational reference system on which the measurement of an angle is based.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an angle reference type.

dominio.definicion: The horizontal direction of an object or point measured clockwise from Magnetic North up to, but not including, 360 arc degrees.
The horizontal direction of an object or point measured clockwise from True North up to, but not including, 360 arc degrees.
A magnetic bearing extending from a VOR navigation facility.

definicion: The terminal angular limit, expressed as a radial or bearing from an object.
descripcion: The order of the angle initial limit and terminal limit are always ordered clockwise around the central object, as viewed from above.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value that is restricted to fall in the range from 0 to 359.9, inclusive.
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

definicion: The type(s) of animals on a farm or in a breeding facility.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an animal husbandry type.

dominio.definicion: Domestic fowl, including barn-door fowls, geese, ducks, and turkeys, that are used for their flesh, eggs and/or feathers.
A solid-hoofed quadruped with mane and tail of long coarse hair, domesticated for the sake of pack or draught animal as well as for sports.
A deer inhabiting the sub-arctic parts of the northern hemisphere, domesticated and mostly used as a draught animal.
Domesticated animals, especially oxen and cows.
A gregarious ruminant animal, especially the domesticated Ovis aries, reared for the sake of its flesh and wool.
A swine, domesticated for the sake of its flesh and skin.
A hairy, horned and bearded domesticated ruminant belonging to the genus Capra.
An aquatic oviparous, cold blooded vertebrate animal, provided with permanent gills, usually covered with scales and moving by means of fins, that is used as food.
A domesticated horse-like animal that is used as a pack or draught animal.
Wild animal bred in fenced parks for the sake of their flesh and/or skin.
A large pachydermatous animal, four-footed, with flexible proboscis and long curved tusks, partially domesticated and used as beast of draught and burden.
A domesticated quadruped of numerous breeds classed together as Canis familiaris, derived from crossing of various species, bred as a pet or for special ranges of use.
A large, homeless, humpbacked ruminant with long neck and padded feet, used as a beast of burden.
A domesticated Peruvian wool-bearing animal, resembling a camel, but humpless and smaller, used as a beast of burden and for its wool.
The offspring of a male ass and a mare that is used as a pack animal.
An animal yielding a fur valuable commercially and bred on farms.
A bee that produces honey as food for man.
The larva of Bombyx mori or allied moths that enclose their chrysalis in a cocoon of silk and is bred for the production of silk for textiles.

definicion: Rate of annual change in magnetic variation.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity by which events are compared in position and duration.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of time that is 60 seconds in duration.

definicion: The configuration of an antenna based on its construction.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an antenna configuration.

dominio.definicion: A radio antenna that can be made from a simple wire, with a centre fed driven element.
A radio frequency antenna consisting of a wire whose length does not bear relation to the wavelength of the radio waves used, and chosen more for for convenience.
A group of antennas which varies respective signals feeding the antennas effectively to reinforce radiation pattern in desired directions, and suppressing undesired directions.
A directional radio or TV antenna consisting of two or more dipoles in the same plane with all dipoles parallel to each other.

definicion: A code indicating the type of markings depicted on the runway.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an approach capability markings.

dominio.definicion: The runway has the minimum markings required to support Visual Flight Rules (VFR) operations.
dominio.observaciones: These minimum requirements are the Runway Designation and Centerline markings.

dominio.definicion: The runway has the minimum markings required to support non-precision Instrument Flight Rules (IFR) operations.
dominio.observaciones: These minimum requirements are the Runway Designation, Centerline, Threshold, and Aiming Point markings.

dominio.definicion: The runway has the minimum markings required to support precision Instrument Flight Rules (IFR) operations.
dominio.observaciones: These minimum requirements are the Runway Designation, Centerline, Threshold, Aiming Point, and Touchdown Zone markings.

definicion: A description of the approach, including directions and potential hazards.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that has no restrictions on lexicality or length.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a character string. For example: Golden Gate Bridge.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The lowest prevailing visibility needed to land at the aerodrome when at the specified minimum altitude or height.
descripcion: The visibility value, observed in accordance with the definition of 'visibility', which is reached or exceeded within at least half the horizon circle or within at least half of the surface of the aerodrome. These areas could comprise contiguous or non-contiguous sectors. This value may be assessed by human observation and/or instrumented systems. When instruments are installed, they are used to obtain the best estimate of the prevailing visibility.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 1,852.0 metres.

definicion: A word or code placed at the beginning of the procedure name to denote a special application for the procedure.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an approach prefix.

dominio.definicion: A prefix indicating an approach procedure with a high altitude initial segment such as a high altitude teardrop penetration.
dominio.observaciones: Usually requested by Military. Normally C, D and E Minimums only.

dominio.definicion: A prefix indicating a procedure specifically designed for helicopters.
A prefix indicating a procedure with parallel or joining ILS courses operating simultaneously.

definicion: The type of an Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) based on the navigation equipment required.
descripcion: This will also form part of the procedure name.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an approach type.

dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Airport Surveillance Radar (ASR).
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of (precision, on-board) Airborne Radar Approach (ARA) equipment.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Air Route Surveillance Radar (ARSR).
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Precision Approach Radar (PAR).
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Instrument Landing System (ILS) equipment.

dominio.etiqueta: Instrument Landing System (ILS) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME)
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of an Instrument Landing System (ILS) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME).

dominio.etiqueta: Instrument Landing System (ILS) using a Precision Runway Monitor (PRM)
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of an Instrument Landing System (ILS) using a Precision Runway Monitor (PRM).
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Localizer Type Directional Aid (LDA) equipment.

dominio.etiqueta: Localizer-type Directional Aid (LDA) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME)
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of a Localizer Type Directional Aid (LDA) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME).
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Localizer equipment.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Localizer Back Course equipment.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of a Localizer with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME).

dominio.etiqueta: Localizer with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME) Back Course
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of a Localizer Back Course with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME).
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Microwave Landing System (MLS) equipment.

dominio.etiqueta: Microwave Landing System (MLS) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME)
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of a Microwave Landing System (MLS) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME).
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Non-Directional Beacon (NDB) equipment.

dominio.etiqueta: Non-Directional Beacon (NDB) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME)
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of a Non-Directional Beacon (NDB) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME).
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Simplified Directional Facility (SDF) equipment.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Transponder Landing System (TLS) equipment.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of VHF Omnidirectional Radio (VOR) equipment.

dominio.etiqueta: VHF Omnidirectional Radio (VOR) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME)
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of a VHF Omnidirectional Radio (VOR) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME).
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of UHF Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN) Beacon equipment.

dominio.etiqueta: VHF Omnidirectional Radio (VOR) with UHF Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN) Beacon
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of a VHF Omnidirectional Radio (VOR) with UHF Tactical Air Navigation (TACAN) Beacon equipment.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Distance Measuring Equipment (DME).

dominio.etiqueta: Distance Measuring Equipment (DME) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME)
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Distance Measuring Equipment (DME) with Distance Measuring Equipment (DME) located at an additional location.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Required Navigation Performance (RNP) capabilities.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Global Positioning System (GPS) receiver equipment.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receiver equipment.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Area Navigation (RNAV) equipment.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Instrument Guidance System (IGS) equipment.

dominio.etiqueta: Area Navigation (RNAV) to Instrument Landing System (ILS)
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Area Navigation (RNAV) equipment followed by Instrument Landing System (ILS) equipment.

dominio.etiqueta: Special Aircraft and Aircrew Approval Required (SAAAR)
dominio.definicion: The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Required Navigation Performance (RNP) Special Aircraft and Aircrew Approval Required (SAAAR) capabilities.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Visual procedures.
The Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) depends on the use of Satellite Based Augmentation System (SBAS) equipment.

definicion: An indication that the capability to physically secure an aircraft to an apron surface is available.
descripcion: The aircraft may be secured to the surface of the apron with, for example, ropes or chains.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of an apron based upon its location on an aerodrome and its general purpose.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an apron type.

dominio.definicion: An area designed for aircraft maneuvering and parking that is adjacent or readily accessible to passenger terminal facilities.
An area designed for aircraft maneuvering and parking that is adjacent or readily accessible to cargo facilities.
An area removed from the passenger or cargo terminal where aircraft may park as to not disturb normal aerodrome operations.
An uncovered area adjacent to a hangar on which aircraft maintenance can be performed, or an area on which aircraft move into and out of a hangar.
An area designed for aircraft maneuvering and parking that is adjacent or readily accessible to facilities that support corporate or personal flying operations.
An area designed for aircraft maneuvering and parking that is adjacent or readily accessible to facilities that support military operations.
An area for a single military aircraft designed to isolate the damage suffered by one aircraft from spreading to the others during an attack.
dominio.observaciones: Usually found in a group but separated from others by distance and often revetted. They are found arrayed along a loop taxiway that is connected to the runway(s).

dominio.definicion: A defined area where aircraft can be held, or bypassed, to facilitate efficient surface movement of aircraft.

definicion: The function(s) that may be performed on an apron.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an apron usage.

dominio.definicion: An apron used for parking of aircraft.
An apron that is used for either or both the loading or unloading passengers or cargo.
An apron that is used for either or both the loading or unloading of fuel.
An apron where space has been set aside for use by visiting aircraft.
A painted compass rose on the surface of an apron, used as reference to calibrate on-board aircraft compasses.
An apron where aircraft engines are occasionally pre-flight tested at high RPM.
dominio.observaciones: May be equipped with one or more blast deflectors.

dominio.definicion: An apron where aircraft maintenance is performed.
dominio.observaciones: It is often attended by special purpose vehicles.

dominio.definicion: An military apron usually collocated with a taxiway with rapid access to a runway end, used by combat-ready aircraft prepared to take off on short notice.
Designed for the use of a single military fighter aircraft for zeroing-in and aligning forward-firing weapons, located in a protected area opposite a tall, wide earthen targeting wall.
An apron that is used for the loading of fuel while the aircraft engines are running.
An apron that is used for either or both the loading or unloading of aircraft weaponry.

An apron where frost, ice or snow is removed (de-icing) from the aircraft to provide clean surfaces, and/or where clean surfaces of the aircraft receive protection (anti-icing) preventing the formation of frost or ice and accumulation of snow or slush for a limited period of time.
A designated location where the automated Inertial Navigation System (INS) instruments of aircraft are reset before taking-off.
A designated site where a Chemical, Biological, Radiological or Nuclear (CBRN) contaminated aircraft, checked at landing, is sent to be decontaminated by special teams.
An apron where aircraft are cleaned.

definicion: The type, purpose, or intended role served by an aquaculture facility.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aquaculture facility type.

dominio.definicion: The cultivation of marine organisms for food and other products in either the open ocean, in an enclosed section of the ocean, or in tanks, ponds or raceways that are filled with seawater (for example: the farming of marine fish, prawns, or oysters in saltwater ponds).
A process for free ranching marine fish or sea ranching.
dominio.observaciones: The principle is based on behavioral conditioning and the migratory nature of certain species of marine fish. Fish hatchlings are initially raised in a closely knitted net in a harbor, during which time an underwater horn is sounded before each feeding. When the young fish are old enough they are freed from the net to mature in the open sea. During spawning season, about 80 percent of these fish return to their birthplace. The fish are harvested by sounding the horn and then raising the net.

dominio.definicion: An aquaculture business for the cultivation of marine shrimp for human consumption.
The harvesting of the top few feet of natural kelp beds by boats with mowers.
A facility that raises and then releases juvenile fish into the wild to support recreational fishing, or to supplement the natural numbers of a species.
An aquaculture business designed to raise and produce freshwater prawn or shrimp for human consumption.
A facility involved in the raising of fish commercially in tanks or landlocked enclosures, usually for food.
dominio.observaciones: Fish species raised on fish farms include, for example, salmon, catfish, tilapia, cod, carp, and trout.

definicion: The growth pattern, location and/or habit of aquatic vegetation.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aquatic vegetation growth habit code.

dominio.definicion: Aquatic vegetation that grows completely under the surface of the water.
dominio.observaciones: Includes sea grass and large (macro) algae such as kelp. Parts of the plant may expose at low water levels, but the plant will begin to die if the normal water level is not soon restored.

dominio.definicion: Aquatic vegetation that is rooted in the sediments and either extends above the water surface for a short height or floats on the surface of the water.
dominio.observaciones: Includes water lilies, grasses, sedges, and rushes.

dominio.definicion: Aquatic vegetation that is not rooted and floats with local currents.
dominio.observaciones: Algae that can accumulate in still waters, coastally, within coves and/or along frontal boundaries.

dominio.definicion: Aquatic vegetation that occurs in waterlogged soils and has specialized roots for stabilization and oxygen.
dominio.observaciones: Includes mangroves, cypress, and shrubs. Normally located in areas sheltered from high-energy waves.

definicion: The type of an aqueduct based on its structure.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aqueduct type.

dominio.definicion: An artificial gently sloping underground channel or tunnel.
dominio.observaciones: Usually lined to prevent or reduce water loss.

dominio.definicion: A pipe located on a waterbody bottom.
dominio.observaciones: May be either buried or lie relatively unprotected on the waterbody bottom.

dominio.definicion: A lined but usually uncovered surface-level channel.
dominio.observaciones: In order to allow for gravity-driven flow it may be raised on an embankment, supported by a bridge, and/or pass through a terrain cut.

dominio.definicion: An artificial gently sloping underground channel or tunnel connected to the surface by qanat shafts.
dominio.observaciones: A qanat aqueduct generally starts in the mountains and uses gravity to bring water to a village below.

definicion: The type of permeable geologic formation that composes the aquifer.
descripcion: The ability of the aquifer to store water is dependent on the porosity and permeability of the aquifer composition.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an aquifer composition.

dominio.definicion: A dark-colored fine-grained extrusive or intrusive igneous rock composed largely of plagioclase feldspar and pyroxene.
Loose rock (sediment) larger than 256 millimetres (10 inches).
A clastic mineral particle of any composition that has a grain size smaller than 1/256 millimetres.
dominio.observaciones: Descriptive of a broad category of hydrous silicate minerals in which the silica tetrahedrons are arranged into sheets. Clastic rocks are composed of fragments, or clasts, of pre-existing rock.

dominio.definicion: A clastic sedimentary rock that contains large (greater than 2.0 millimetres In diameter) rounded or semirounded rock particles.
dominio.observaciones: The space between the rock particles are generally filled with smaller particles and/or chemical cement that bind the rock together.

dominio.definicion: A sedimentary rock type of compact limestone consisting of calcium magnesium carbonate in the form of the mineral dolomite.
A coarse-grained, intrusive igneous rock composed primarily of light colored minerals such as quartz, orthoclase, sodium plagioclase and muscovite mica.
Clastic sedimentary particles of any composition that are greater than 2.0 millimetres in diameter and less than 256 millimetres.
dominio.observaciones: Clastic rocks are composed of fragments, or clasts, of pre-existing rock.

dominio.definicion: Rock formed by the solidification of molten rock material below the Earth's surface or rock formed at the Earth's surface as a result of the partial melting of rocks within the mantle and crust.
dominio.observaciones: When formed below the Earth's surface it is called intrusive igneous rocks. When formed at the Earth's surface it is called extrusive igneous rocks.

dominio.definicion: A landscape, normally underlain by limestone, dolomite or gypsum, where the topography is primarily formed by the dissolving of rock by water, and in which the bedrock may be characterized by voids and cavities.
dominio.observaciones: Karst areas have numerous depressions and/or valleys caused by the collapse of the underlying bedrock. Karst topography is characterized by sinkholes, sinking streams, closed depressions, subterranean drainage, and caves.

dominio.definicion: A sedimentary rock that contains at least 50 percent calcium carbonate in the form of calcite by weight.
dominio.observaciones: Limestone is usually formed from shells of once-living organisms or other organic processes, but may also form by inorganic precipitation.

dominio.definicion: A calcium carbonate or lime-rich mud or mudstone which contains variable amounts of clays and aragonite.
dominio.observaciones: It is formed by precipitation in lake or marine settings. High calcium carbonate content tends to make dried marl earthy and crumbly.

dominio.definicion: Existing rocks that have been altered by heat and pressure or by contact with molten magma.
dominio.observaciones: Examples include quartzite and marble.

dominio.definicion: A sedimentary material consisting of a mixture of clay and/or silt with water to form a plastic mass with a grain size preponderantly below 0.06 millimetres in diameter.
dominio.observaciones: Mud is deposited in low-energy environments in lakes, estuaries and lagoons. It may also be deposited in deep-sea environments.

dominio.definicion: A sedimentary material, finer than gravel and coarser than silt, with grains between 1/16 and 2.0 millimetres in diameter.
A metamorphic rock containing abundant particles of mica, characterized by strong foliation, and originating from a metamorphism in which directed pressure plays a significant role.
Sediment that has not been lithified.
dominio.observaciones: Lithification is the process in which sediments compact under pressure, expel connate fluids, and gradually become solid rock.

dominio.definicion: Fine particles of volcanic rock and glass blown into the atmosphere by volcanic eruptions, which have settled to form semi-consolidated to consolidated layers, for example tuff, but may include agglomerate, pyroclastic breccia, lapillistone, and lapilli tuff.
dominio.observaciones: Volcanic ash includes tiny jagged pieces of rock and glass that are hard, mildly corrosive, conduct electricity when wet, and does not dissolve in water.

dominio.definicion: Rock formed by the solidification of molten rock material at or near the Earth's surface.
Any of various sedimentary rocks composed of sand grains, especially of quartz, cemented together.
dominio.observaciones: Typically red, yellow, brown, grey, or white in colour.

dominio.definicion: Soft finely stratified rock that splits easily into fragile laminae, consisting of consolidated mud or clay.

descripcion: The productivity refers to the estimated typical long-term yield from single, properly sited and constructed borehole (well).

dominio.definicion: Less than 0.1 litres per second.
Between 0.1 and 1 litres per second.

dominio.observaciones: An aquifer located at great depth.

dominio.observaciones: An aquifer with intermediate permeability (permeabilty coefficient from 10E-4 to 10E-6 metres per second). It has the potential to be considered a source for public supply or industry.

dominio.observaciones: An aquifer with high permeability (permeabilty coefficient greater than 10E-4 metres per second). It has the potential to be considered a source for public supply or industry.

dominio.observaciones: It is used as a fuel for tractors and jet engines, and in domestic heaters.

dominio.definicion: The transparent, colourless, tasteless, odourless, liquid compound of hydrogen and oxygen (formula H2O).
