definicion: The type of the magnitude of the earthquake, based on the method used in its determination.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an earthquake magnitude type.

dominio.definicion: The computed value is the surface-wave magnitude.
dominio.observaciones: A surface-wave is a seismic wave that is constrained to follow the natural wave guide of the Earth's uppermost layers. Its magnitude is quantified using a base-10 logarithmic scale based on the ratio of the amplitude of ground motion to its period, corrected by a factor that is a function of the distance from the point of measurement to the earthquake epicenter. The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) computes surface wave magnitudes for earthquakes that are located at distances between 20 and 160 geocentric arc degrees from the recording station, have a seismic-wave period between 18 and 22 seconds, and whose depth is less than 50 kilometres (generally surface-wave magnitudes are not computed by the USGS for depths greater than 50 kilometres). May be designated as 'Ms'.

dominio.definicion: The computed value is the body-wave magnitude.
dominio.observaciones: A body-wave is a seismic wave that travels into and through the Earth's inner layers. Its magnitude is quantified using a base-10 logarithmic scale based on the ratio of the amplitude of ground motion to its period, corrected by a factor that is a function of the distance from the point of measurement to the earthquake epicenter and the focal depth of the earthquake. The U.S. Geological Survey computes body-wave values based on a seismic-wave period greater than or equal to 0.1 and less than or equal to 3.0 seconds, and whose distance is greater than or equal to 5 geocentric arc degrees. May be designated as 'mb'.

dominio.definicion: The computed value is the moment magnitude.
dominio.observaciones: The moment magnitude is computed from a long-period body- and mantle-wave moment tensor inversion method; it is also related to the product of the area of the earthquake fault, multiplied by the average fault slip over that area and by the shear modulus of the fault rocks. The moment magnitude value is approximately the same as the surface-wave magnitude value. May be designated as 'MW' or 'Mw'.

dominio.definicion: The computed value is the energy magnitude.
dominio.observaciones: The magnitude is computed from the radiated energy using the method described in Choy and Boatwright (1995). The energy radiated by an earthquake is estimated from the energy spectral density of the broadband P waves (Boatwright and Choy, 1986). The energy magnitude can complement moment magnitudes in describing the size of an earthquake. The energy magnitude, being derived from velocity power spectra, is a measure of the amount of damage that could be caused. The moment magnitude, being derived from low-frequency asymptote of displacement spectra, is more physically related to the final static displacement of an earthquake. May be designated as 'Me'.

dominio.definicion: The computed value is the local magnitude.
dominio.observaciones: Generally referred to as the true 'Richter magnitude' (originally defined for California), it is a base-10 logarithmic scale obtained by calculating the logarithm of the combined horizontal amplitude of the largest displacement from zero on a Wood-Anderson torsion seismometer output. The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) computes local magnitude values for distances less than 600 kilometres from the epicenter with focal depths less than 70 kilometres; local magnitudes are computed by the USGS in the western part of the United States as well as world-wide, often using different calibrating functions. May be designated as 'ML'.

dominio.definicion: The computed value is the local or regional magnitude.
dominio.observaciones: The magnitude is the body-wave magnitude computed from the vertical component 1-second short-period surface seismic waves. The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) computes local or regional magnitude values for the area of North America east of the Rocky Mountains; these are also computed by the USGS in other parts of the world, using different calibrating functions. May be designated as 'Mn' or 'mbLg'.

dominio.definicion: The estimated value is the duration magnitude.
dominio.observaciones: The estimated magnitude is derived from the duration or coda length of earthquake vibrations. The duration magnitude formulas vary for different geographic regions and for different seismographic instruments. Duration or coda length magnitude scales are normally adjusted to agree with local magnitude, or local or regional magnitude, estimates. May be designated as 'MD' or 'CL'.

dominio.definicion: The estimated value is the felt area magnitude.
dominio.observaciones: The estimated magnitude is based on isoseismal maps or defined areas using intensity-attenuation relationships, and is compatible with an estimated body-wave magnitude. The felt area magnitude is commonly computed from the felt area for earthquakes which occurred before seismic instruments were in general use. May be designated as 'FA' or 'MI'.

datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The type of an embankment based on its use and/or relationship to the surrounding terrain.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an embankment type.

dominio.definicion: A raised long mound of earth or other material.
dominio.observaciones: Raised above the surrounding terrain on both sides.

dominio.definicion: A raised section of terrain intended to level a sloped area.
dominio.observaciones: For example, to support a portion of a roadbed on the side of a mountain. Also used to describe an embankment to fill or traverse a gully or hollow.

dominio.definicion: An artificial embankment to contain or hold back water.
An embankment providing a route across wet and/or intertidal terrain.
dominio.observaciones: Usually supports a road.

dominio.definicion: A natural low embankment bordering a distributary or meandering stream that may subsequently be built up artificially to control floods.
An artificial embankment subdividing a waterbody (for example: a pond, a lake, and/or a rice paddy).

definicion: The average length of time between when an emergency response service is first notified of an emergency and when the service first arrives at the emergency location.
descripcion: Emergency response services include fire and rescue, law enforcement, and emergency medical service.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value that is restricted to be non-negative.
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity by which events are compared in position and duration.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of time that is 60 seconds in duration.

definicion: An altitude which provides at least 1000 feet of obstacle clearance in nonmountainous areas or 2000 feet of obstacle clearance in designated mountainous areas within a 100 nautical mile radius of the navigation facility upon which the procedure is predicated.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 0.3048 metres.

definicion: The type(s) of organic and/or inorganic components of the environment that are endangered by pollutants within an area.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an endangered environment components.

dominio.definicion: The ground, especially the top stratus of the Earth's crust whence plants derive their mineral food.
The water on the Earth's surface.
The water accumulated in the underground and filling cavities in the Earth's crust.
The gaseous envelope surrounding the Earth.
Any animal organism, wild or domesticated, including humans.
Any vegetable organism, naturally grown or cultivated.

definicion: The type of a natural resources commonly used for the production of energy through combustion.
descripcion: For example: crude oil, coal, and natural gas.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an energy raw material.

dominio.definicion: Brown to black, solid or semisolid, bituminous substance made almost entirely of carbon and hydrogen.
dominio.observaciones: Natural asphalt is formed in oil-bearing rocks by the evaporation of volatiles.

dominio.definicion: Dark-brown to black coal whose metamorphic rank lies between subbituminous coal and anthracite.
dominio.observaciones: Medium-rank coal.

dominio.definicion: Brown to brownish black, low metamorphic rank coal (includes lignite and subbituminous coal).
dominio.observaciones: Intermediate metamorphic rank between peat and bituminous coal.

dominio.definicion: Naturally occuring complex liquid hydrocarbons.
dominio.observaciones: Petroleum that emerges from a well is defined as crude oil.

dominio.definicion: Naturally occuring gaseous hydrocarbons.
Dark grey or black shale that contain organic substances that yield liquid hydrocarbons on distillation, but that do not contain free petroleum.
Sandstone or unconsolidated sand containing petroleum or impregnated with hydrocarbons.
Oil reservoir in a sandstone or unconsolidated sand where the volatiles have escaped and the rock has become impregnated with hydrocarbon residue.
Hard, black coal that has a semimetallic luster and semiconchoidal fracture.
dominio.observaciones: Anthracite is a coal of the highest metamorphic rank (high-rank coal), with more than 90 percent by weight of carbon.

definicion: The type of an engine test cell based on the purpose for which it was designed.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an engine test cell type.

dominio.definicion: An all-weather facility used for the performance testing of a dismounted jet engine that includes an augmenter tube and an overall enclosure designed to minimize noise exposure by test personnel and others in the vicinity.
dominio.observaciones: The facility acts as a large fluid-driven pump. Engine exhaust gases, leaving the nozzle as a high-velocity, high-temperature, relatively small diameter jet, are directed into the augmenter tube. An expanding shear layer develops around the jet, pulling along a layer of cool ambient air. Momentum and energy are transferred to this augmentation air, decreasing the velocity and temperature of the jet. The overall structure generally consists of an intake stack, a test enclosure, the blast augmenter tube and an exhaust ramp and/or stack.

dominio.definicion: An all-weather noise-abatement facility for conducting ground run-up testing of installed jet engines and/or making final adjustments and tuning the engines after overhauls.
dominio.observaciones: It consists of a tall hangar with sound-proof walls that may contain either the entire aircraft (in the case of wing-mounted engines) or just the tail section (in the case of tail-mounted engines). Prominently placed are multiple stacks (chimneys) for air inlet and exhaust; there may be additional horizontal tube-exhausts along the rear wall. The exhaust stacks and/or tubes contain sound-silencers and they are linked to augmenter tubes placed behind the jet engine(s) being tested in order to gather all exhausts.

dominio.definicion: An open-air structure for testing the performance of an upright (vertically mounted) rocket engine that includes a blast deflector and/or cooling mechanisms (for example: water sprays) to handle the substantial amount of high-temperature exhaust gases produced during operation.
dominio.observaciones: The structure is usually associated with substantial liquid fuel (for example: liquid hydrogen or kerosene) and oxidant (for example: liquid oxygen) tanks and associated pipes. It is typically located distant from centers of population due to the intense sound produced during test firing.

dominio.definicion: A structure, usually open-air, for testing the performance of a horizontally mounted rocket engine.
dominio.observaciones: The structure is sufficient to mount the engine (for example: a solid-fuel booster) and safely direct the exhaust. There may be a concrete pan to provide a degree of protection to the local surface. In the case of a liquid-fueled engine there may be associated small tanks containing fuel and oxidizer. In some cases the entire structure may consist of a shed with a side that is either permanently or temporarily opened during testing.

definicion: The type of an excavation and/or embankment created for the purpose of enhancing the defense of a site from armed attack.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an engineered earthwork type.

dominio.definicion: A site serving as an emplacement for one or more pieces of artillery.
A wall-like barrier at the edge or along the top of a earthen structure built for defensive purposes and normally pierced to provide protected sites for the discharge of defensive projectiles.
A trench dug for military purposes.
dominio.observaciones: For example: to be used as a line of firing positions for hand-held weapons or as a means of personnel movement that provides cover and concealment.

dominio.definicion: A defensive wall consisting of a low earthen embankment topped by a parapet or palisade.
An enclosed, usually square or polygonal, outwork or fieldwork with little or no flanking defences.
dominio.observaciones: It is located outside of a larger defensive installation (for example: a fort) and is used to protect soldiers located outside of the main line of defence.

definicion: The degree of surface-level wind damage due to tornadic winds as specified by the damage-based Enhanced Fujita (EF) Tornado Scale.
descripcion: The categories are based upon 28 damage indicators consisting of types of buildings, structures, and trees common to tornado-prone regions. For each damage indicator, several degrees of damage are identified. Integration of degrees of damage across observed damage indicators results in an overall estimate of the highest wind speed that occurred during the life cycle of the tornado.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain category denoting an enhanced fujita tornado scale.

dominio.definicion: Estimated three-second gust (peak momentary) wind speed of 65-85 statute miles per hour.
dominio.observaciones: Individual damage indicators and their corresponding degree of damage (with photographs) in this gust wind speed range are specified in 'A Recommendation for an ENHANCED FUJITA SCALE (EF-Scale)', Wind Science and Engineering Center, Texas Tech University, June 2004.

dominio.definicion: Estimated three-second gust (peak momentary) wind speed of 86-110 statute miles per hour.
dominio.observaciones: Individual damage indicators and their corresponding degree of damage (with photographs) in this gust wind speed range are specified in 'A Recommendation for an ENHANCED FUJITA SCALE (EF-Scale)', Wind Science and Engineering Center, Texas Tech University, June 2004.

dominio.definicion: Estimated three-second gust (peak momentary) wind speed of 111-135 statute miles per hour.
dominio.observaciones: Individual damage indicators and their corresponding degree of damage (with photographs) in this gust wind speed range are specified in 'A Recommendation for an ENHANCED FUJITA SCALE (EF-Scale)', Wind Science and Engineering Center, Texas Tech University, June 2004.

dominio.definicion: Estimated three-second gust (peak momentary) wind speed of 136-165 statute miles per hour.
dominio.observaciones: Individual damage indicators and their corresponding degree of damage (with photographs) in this gust wind speed range are specified in 'A Recommendation for an ENHANCED FUJITA SCALE (EF-Scale)', Wind Science and Engineering Center, Texas Tech University, June 2004.

dominio.definicion: Estimated three-second gust (peak momentary) wind speed of 166-200 statute miles per hour.
dominio.observaciones: Individual damage indicators and their corresponding degree of damage (with photographs) in this gust wind speed range are specified in 'A Recommendation for an ENHANCED FUJITA SCALE (EF-Scale)', Wind Science and Engineering Center, Texas Tech University, June 2004.

dominio.definicion: Estimated three-second gust (peak momentary) wind speed exceeding 200 statute miles per hour.
dominio.observaciones: Individual damage indicators and their corresponding degree of damage (with photographs) in this gust wind speed range are specified in 'A Recommendation for an ENHANCED FUJITA SCALE (EF-Scale)', Wind Science and Engineering Center, Texas Tech University, June 2004.

definicion: The type of an identifier of an entity (for example: feature or event) instance based on its intended use and/or the data production system that assigns the value.
descripcion: The scope of uniqueness of the identifier may be limited to a dataset (for example: a map or chart sheet).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an entity identifier type.

dominio.definicion: The unique textual identifier of a feature instance as assigned by the NGA Geospatial Intelligence Database Integration (GIDI) process.

A numeric identifier used to relate a feature instance to additional information about that feature instance that may be presented along the margin (outside the neat line) of a map or chart sheet on which that feature instance is portrayed.
dominio.observaciones: The scope of uniqueness may only be within the map or chart sheet. An integer value usually starting with '1' and increasing until all relevant portrayed feature instances on the map or chart sheet have been uniquely identified.

dominio.definicion: The unique named feature identifier element in the NGA Geographic Names Data Base (GNDB).
dominio.observaciones: Typically used together with Attribute: 'Name Identifier' to provide a unique index into the NGA Geographic Names Data Base (GNDB) from which NGA draws all of its feature name information.

dominio.definicion: A numeric identifier of a feature instance.
dominio.observaciones: The scope of uniqueness is usually only within a dataset, but may be over a larger extent based on data production organisation policy and procedures.

dominio.definicion: The globally unique and persistent identifier of an entity (for example: feature or event) instance as specified by a Uniform Resource Name (URN) in accordance with the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) RFC2396 and RFC2141.
dominio.observaciones: It is based on the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI), a compact string of characters for identifying an abstract or physical resource. The term 'Uniform Resource Name' (URN) refers to the subset of URI that are required to remain globally unique and persistent even when the resource ceases to exist or becomes unavailable. The URN is drawn from one of a set of defined namespaces, each of which has its own set name structure and assignment procedures.

dominio.definicion: A unique identification code that identifies a feature that is a vertical obstruction to low-level flight.
dominio.observaciones: An eleven character code consisting of four blocks of information as follows: Positions 1-2, the FIPS 10-4 two-character Country Code; Positions 3-6, a World Aeronautical Chart (WAC) Identifier; Positions 7-10, a Unique Obstruction Identification consisting of a four-digit (0001-9999) number; Position 11, an alphanumeric Producer Code.

definicion: The means by which an entrance and/or exit is closed (for example: by a door, hatch, or cover).

datatype.nombre: Entrance and/or Exit Closure Method Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an entrance and/or exit closure method.

dominio.definicion: Hinged and swings open and closed either horizontally or vertically in one direction but not in the other (for example: outwards only).
Double hinged and swings open and closed in either the inwards or outwards direction.
Slides open and closed on rollers, tracks, or rails running parallel to the opening.
A set of horizontal panels that are linked (for example: hinged) together, hang from the top of the opening, and which ascend and descend from an overhead track.
dominio.observaciones: The track is normally located on the inward side of the opening.

definicion: An indication that an entrance and/or exit is shielded from direct observation and/or attack.
descripcion: The shielding may be provided by a suitably placed berm, revetment, or wall.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of an entrance and/or exit based on the type of feature to which access is accomplished and/or its structure.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an entrance and/or exit type.

dominio.definicion: The opening of a mine tunnel onto the terrain surface.
dominio.observaciones: The entry is generally located on the slope of a hill and the tunnel passes into the mine either horizontally or with a moderate slope such that the removal of minerals (for example: coal) may be facilitated by the construction of a small-gauge railway, roadway or conveyer into the mine.

dominio.definicion: An opening of reinforced shelter onto the terrain surface.
dominio.observaciones: The reinforcement may be accomplished by either underground burial (including mining) or by covering and/or surrounding with earth and/or other materials.

dominio.definicion: An opening of an underground room or vault onto the terrain surface.
dominio.observaciones: A cellar is usually located under a building or similar structure.

dominio.definicion: The opening of a mine shaft onto the terrain surface.
dominio.observaciones: On the surface above the mine shaft stands a superstructure (termed a 'pit-head' or 'pit-head frame'), which historically contained a winding engine and in modern times contains an electric hoist controller. This raises and lowers a cage within the shaft.

dominio.definicion: An opening of a tunnel into a larger space (for example: onto the terrain surface).
dominio.observaciones: A tunnel is usually open to the terrain surface at both ends, but may sometimes lead to an enclosed space, for example: leading to an underground bunker, into an underground mine (termed an 'adit') or into an underground railway station.

dominio.definicion: An opening of a cave into a larger space (for example: onto the terrain surface).
dominio.observaciones: A cave may consist of an interconnected series of subterranean chambers and often opens to the Earth's surface (either vertically or horizontally).

dominio.definicion: The opening or passage which a door serves to close or open.
dominio.observaciones: The opening may, for example, be to an enclosed space or through a wall.

dominio.definicion: Designated as an emergency exit in a structure (for example a tunnel).
A connection between tunnel tubes.
An access to an underground railway facility (for example: a metro station).

definicion: The primary type of environmental damage existing within an area.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an environmental damage type.

dominio.definicion: Environmental damage of marine and/or terrestrial ecosystems caused by oil tanker accidents.
Environmental damage caused by burning oil-drilling facilities (predominantly air pollution).
Predominantly treeless forest area resulting from fire.
Discharge of untreated waste water in high quantities causing environmental pollution.
Transgression of the limiting values for radiation protection regulations in case of breakdowns in a nuclear power plant.
Radioactive or radioactive-contaminated substances (especially gaseous or liquid) that can not be reprocessed and which have a lasting influence on the environment (also radioactive fall-out).
Deterioration of a forest by air pollution.
An intensive harmful disruption of the natural balance causing by deforestation.
Environment changes caused by mostly illegal disposal (land or sea) of substances polluted by heavy metals.
Pollution of water bodies caused by toxic substances and deoxygenation.
Area of low ozone concentration in the stratosphere.
Uncleared mine fields (for example: antipersonnel mine, antitank mine) within an area.
Unexploded ammunition within an area.
Environmental damage caused by storm or wind.
The natural removal of solids (sediment, soil, rock and other particles) in the natural environment.
dominio.observaciones: It usually occurs by the transport of wind, water and/or ice by down-slope creep of soil and other material under the force of gravity.

dominio.definicion: A general term covering a wide variety of mass-movement landforms and processes involving the downslope transport, under gravitational influence, of soil and rock material en masse.

definicion: The type of infectious disease currently prevalent in an area as an epidemic.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an epidemic type.

dominio.definicion: A disease of humans caused by Trypanosoma brucei and characterized by fever, mental and physical lethargy, almost always fatal.
dominio.observaciones: Endemic in tropical Africa and caused by parasite communicated by the Tsetse-fly.

dominio.definicion: A livestock epidemic caused by Trypanosoma brucei, occurring in Africa and communicated by the Tsetse-fly.
An infectious disease caused by Trypanosoma cruzi, affecting the nervous system, the heart and the intestine caused by pathogenic excrements of reduviids.
A fever due to a parasite communicated by the bite of mosquitoes.
An intensely infectious disease caused by the bacterium Yersinia pestis and communicated by rodent fleas.
A disease characterized by violent vomiting and purging, tending to run a rapidly fatal course.
An infectious fever characterized by an eruption of red spots on the chest and abdomen, severe intestinal irritations, inflammation, and diarrhea.
A modified form of typhoid fever usually caused by polluted food or drinking water.
dominio.observaciones: The clinical picture is similar to typhoid.

dominio.definicion: The splenic fever of sheep and cattle; malignant disease in man communicated by animals suffering from this.
A chronic disease, usually characterized by shining tubercles of various size, thickening of the skin, loss of feeling and necrosis of parts.
A contagious feverish disease, characterized by eruptions on the skin.
A disease of the liver, caused by trematoda, living in warm lakes, which enter through the skin.
An infectious tropical febrile disease seated in the large intestines, accompanied by mucous and bloody evacuations.
A disease of parrots communicable to man, with a high mortality.
An acute infectious disease, communicated by birds.
An inflammation of the grey matter of the spinal cord caused by the polio virus, resulting in asceptic meningitis and/or paralytic disease.
An infectious fever caused by bacteria in the genus Borrelia that is characterized by frequent relapses.
A parasitic epidemic disease among animals of unspecified etiology.
dominio.observaciones: If widespread, termed 'panzootic'.

dominio.definicion: A haemorrhagic fever caused by the ebola virus and with a high mortality probability.
A disease belonging to the group of haemorrhagic fevers causing internal haemorrhage.
A virus disease injuring or destroying cells of the immune system, usually with a fatal result.
A disease of the lungs caused by virus, communicated by animals or their meat.
A disease caused by virus, communicated by the excrements of infected birds.
A malignant tropical fever caused by the bite of mosquitoes, attended with jaundice and black vomit.
An infectious disease characterized by acute inflammation and the formation of a false membrane, chiefly on the pharynx, nostrils, tonsils, and palate.
An infectious fever disease, attended with haemorrhages usually caused by virus.

definicion: The denominator (for example: 50,000) of the map scale that best represents the density of feature collection within the geospatial extent of a specified region.

datatype.definicion: An integer domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is an integer. For example, 6 (as in the length of a fathom in feet).
datatype.nota: The realization of this integer datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: A dimensionless quantity (a quantity with the dimension of 1).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A dimensionless physical quantity, one which has no unit of measure.

definicion: The map scale that best represents the density of feature collection within the geospatial extent of a specified region, as a category.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an equivalent scale category.

dominio.definicion: A map scale of 1:5,000,000.
A map scale of 1:2,000,000.
A map scale of 1:1,000,000.
A map scale of 1:500,000.
A map scale of 1:250,000.
A map scale of 1:100,000.
A map scale of 1:50,000.
A map scale of 1:25,000.
A map scale of 1:12,500.
A map scale of 1:5,000.

definicion: The theoretical load which, if acting on a single tire, with a contact area equal to that of one tire of the assembly, will produce the same effect on the movement area as the multiple wheel assembly.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of the property of a body that causes it to have weight in a gravitational field.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of mass equal to 453.59237 kilograms.

definicion: The estimated overall cost of the disaster.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The monetary unit establishing a currency.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The unit of monetary exchange serving as legal tender in the United States, the dollar.

definicion: The estimated quantity of material the feature is producing over a period of time.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of mass, the property of a body that causes it to have weight in a gravitational field, per unit time.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of mass rate that is approximately 0.000031686 kilograms per second.

definicion: The estimated overall quantity of material the feature will deliver or produce until it will be closed or abandoned.
descripcion: For example the quantity of an oil field.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of the property of a body that causes it to have weight in a gravitational field.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of mass equal to one thousand kilograms.

definicion: The hierarchy of an ethnic group within an area.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an ethnic group hierarchy.

dominio.definicion: Ethnic groups that may meaningfully be combined on the basis of common cultural elements.
An ethnic group combined by descent and culture but not nationally organized.
dominio.observaciones: Characteristics of this ethnic group vary from an ethnic-biological to a political-cultural identity.

dominio.definicion: Temporary or permanent integration of several tribes.
dominio.observaciones: May be for military or religious purposes.

dominio.definicion: A homogeneous and, under political or social aspects, an autonomous ethnic group (usually managing its own territory) defined by linguistic and cultural characteristics.
dominio.observaciones: A tribe is a subunit of a people and combines ethnic groups of minor size.

dominio.definicion: Ethnic groups of different size defined by linguistic and cultural characteristics, but assignable to a tribe.
dominio.observaciones: A subunit of a tribe.

dominio.definicion: An ethnic group composed of one or several lineages having an evident solidarity, descending from a common ancestor but without a clearly defined parentage (genealogy).
A subunit of a clan.
Patri- or matrilinear kinfolk descending from a common ancestor in a precise definable genealogy and accepted as an autonomous entity by the society.
An ethnic group known by name but not definitely assignable to a hierarchy because of lack of information.

definicion: The type(s) of designated emergency evacuation routes which include the feature.
descripcion: Evacuation routes may include passages (for example: hallways, stairs and walkways) supporting egress from a structure and transportation routes (for example: roads) leading away from the site of the emergency.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain category denoting an evacuation route use.

dominio.definicion: The feature is a portion of a route designated for use during emergency evacuation in anticipation of flooding.
dominio.observaciones: Such routes lead to higher ground, often to temporary public facilities where evacuees may be housed until floodwaters recede.

dominio.definicion: The feature is a portion of a route designated for use during emergency evacuation either during a structure fire or in advance of an approaching wildland fire.
dominio.observaciones: In the case of structural fires such routes use stairwells for descent to ground level and typically terminate at a well-known location where efforts can be made to determine whether all potential occupants have safely exited the structure. Routes used to escape approaching wildland fires will vary based on topography, weather and fire-front conditions; in general they lead away from forested areas.

dominio.definicion: The feature is a portion of a route designated for use during emergency evacuation in advance of an approaching cyclonic storm that is predicted to make imminent landfall.
dominio.observaciones: For example, along the United States Gulf Coast, hurricane evacuation routes lead north for up to hundreds of miles to the safest major city; along the Atlantic Coast, routes lead west. Hurricane evacuation routes may be marked with distinctive blue signs that indicate the correct direction of use. During mass evacuations, all lanes of such routes may be used to flow north or west (as appropriate), a procedure known as contraflow (in the lanes that normally flow in the other direction).

dominio.definicion: The feature is a portion of a route designated for use during emergency evacuation in the event of an accident at a nuclear facility likely to result in release of radionuclides into the environment.
dominio.observaciones: In addition to leading away from the site of the nuclear facility, such routes often take into consideration the prevailing winds and attempt to avoid the potential downwind plume resulting from an atmospheric radionuclide release.

definicion: The date and, optionally, time of an event.
descripcion: The event to which the date applies must be determined in the context of the data content specification. Typically the Attribute: 'Event Type' is used to specify the nature of the event.

datatype.nombre: Event Date and Time Structured Text
datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying an event date and, optionally, time.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: Formatted in accordance with ISO 8601:2000, 5.4.1, Combinations of date and time of day - Complete representation - Extended format, a calendar date and time representation, as a single data element comprising up to twenty characters, where [YYYY] represents a calendar year, [MM] the ordinal number of a calendar month within the calendar year, [DD] the ordinal number of a day within the calendar month, [hh] the ordinal number of an hour within the calendar day, [mm] the ordinal number of a minute within the hour, [ss] the ordinal number of a second within the minute, and an optional 'Z' when the time is according to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), as 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ' (for example: '1985-04-12T11:45:20Z' for 11 hours, 45 minutes and 20 seconds UTC on 12 April 1985). Representations with reduced precision may be used in accordance with 5.4.2 (for example: '1985-04-12' for 12 April 1985). Representations consistently using basic format (eliminating the hyphen '-' and the colon ':') may be used in accordance with 5.4.1 (for example: '19850412T114520Z').

definicion: The local time of an event.

datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying an event local time.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of an event (for example: a report or an activity).
descripcion: The Attribute: 'Event Date' may be used to specify the date of the event.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an event type.

dominio.definicion: The digital representation of the feature was created.
The report was received that indicated the existence of the feature.
The source was created that was used to define the digital representation of the feature.

definicion: The type of an extraction mine.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an extraction mine type.

dominio.definicion: An excavation of soil for the sole purpose of fill material such as road and/or dam construction or for backfill material.
A method of mining by removing surface layers and working from above, rather than from shafts.
The mining of minerals from placer or alluvial deposits using water pressure (hydraulic mining) and/or surface excavating equipment.
dominio.observaciones: A placer is a deposit of sand, gravel, or earth, often located adjacent to a stream, containing particles of gold or other valuable minerals (for example: platinum, tin, diamond, ruby, and other gems).

dominio.definicion: A surface mine from which easily accessible deposits are removed without the removal of overburden or the use of shafts.
The surface material is removed in successive parallel strips to expose the mineral, the spoil from each new strip being placed in the previously excavated one.
dominio.observaciones: They are used in generally flat terrain and are commenced with a trench or 'box cut' made through the overburden to expose a portion of the mineral seam. This trench is extended, in a series of cuts 30 to 60 metres wide, to the limits of the property in the strike direction. After mineral removal, a second cut is made parallel to the first one, and the overburden material from this cut is placed in the void of the first cut. The process is repeated in successive parallel cuts until the stripping ratio indicates that continued surface mining is uneconomical.

dominio.definicion: A place in a bog or fen from which peats are cut.
A mine reached by shafts bored from the surface.
dominio.observaciones: The shafts may be at any slope, including both vertical and horizontal.

dominio.definicion: An open-air excavation for the extraction of stone intended principally for use in construction.
The surface material is removed in a strip along the side of a hill to expose the mineral.
dominio.observaciones: They are used where a mineral seam outcrops in rolling or hilly terrain. The method consists of removing the overburden above the mineral seam and then, starting at the outcrop and proceeding along the hillside, creating a bench around the hill. In the past, the blasted overburden spoil was simply shoved down the hill; currently, soil is either carried down the mountain to fill a chosen valley in horizontal layers or is replaced on the working bench itself in places where the mineral has been removed. If the break-even stripping ratio remains favourable, further cuts into the hillside will be made. Otherwise, if there are sufficient reserves under the knob of the hill, the mineral may be recovered by underground mining or by augering.

Characterized by large heavy steel frame buildings and may utilize large cranes for heavy lifting.

definicion: The status of operation of a man-made structure, as a whole.
descripcion: Includes actual operations, operational capability, and planned or proposed man-made structures.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a facility operational status.

dominio.definicion: Operating without interruption.
Operations are intended to be continuous but may be interrupted on a scheduled basis.
Operations are not intended to be continuous but are intended to occur (or, equivalently, be interrupted) on a scheduled basis.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the hours of operation of a business may be governed by a timetable.

dominio.definicion: Not in operation due to it being non-functional and operation is not scheduled to be restored.
Operational, but intended to be replaced or discontinued.
Future operations are scheduled.
Operations have been abandoned, but may be resumed in the future.
Fully functional and ready for operation however has not been certified or commissioned for such use.
dominio.observaciones: The operational capacity may not be authorized for various reasons, such as newly installed and not yet commissioned or certified, or operational but has been taken out of service for non-technical reasons, awaiting certification or commissioning status.

dominio.definicion: Temporarily not in operation due to it being non-functional and operation is scheduled to be restored.
dominio.observaciones: Usually an unscheduled loss of operation.

dominio.definicion: Operations are occasional, in response to requests from authorized users.
Operations may occur sporadically.
Operations have been abandoned and will not be able to be resumed in the future (for example: due to destruction or dismantling of the facility).
Fully capable of operation.
dominio.observaciones: The schedule of operations may be indeterminate or unknown.

dominio.definicion: Functional, but operating with only partial capability for some reason.
dominio.observaciones: Parts of the man-made structure are not in operation; or, the operation is running below capacity.

definicion: The classification of a soil based on its properties as defined by the UN Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and based on the nature of diagnostic horizons, properties and materials.
descripcion: The number of reference soil groups is fixed at 32.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an FAO soil group.

dominio.definicion: Soils with a clay-enriched subsoil. Acrisols have low base status and low-activity clay.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'AC'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with a clay-enriched subsoil. Albeluvisols are characterized by showing albeluvic tonguing (a bleached horizon penetrating into a clay-rich subsurface horizon).
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'AB'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with a clay-enriched subsoil. Alisols have low base status and high-activity clay.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'AL'.

dominio.definicion: Young soils from volcanic deposits. Soil sets by Fe/Al chemistry. Soils developed in volcanic material, mainly volcanic ash, with high glass content. These soils has an intense dark colour and high content in organic matter.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'AN'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with strong human influence, showing long and intensive agricultural use. Mineral soils conditioned by man (modified through cultivation and addition of material).
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'AT'.

dominio.definicion: Sandy soils. They are relative young soils or soils with little or no profile development. Sandy soils developed in situ after weathering of old, usually quarz-rich soil material or rock, and soils developed in recently deposited sands as occur in deserts.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'AR'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with accumulation of secondary calcium carbonates.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'CL'.

dominio.definicion: Moderately developed soils. Cambisols are relative young soils or soils with little or no profile development.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'CM'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with a humus-rich (dark) topsoil and a calcareous subsoil.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'CH'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with limited rooting due to shallow permafrost.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'CR'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with accumulation of secondary silica.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'DU'.

dominio.definicion: Soils in which Fe an Al chemistry plays a major role in their formation. Ferrasols are rich in Kaolinit and sesquioxides and are deep and strongly weathered.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'FR'.

dominio.definicion: Soils influenced by water. Fluvisols are located in floodplains and tidal marshes.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'FL'.

dominio.definicion: Soils strongly influenced by ground-water.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'GL'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with accumulation of secondary gypsum.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'GY'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with thick organic layers. Comprise soils formed in organic soil material. They are confined to poorly drained basins, depressions, swamps and marshlands with shallow ground-water. Histosols occur extensively in boreal, artic and subartic regions.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'HS'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with a humus-rich (dark brown) topsoil and a high base saturation (calcareous or gypsum-rich subsoil).
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'KS'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with limited rooting due to shallow or extremely gravely soils. Leptosols include the Lithosols of the Soil Map of the World (FAO-UNESCO, 1971-1981).
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'LP'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with clay-enriched subsoil. Lixisols have high base status and low-activity clay.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'LX'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with clay-enriched subsoil. Luvisols have high base status and high-activity clay.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'LV'.

dominio.definicion: Soils in which Fe an Al chemistry plays a major role in their formation (deep, dark red, brown or yellow). Nitisols are characterized by low-activity clay, phosphorus fixation and are strongly structured (nut-shaped).
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'NT'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with a humus-rich (dark) topsoil and a high base saturation. They show evidence of removal of carbonates.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'PH'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with stagnating water. Planosols shows a abrupt textural discontinuity (increase in clay content).
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'PL'.

dominio.definicion: Soils in which Fe an Al chemistry plays a major role in their formation. Plinthosols shows an accumulation of Fe under hydromorphic conditions.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'PT'.

dominio.definicion: Soils in which Fe and Al chemistry plays a major role in their formation. Podzols are acid soils with a subsurface accumulation of iron-aluminum-organic compounds.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'PZ'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with no significant profile development.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'RG'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with strong salt enrichment upon evaporation.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'SC'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with subsurface clay accumulation, rich in sodium. Alkaline soils. .
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'SN'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with an acidic dark (rich in organic matter) topsoils. Umbisols are relative young soils or soils with little or no profile development. These soils are classified in other systems as Humic Cambisols and Umbric Regosols (FAO).
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'UM'.

dominio.definicion: Soils influenced by water, rich in swelling clays. Alternating wet-dry conditions cause cracking and wedge-shape structural elements in the subsurface soil.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'VR'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with stagnating water. Stagnosols shows a structural or moderate textural discontinuity. A common name for this soil is also pseudogley.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'ST'.

dominio.definicion: Soils with strong human influence, containing many artefacts.
dominio.observaciones: Code: 'TC'.

definicion: The agricultural practice(s) in use within an agro-ecosystem.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a farming method.

dominio.definicion: Farming in which crops alternating with soil replenishment vegetation types are grown on the same land in successive years or seasons.
dominio.observaciones: Soil replenishment and pest and disease abatement are accomplished without recourse to fertilizers and pest control agents.

dominio.definicion: Farming to support the feeding of livestock on low grass or vegetation on pastures and ranges.
Farming in which the fields are continuously used for cultivation.
dominio.observaciones: Continuous cultivation usually depends on the application of fertilizers and pest control agents.

dominio.definicion: Farming based on the technique where forested and highly vegetated areas will be cut months before a dry season, typically by hand, and then burned with the resulting ash serving to temporarily fertilize the underlying soil.
dominio.observaciones: It is an agricultural method for subsistence farming in third-world areas and typically within grasslands and rainforest. It is also known variously as 'shifting cultivation', 'swidden-fallow agriculture', or 'jhoom cultivation' (in India, Pakistan, other areas of Southern Asia). There is no attempt to fertilize or otherwise replenish the soil. When the soil nutrients are exhausted, the cleared land is abandoned - left fallow to sometimes regenerate by the growth of native species, but more often left exposed to damage and loss through erosion.

definicion: The general arrangement(s) and/or pattern(s) of farming fields.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a farming pattern.

dominio.definicion: The fields are laid out in a linear arrangement.
dominio.observaciones: For example, long and narrow with the crop rows aligned along the longer dimension.

dominio.definicion: The fields are laid out in a specific and uniform arrangement.
dominio.observaciones: For example, of roughly equal size and shape as on a draughtboard.

dominio.definicion: The fields are on a slope that has been divided and formed into successive plateaus by long, low ridges of soil extending across the slope.
dominio.observaciones: May have associated flat or graded channels to control the runoff of water.

dominio.definicion: The fields are intermingled with scattered woods and/or rows of trees.
The fields include scattered trees and/or are bordered by rows of trees, but there are no areas of woods.
The fields have no trees in and/or among them.
Provided with one or more lattice frameworks of light bars (for example: wooden or metal) used as a support for crops (for example: fruit trees or vines).
The fields have no regular arrangement and/or pattern.

definicion: The type of multiplicity and/or configuration of a feature.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a feature configuration.

dominio.definicion: Consists of multiple components that are spatially dispersed.
Divided into multiple components that have the same width.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a divided highway.

dominio.definicion: Divided into multiple components that have different widths.
Not divided into distinct, spatially separated components.

definicion: The number of features of the same type within a defined region.
descripcion: May be used to indicate the number of features actually present in near proximity to each other although only one representative feature is collected. For example, the number of adjacent pipelines.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The angular distance measured from true north (0 degrees) clockwise to the predominant linear pattern of the elements within a feature.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value that is restricted to be completely contained in the range from 0 to 360, inclusive.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

definicion: The purpose(s) of, or intended role(s) served by, the feature.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a feature function.

dominio.definicion: The production of crops and/or animals.
The growing of all crops (for example: wheat, rice or tomatoes), except aquatic crops.
dominio.observaciones: Includes the growing of both non-perennial crops (plants that do not last for more than two growing seasons; for example: cereals, vegetables, or tobacco) and perennial crops, (plants that lasts for more than two growing seasons, either dying back after each season or growing continuously; for example: grapes, citrus fruits, or nuts).

dominio.definicion: The raising and breeding of all animals (for example: cattle, sheep, or pigs), except aquatic animals.
The regular consumption of part of one organism (for example: grass) by another organism (for example: livestock) without killing it.
dominio.observaciones: Animal grazing areas are usually dominated by grasses (for example: prairies, savannas and steppes), and common grazing herbivores include: antelope, bison, buffalo, cattle, elephants, goats, horses, rabbits, and sheep.

dominio.definicion: The combined production of crops and animals without a specialized production of either crops or animals.
dominio.observaciones: The size of the overall farming operation is not a determining factor. If either production of crops or animals exceeds 66 per cent or more of the overall economic value of the activity, the combined activity should not be included here, but allocated to crop or animal farming.

dominio.definicion: Labour provided by economic migrants that is generally unskilled and is used, for example, to harvest crops.
dominio.observaciones: The migrants generally move their residence throughout the year, following the seasonal demands for agricultural labour as different crops become ready for harvest. They may be either legally or illegally present in the host country.

dominio.definicion: The preparation of agricultural products for shipment by baling.
Pursuing animals to capture or kill them for food, blood sport, or trade in their products.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: hunting and trapping on a commercial basis; taking of animals (dead or alive) for food, fur, skin, or for use in research, in zoos or as pets; production of fur skins, reptile or bird skins from hunting or trapping activities; and land-based catching of sea mammals such as walrus and seal.

dominio.definicion: The production of roundwood for the forest-based manufacturing industries as well as the extraction and gathering of wild growing non-wood forest products.
dominio.observaciones: Besides the production of timber, forestry activities result in products that undergo little processing, such as firewood, charcoal, wood chips and roundwood used in an unprocessed form (for example: as mine pit-props or for pulpwood). These activities can be carried out in natural or planted forests.

dominio.definicion: Controlling the establishment, growth, composition, health, and quality of forests to meet diverse needs and values of landowners and society on a sustainable basis.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: growing of standing timber (for example: planting, replanting, transplanting, thinning and conserving of forests and timber tracts); growing of coppice, pulpwood and fire wood; and operation of forest tree nurseries. These activities can be carried out in natural or planted forests.

dominio.definicion: Manages and protects (for example: against fire) an area of forest and/or other natural region.

Hunting, collecting and gathering activities directed at removing or collecting live wild aquatic organisms (predominantly fish, molluscs and crustaceans) including plants from the oceanic, coastal or inland waters for human consumption and other purposes by hand or more usually by various types of fishing gear such as nets, lines and stationary traps.
dominio.observaciones: Such activities can be conducted on the intertidal shoreline (for example: collection of molluscs such as mussels and oysters) or shore based netting, or from home-made dugouts or more commonly using commercially made boats in inshore, coastal waters or offshore waters. The aquatic resource being captured is usually common property resource irrespective of whether the harvest from this resource is undertaken with or without exploitation rights. Such activities also include fishing restocked water bodies.

dominio.definicion: The production process involving the culturing or farming (including harvesting) of aquatic organisms (for example: fish, molluscs, crustaceans, plants, crocodiles, alligators or amphibians) using techniques designed to increase the production of the organisms in question beyond the natural capacity of the environment (for example: regular stocking, feeding and protection from predators).
dominio.observaciones: Culturing or farming refers to the rearing of individuals up to their juvenile and/or adult phase under captive conditions. In addition, it also encompasses individual, corporate or state ownership of the individual organisms throughout the rearing or culture stage, up to and including harvesting.

dominio.definicion: The extraction of minerals occurring naturally as solids (coal and ores), liquids (petroleum) or gases (natural gas).
dominio.observaciones: Extraction can be achieved by different methods (for example: underground or surface mining, well operation, or seabed mining). Includes supplementary activities aimed at preparing the crude materials for marketing (for example: crushing, grinding, cleaning, drying, sorting, concentrating ores, liquefaction of natural gas and agglomeration of solid fuels. These operations are often accomplished at or near the location where the resource is extracted.

dominio.definicion: The extraction of solid mineral fuels (for example: coal or lignite) includes underground or open-cast mining and includes operations (for example: grading, cleaning, compressing and other steps necessary for transportation) leading to a marketable product.
The production of crude petroleum, the mining and extraction of oil from oil shale and oil sands and the production of natural gas and recovery of hydrocarbon liquids.
dominio.observaciones: Includes the activities of operating and/or developing oil and gas field properties, for example: drilling, completing and equipping wells; operating separators, emulsion breakers, desilting equipment and field gathering lines for crude petroleum; and all other activities in the preparation of oil and gas up to the point of shipment from the producing property. Also includes the production of oil, the mining and extraction of oil from oil shale and oil sands and the production of gas and hydrocarbon liquids, through gasification, liquefaction and pyrolysis of coal at the mine site.

dominio.definicion: The mining of metallic minerals (for example: iron, uranium, aluminum, copper, or nickel ore).
dominio.observaciones: Different methods may be employed (for example: underground or open-cast extraction or seabed mining) and ore dressing and beneficiating operations may be required (for example: crushing, grinding, washing, drying, sintering, calcining or leaching ore, gravity separation or flotation operations).

dominio.definicion: The extraction from a mine or quarry or dredging from alluvial deposits of products used in construction (for example: sand or stone) or the manufacture of materials (for example: clay or gypsum).
dominio.observaciones: Processes used in the extraction of construction products include: quarrying, rough trimming and sawing of monumental and building stone such as marble, granite, or sandstone; quarrying, crushing and breaking of limestone; extraction and dredging of industrial sand, sand for construction and gravel; breaking and crushing of stone and gravel; and the quarrying of sand. Products used in the manufacture of materials include: gypsum and anhydrite; chalk and uncalcined dolomite; and clays, refractory clays and kaolin.

dominio.definicion: The mining and quarrying of chemicals (for example: potassium salts or native sulphur) or mineral fertilizers (for example: guano).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: mining of natural phosphates and natural potassium salts; mining of native sulphur; extraction and preparation of pyrites and pyrrhotite, except roasting; mining of natural barium sulphate and carbonate (barytes and witherite), natural borates, natural magnesium sulphates (kieserite); mining of earth colours, fluorspar and other minerals valued chiefly as a source of chemicals; and guano mining.

dominio.definicion: The digging and/or agglomeration of peat.
The extraction of salt from underground (for example: by mining or by dissolving and pumping) or by evaporation of sea water or other saline waters.
dominio.observaciones: Includes crushing, purification and refining of salt by the producer.

dominio.definicion: The mining and quarrying of various materials (for example: abrasive materials, asbestos, siliceous fossil meals, natural graphite, steatite (talc), and feldspar) and minerals (for example: gemstones, quartz, or mica) other than those used in construction (for example: sand or stone), the manufacture of materials (for example: clay or gypsum), or the manufacture of chemicals (for example: potassium salts or native sulphur) or mineral fertilizer (for example: guano), or solid mineral fuels (for example: coal, petroleum).
The separation of natural gas from crude oil through the extraction of condensates or the draining and separation of liquid hydrocarbon fractions.
The drilling of boreholes in the search for extractable mineral resources (for example: crude petroleum or natural gas) and/or subsequent exploitation of those resources.

The preparation or concentration of ore by treatment or cleaning to concentrate its valuable constituents (minerals) into products (concentrate) of smaller bulk, and simultaneously to collect the worthless material (termed 'gangue') into discardable waste (termed 'tailing').
dominio.observaciones: The fundamental operations of ore-dressing processes are the breaking apart of the associated constituents of the ore by mechanical means (termed 'severance') and the separation of the severed components (termed 'beneficiation') into concentrate and tailing, using mechanical or physical methods which do not result in substantial chemical changes.

dominio.definicion: The physical or chemical transformation of materials, substances, or components into new products.
dominio.observaciones: The materials, substances, or components transformed are raw materials that are products of agriculture, forestry, fishing, mining or quarrying as well as products of other manufacturing activities. Substantial alteration, renovation or reconstruction of goods is generally considered to be manufacturing.

dominio.definicion: The processing of the products of agriculture, forestry and fishing into food for humans or animals, including the production of various intermediate products and byproducts that are not directly food products.
dominio.observaciones: Food products may be of greater or lesser value (for example: hides from slaughtering, or oilcake from oil production).

dominio.definicion: The processing and preserving of foodstuffs (meat, seafood, fruit and vegetables).
The processing and preserving of meat (for example: carcasses, smoked cuts, or sausages) and meat by-products (for example: fats, feathers, or hides).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: operation of slaughterhouses engaged in killing, dressing or packing meat (for example: beef, pork, poultry, lamb, rabbit, mutton, or camel); production of fresh, chilled or frozen meat, in carcasses, cuts or individual portions; production of dried, salted or smoked meat; and the production of meat products (for example: sausages, salami, puddings, 'andouillettes', saveloys, bolognas, pates, rillettes, and boiled ham). It also includes, for example, the related activities of: slaughtering and processing of whales on land or on specialized vessels; production of hides and skins originating from slaughterhouses, including fellmongery; rendering of lard and other edible fats of animal origin; processing of animal offal; production of pulled wool; and the production of feathers and down.

dominio.definicion: The processing and preserving of fish (for example: herring or salmon), crustaceans (for example: lobster or shrimp) and molluscs (for example: clams or oysters).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: preparation and preservation (for example: by freezing, deep-freezing, drying, smoking, salting, immersing in brine, or canning); production of fish, crustacean and mollusc products (for example: cooked fish, fish fillets, roes, caviar, or caviar substitutes); production of fishmeal for human consumption or animal feed; and the production of meals and solubles from fish and other aquatic animals unfit for human consumption. It also includes, for example, the related activities of: activities of vessels engaged only in the processing and preserving of fish, and the processing of seaweed.

dominio.definicion: The processing and preserving of fruit (for example: apples or oranges) and vegetables (for example: beans, maize, or potatos).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: manufacture of food consisting chiefly of fruit or vegetables (except ready-made dishes in frozen or canned form); preserving of fruit, nuts or vegetables (for example: by freezing, drying, immersing in oil or in vinegar, or canning); manufacture of fruit or vegetable food products or juices; manufacture of jams, marmalades and table jellies; processing and preserving of potatos (for example: prepared frozen potatos, dehydrated mashed potatos, potato snacks, potato crisps, or potato flour and meal); roasting of nuts; and the manufacture of nut foods and pastes. It also includes, for example, the related activities of: production of concentrates from fresh fruits and vegetables; industrial peeling of potatoes; and the manufacture of perishable prepared foods of fruit and vegetables (for example: salads, peeled or cut vegetables, or tofu).

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of crude and refined oils (for example: olive oil, soya-bean oil, or palm oil) and fats (for example: margarine) from vegetable or animal materials.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: manufacture of crude or refined vegetable oils (for example: olive oil, soya-bean oil, palm oil, sunflower-seed oil, cotton-seed oil, rape, colza or mustard oil, or linseed oil); manufacture of non-defatted flour or meal of oilseeds, oil nuts or oil kernels; processing of vegetable oils (for example: blowing, boiling, dehydration, or hydrogenation); manufacture of margarine, melanges and similar spreads; and the manufacture of compound cooking fats. It also includes, for example, the related activities of: manufacture of non-edible animal oils and fats; extraction of fish and marine mammal oils; and the production of cotton linters, oilcakes and other residual products of oil production.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of dairy products (for example: milk, butter, cheese, or ice cream).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example, the manufacture of: fresh liquid milk (pasteurized, sterilized, homogenized and/or ultra heat treated); milk-based drinks; cream from fresh liquid milk (pasteurized, sterilized, homogenized); dried or concentrated milk whether or not sweetened; milk or cream in solid form; butter; yoghurt; cheese and curd; whey; casein or lactose; and ice cream and other edible ices such as sorbet.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of grain mill products (for example: meal, polished rice, flour mix or cereal breakfast foods).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: grain milling (the production of flour, groats, meal or pellets of wheat, rye, oats, maize or other cereal grains); rice milling (the production of husked, milled, polished, glazed, parboiled or converted rice, or rice flour); vegetable milling (production of flour or meal of dried leguminous vegetables, of roots or tubers, or of edible nuts); manufacture of flour mixes and prepared blended flour and dough for bread, cakes, biscuits or pancakes; and the manufacture of cereal breakfast foods.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of fresh, frozen or dry bakery products (for example: bread, pies, crackers or pancakes).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example, the manufacture of: bread and rolls; fresh pastry, cakes, pies, and tarts; rusks, biscuits and other 'dry' bakery products; preserved pastry goods and cakes; snack products (for example: cookies, crackers, or pretzels), whether sweet or salted; tortillas; and frozen bakery products (for example: pancakes, waffles, or rolls).

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of sugar in various forms (for example: granulated or syrup).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: manufacture or refining of sugar (sucrose) and sugar substitutes from the juice of cane, beet, maple and palm; manufacture of sugar syrups and molasses; and the production of maple syrup and maple sugar.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of raw sugar from sugar cane.
dominio.observaciones: The sugar cane stalks are washed, then chopped and shredded, then repeatedly mixed with water and crushed between rollers; the collected juices contain 10 to 15 percent sucrose. The remaining fibrous solids and termed 'bagasse' and are often burnt for fuel. Filtering, pH adjustment, clarification, evaporation and crystallization result in raw sugar that is yellow to brown in color.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of refined sugar from raw sugar.
dominio.observaciones: The raw sugar is mixed with heavy syrup, centrifuged, separated, dissolved, treated, filtered, concentrated to supersaturation and then repeatedly crystallized under vacuum to produce white refined sugar. To produce granulated sugar in which the individual sugar grains do not clump together, the refined sugar must be completely dried. This is accomplished first by drying the sugar in a hot rotary dryer, and then by conditioning the sugar by blowing cool air through it for several days.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of cocoa, chocolate and sugar confectionery (for example: caramels or chewing gum).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example, the manufacture of: cocoa, cocoa butter, cocoa fat, and cocoa oil; chocolate and chocolate confectionery; sugar confectionery (for example: caramels, cachous, nougats, fondant, or white chocolate); chewing gum; and confectionery lozenges and pastilles. It also includes the preserving in sugar of fruit, nuts, fruit peels and other parts of plants.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of farinaceous products (for example: macaroni, noodles, or couscous).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example, the manufacture of: pastas such as macaroni and noodles, whether or not cooked or stuffed; couscous; and canned or frozen pasta products.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of ready-made (for example: prepared, seasoned and cooked) meals and dishes, in frozen or canned form.
dominio.observaciones: These dishes are usually packaged and labeled for re-sale. They include, for example: fresh or frozen meat or poultry dishes; canned stews and vacuum-prepared meals; other prepared meals (for example: 'TV dinners'); frozen fish dishes, including fish and chips; prepared dishes of vegetables; and frozen pizza.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of prepared animal feeds.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: prepared feeds for pets (for example: dogs, cats, birds, or fish); prepared feeds for farm animals, including animal feed concentrated and feed supplements; preparation of unmixed (single) feeds for farm animals; and the treatment of slaughter waste to produce animal feeds.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of water ice (for example: block ice (including sculptured ice), and packaged crushed, cubed, and shaved ice) and dry ice (frozen carbon dioxide).
dominio.observaciones: Ice manufacturers are often also involved in its wholesale distribution.

dominio.definicion: The distilling, rectifying and blending of spirits (for example: brandy, gin or whiskey) for human consumption.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: manufacture of distilled, potable, alcoholic beverages (for example: whisky, brandy, gin, liqueurs, or 'mixed drinks'); blending of distilled spirits; and the production of neutral spirits.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of wine and related fermented products.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example, the manufacture of: wine; sparkling wine; wine from concentrated grape must; fermented but not distilled alcoholic beverages (for example: sake, cider, perry, mead, other fruit wines and mixed beverages containing alcohol); vermouth and similer flavoured wines. It also includes the blending of wine and the manufacture of low or non-alcoholic wine.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of malt liquors (for example: beer or ale), malt, and related malt products.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example, the manufacture of malt liquors (for example: beer, ale, porter or stout) and malt. It also includes the manufacture of low alcohol or non-alcoholic beer.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of soft drinks and the production of natural mineral waters and other bottled waters.
dominio.observaciones: Includes the manufacture of various non-alcoholic beverages (excepting non-alcoholic beer and wine) and non-alcoholic flavoured and/or sweetened waters; for example: lemonade, orangeade, cola, fruit drinks, or tonic waters.

dominio.definicion: The processing of an agricultural product, tobacco, into a form suitable for final consumption.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example, the manufacture of tobacco products and products of tobacco substitutes (for example: cigarettes, cigarette tobacco, cigars, pipe tobacco, chewing tobacco, or snuff) as well as the manufacture of 'homogenized' or 'reconstituted' tobacco. It also inclused the process of stemming and redrying of tobacco.

dominio.definicion: The preparation and spinning of textile fibres as well as textile weaving, finishing of textiles, and the manufacture of made-up textile articles (for example: household linen, blankets, rugs, or cordage) except wearing apparel.

The tailoring (ready-to-wear or made-to-measure) in all materials (for example: leather, fabric, or knitted and crocheted fabrics) of all items of clothing (for example: outerwear or underwear; for men, women or children; for work, city or casual use) and accessories.
dominio.observaciones: The material used may be coated, impregnated or rubberized. Also included are headgear of fur skins.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of articles made of fur skins.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: fur wearing apparel and clothing accessories; assemblies of fur skins (for example: 'dropped' fur skins, plates, mats, or strips; and diverse articles of fur skins (for example: rugs, unstuffed pouffes, and industrial polishing cloths).

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of footwear for all purposes, of any material, by any process, including moulding.
dominio.observaciones: Also includes the manufacture of leather parts of footwear (for example: manufacture of uppers and parts of uppers, outer and inner soles, or heels) as well as the manufacture of gaiters, leggings and similar articles.

dominio.definicion: The sawmilling and planing of wood and related processes (for example: drying or preservative treatment) and products (for example: railway sleepers or flooring).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: sawing, planing and machining of wood; slicing, peeling or chipping logs; manufacture of wooden railway sleepers; manufacture of unassembled wooden flooring; and manufacture of wood wool, wood flour, chips, and particles. It also includes the processes of drying of wood and impregnation or chemical treatment of wood with preservatives or other materials.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of wooden goods intended to be used primarily in the construction industry.
