dominio.observaciones: Assistance includes, for example: the identification of chemical, biological, radiological, or nuclear substances; assessment of the incident situation; and advising the civilian incident commander on potential courses of action.

dominio.definicion: The administration and operation of administrative, civil and criminal law courts, military tribunals and the judicial system, including legal representation and advice on behalf of the government or when provided by the government in cash or services.
dominio.observaciones: May also include the rendering of judgments and interpretations of the law, and the arbitration of civil actions.

dominio.definicion: The administration and operation of regular and auxiliary police forces involved in the prevention, investigation, apprehension, or detention of individuals suspected or convicted of offenses against the criminal laws.
dominio.observaciones: May include auxiliary duties (for example: traffic regulation, alien registration, or maintenance of arrest records).

dominio.definicion: The regulation of the movement of people between States.
dominio.observaciones: Accomplished at a physical checkpoint located at an international boundary or port.

dominio.definicion: To keep prisoners in a place of confinement.
dominio.observaciones: May occur for either civil or criminal misconduct, and may be used to temporarily detain suspects awaiting trial.

dominio.definicion: The discipline, reformation, and training of young offenders.
dominio.observaciones: May involve minimizing the use of penal care (for example: a prison specializing in youthful offenders) and maximizing of the use of less-restrictive settings which allow the youths to remain either in their own homes or in 'halfway houses' offering structured custodial care, usually while attending a special school during the daytime.

dominio.definicion: The administration and operation of regular and auxiliary fire brigades in fire prevention and firefighting.
dominio.observaciones: May also include assistance in non-fire emergencies (for example: civic disasters, floods, or road accidents).

dominio.definicion: The administration and operation of specially trained rescue and paramedical personnel qualified to extract individuals from life-threatening situations and to administer emergency medical treatment.

The coordination of information and resources to support incident management actions taken during an emergency period to protect life and property, care for the people affected, and temporarily restore essential community services.
dominio.observaciones: Emergency operations may be managed at a temporary facility or may be located in a more central or permanently established facility, perhaps at a higher level of organization within a jurisdiction. Emergency operations may be organized by major functional disciplines (for example: fire, law enforcement, and medical services), by jurisdiction (for example: national, subnational, regional, local), or some combination thereof.

dominio.definicion: The performance of the integration of relevant law enforcement and intelligence information, analysis of its implications for civil safety and security, and the coordination of security measures in order to reduce threats in local communities.
dominio.observaciones: Analysts from the national government may work side-by-side with subnational and local authorities at 'fusion centers' located at regional sites, facilitating the two-way flow of timely, accurate, actionable information on all types of hazards. Such operations provide critical sources of unique law enforcement and threat information, facilitate sharing information across jurisdictions and function, and provide a conduit between individuals on the ground protecting their local communities and appropriate subnational and national agencies.

dominio.definicion: Education at any level or for any profession, oral or written as well as by radio and television or other means of communication.
dominio.observaciones: It includes education by the different institutions in the regular school system at its different levels as well as adult education and literacy programmes.Also included are military schools and academies, as well as prison schools, at their respective levels.

dominio.definicion: The provision of academic courses and associated course work that give students a sound basic education in reading, writing and mathematics and an elementary understanding of other subjects such as history, geography, natural science, social science, art and music.
dominio.observaciones: Such education is generally provided for children, however the provision of literacy programmes within or outside the school system, which are similar in content to programmes in primary education but are intended for those considered too old to enter elementary schools, is also included.Also included is the provision of programmes at a similar level, suited to children with special needs education.Education can be provided in classrooms or through radio, television broadcast, Internet or correspondence.

dominio.definicion: The provision of the type of education that lays the foundation for lifelong learning and human development and is capable of furthering education opportunities.
dominio.observaciones: Often corresponds to the period of compulsory school attendance.Such schools provide programmes that are usually on a more subject-oriented pattern using more specialized teachers, and more often employ several teachers conducting classes in their field of specialization.Education can be provided in classrooms or through radio, television broadcast, Internet or correspondence.

dominio.definicion: The provision of academic courses and granting of degrees at baccalaureate or graduate levels.
dominio.observaciones: The requirement for admission is at least a high school diploma or equivalent general academic training.Instruction may be provided in diverse settings, such as educational institutions, the workplace, or the home, and through correspondence, television, Internet, or other means.

dominio.definicion: The provision of courses and course work that prepares students for jobs that are based in manual or practical activities, traditionally non-academic and related to a specific trade, occupation or vocation in which the learner participates.
dominio.observaciones: It is sometimes referred to as technical education, as the learner directly develops expertise in a particular group of techniques or technology.

dominio.definicion: Houses or supports the activities of a permanent organizational body created for a social purpose (for example: charity) and/or to serve the general social welfare (for example: accommodation, health care or education).

The activities of human health institutions (for example: short- or long-term hospitals; general or specialty medical, surgical, psychiatric and substance abuse hospitals; sanatoria; preventoria; medical nursing homes; asylums; mental hospital institutions; rehabilitation centres; or leprosaria) which engage in providing diagnostic and medical treatment with any of a wide variety of medical conditions.
dominio.observaciones: The facilities may include accommodation or be limited to the provision of out-patient care.These activities also include medical consultation and treatment in the field of general and specialized medicine by general practitioners and medical specialists and surgeons, dental practice activities of a general or specialized nature and orthodontic activities, and activities for human health not performed by hospitals or by practicing medical doctors but by paramedical practitioners legally recognized to treat patients.

dominio.definicion: Provides medical or surgical treatment for the ill or wounded on an in-patient basis (for example: at a hospital).
dominio.observaciones: The patient stays one or more nights at the facility.In the case of non-surgical treatment a skilled nursing facility may be employed.

dominio.definicion: Provides medical or surgical treatment for the ill or wounded on an out-patient basis (for example: at a clinic).
dominio.observaciones: The patient returns home following treatment without an overnight stay at the facility.May be provided in an individual physicians' office or in a clinic setting.

dominio.definicion: The provision of ambulatory medical care outside of a hospital emergency department on a walk-in basis without a scheduled appointment.
dominio.observaciones: Urgent medical care activities treat many problems that can be seen in a primary care physician's office, but include some services that are generally not available in primary care physician offices, for example, X-Ray facilities allow for treatment of minor fractures and foreign bodies, and minor trauma rooms allow for repair of minor and moderate-severity lacerations.

dominio.definicion: The collection, storage, and preparation for use, of human tissue (for example: blood components, bone marrow, corneas, heart values, ova, sperm) destined for future therapeutic use (for example: transfusion or transplantation).
dominio.observaciones: Tissues may be collected from either live donors or cadavers. A tissue bank may be a separate free-standing facility (for example: many blood banks) or part of a larger laboratory in a hospital.

dominio.definicion: The organized effort(s) of society to protect and improve the health and well-being of the population through: health monitoring, assessment and surveillance; health promotion; reducing inequalities in health status; prevention of disease, injury, disorder, disability and premature death; and protection from environmental hazards to health.
dominio.observaciones: Accomplished through the organized efforts and informed choices of society, organizations (public and private), communities and individuals. Public health activities include epidemiology, biostatistics and health services, as well as environmental, social, behavioral, and occupational health.

dominio.definicion: Provides medical treatment to people suffering from leprosy (Hansen's disease).
dominio.observaciones: Historically, quarantine from the rest of the population in the form of a leper colony (for example: on an island or a remote site) or hospital (for example: a leprosarium) was common.

dominio.definicion: Provides in-patient medical treatment for individuals who are disabled, elderly, or nonacutely ill, usually providing less intensive care than that offered at a hospital or skilled nursing facility.
Provides psychiatric medical treatment for the ill on an in-patient basis.
dominio.observaciones: The patient generally stays many weeks or months at the facility.

dominio.definicion: The long-term provision of both accommodation and meals combined with either nursing, supervisory or other types of care as required by the residents.
dominio.observaciones: The care provided is a mix of health and social services with the health services being largely some level of nursing services.Residential care falls between the nursing care delivered in skilled or intermediate care facilities and the assistance provided through social services.

dominio.definicion: A temporary shelter for people to live when they cannot live in their previous residence (for example: as a result of a natural disaster).
dominio.observaciones: An emergency shelter typically specializes in people fleeing a specific type of situation (for example: battered women, victims of domestic violence, or victims of sexual abuse). People staying in emergency shelters generally stay all day, except for work, school, or errands.Temporary emergency shelters are often set up by non-profit organizations like the Red Cross and Red Crescent, or governmental emergency management departments, in response to natural disasters, such as a flood or earthquake. They tend to use tents or other temporary structures, or are in buildings usually used for another purpose, such as a church or school.

dominio.definicion: An emergency shelter for people to stay temporarily when they otherwise would have to sleep on the street.
dominio.observaciones: A homeless shelter is usually open to anyone, regardless of why they don't have a more typical residence available, although they typically expect people to stay elsewhere during the day, returning only to sleep.Other services may be provided (for example: a soup kitchen, job seeking skills training, job training, job placement, support groups, or chemical abuse treatment).

dominio.definicion: A temporary shelter for people to live whose claim for protection has been recognised as satisfying the criteria laid down in the 1951 United Nations Convention on Refugees.
dominio.observaciones: Often established by governments or non-governmental organizations (such as the International Committee of the Red Cross) as temporary camps, and thus often termed a 'refugee camp'. Refugee camps are generally set up in an impromptu fashion (for example: using tents), and only designed to meet basic human needs for a short time; when civil war or other problems prevent the return of refugees, or children essentially grow up in the camps, a humanitarian crisis can result.

dominio.definicion: The provision of shelter and support to children and youth who have run away from or have been pushed out of their homes, or who are acting out and at risk for abuse pending return to their own families or suitable alternative placement.
dominio.observaciones: Such activities usually provide in-house individual, group and family counseling and the full range of other secondary services related to runaways including referral to appropriate resources. They also include support to young people who need help to become independent and live on their own, to take care of their health and/or studies, and to those who have tried living on their own but have yet to make a success of it.

dominio.definicion: The supervision and care of young children during the day, by a person other than the parents or legal guardians of the children and often someone outside the child's immediate family, especially while their mothers are at work.

Social, counselling, welfare, refugee, referral and similar services which are delivered to individuals and families in their homes or elsewhere and carried out by government offices or by private organizations, disaster relief organizations and national or local self-help organizations and by specialists providing counselling services.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: welfare and guidance activities for children and adolescents; adoption activities; household budget counselling; marriage and family guidance; credit and debt counselling; vocational rehabilitation and habilitation activities for unemployed persons; eligibility determination in connection with welfare aid, rent supplements or food stamps; day facilities for the homeless and other socially weak groups; and charitable activities like fund-raising or other supporting activities aimed at social work.

dominio.definicion: The provision of emergency assistance in the form of food, safe drinking water, sanitation and shelter, as well as registration and inquiry services.
dominio.observaciones: For example, many of the activities of the International Red Cross and Red Crescent movement. and their affiliated National organizations.

dominio.definicion: A place (for example: a building, a structure, or an outdoor setting) for live theatrical presentations, concerts, opera or dance productions and/or other stage productions.
dominio.observaciones: May also be used to host other cultural events (for example: lectures or the presentation of motion pictures).

dominio.definicion: A public hall, often of a somewhat austere nature, that is used by members of a community for civic, often educational, purposes.
dominio.observaciones: May also be used to host a variety of social and/or cultural events including live performances and motion pictures.

dominio.definicion: A meeting place used by members of a community for social, cultural, and/or recreational (for example: exercise or minor sports competition) purposes.
A theatre designed specifically for the presentation of musical drama (for example: opera), although other performing arts may be presented (for example: ballet).
dominio.observaciones: It is often a prominent local landmark and may be architecturally distinct.

dominio.definicion: An entertainment venue (for example: live performance or dancing), that does its primary business after dark, usually providing food and drink.

The documentation and information activities of libraries and archives of all kinds (for example: reading, listening and viewing rooms; organization and cataloguing of collections; lending and storage of books, maps, periodicals, films, records, tapes and/or works of art; or retrieval activities in order to comply with information requests).
dominio.observaciones: The library or archive may provide service to the general public or to a special clientele (for example: students or scientists).

dominio.definicion: A permanent institution in the service of society and of its development, open to the public, which acquires, conserves, researches, communicates and exhibits, for purposes of study, education, enjoyment, the tangible and intangible evidence of people and their environment.

Activities associated with the management and (often) public display of aquatic plants and animals (usually fish, and sometimes invertebrates, as well as amphibians, marine mammals, and reptiles) that are kept alive for purposes of observation and study in artificial ponds or tanks (usually with transparent sides).

Activities associated with the management and maintenance of botanical and/or zoological reserves, whether specially constructed (for example: a zoological garden) or a naturally occurring (for example: a park or nature reserve).

The operation of facilities in which money (or something of material value) is wagered on something with an uncertain outcome in the hope of winning additional money or material goods (for example: through a lottery, off-track betting or a casino game).
dominio.observaciones: May take place in a variety of venues, for example, at a casino, in a bingo hall, or through a video gaming terminal.

dominio.definicion: A place that is used principally for performing and observing sporting events, but also may include training fields and related fitness facilities.
dominio.observaciones: Usually organized around a central stadium that may be located indoors (and then often termed an 'arena').

dominio.definicion: A place that is used for organized exercise to maintain physical fitness.
dominio.observaciones: It may include general exercise equipment (for example: lifting weights or a treadmill) and/or more specialized exercise facilities (for example: a swimming pool or a volleyball court) as well as support facilities (for example: showers and a locker room).

dominio.definicion: A specialized facility designed for firearms practice and competition.
dominio.observaciones: Indoor ranges are usually designed for stationary target practice while outdoor ranges may be designed for stationary target practice and additionally may support moving target practice (for example: skeet or trap shooting with clay targets).Pistols, rifles, airguns, semi-automatic, and/or fully-automatic weapons may be allowed.
dominio.aliases: Firing Range, Shooting Gallery, Target Range

dominio.definicion: A place for amusement or recreation that includes water as a predominant and essential part of the recreational foundation.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, but not limited to, the structure(s) and associated equipment such as water rides, water attractions, and pools, that are used in water-based amusement activities.

dominio.definicion: A location at which pets (for example: dogs or cats) may be temporarily housed.
dominio.observaciones: May also provide other services, for example: breeding, grooming, obedience training or veterinary care.

dominio.definicion: The provision of recreational (for example: boating, camping, fishing, or dancing), amusement (for example: amusement or theme parks) and sports activities (for example: individual or team sports).
dominio.observaciones: Dramatic arts, music and other arts and entertainment (for example: theatrical presentations, concerts and opera or dance productions and other stage productions) are excluded.

dominio.definicion: A place (for example: a park or a gaming arcade) that is used for organized amusement and/or recreation other than through sporting events or, usually, performances.
dominio.observaciones: It may include a variety of attractions (for example: mechanical rides, water rides, electronic games, or theme exhibits) and dining facilities (for example: food and beverage vending or picnic grounds).

dominio.definicion: Activities that are avocations, hobbies, or leisure-time pursuits, existing apart from or in addition to one's regular occupation.
dominio.observaciones: Pursued merely for the amusement or interest that they afford, they occupy one's leisure (freedom from occupations).

dominio.definicion: Activities of religious organizations or individuals providing services either directly to worshippers (for example: in churches, mosques, temples, synagogues or other places of worship) or through the preparation of individuals for such service.
dominio.observaciones: Includes religious communities (for example: a convent or a monastery), religious retreats, and religious funeral service activities.

dominio.definicion: A place where religious worship is performed.
dominio.observaciones: Usually a building or similar structure is designed for this purpose.

dominio.definicion: An open space, usually roofed as a hall, that is intended for use in public Muslim worship.
dominio.observaciones: It has been prepared for the purposes of performing the five obligatory prayers of Islam ('salat') and includes a niche denoting the direction of Mecca (the 'mihrab'), to the right of which is usually located a stepped pulpit (the 'minbar').

dominio.definicion: An association or society of persons of like sympathies, of a common vocation, or otherwise mutually acceptable, meeting periodically (under certain regulations) for social intercourse and cooperation.
A club ostensibly for the owners and/or sailors of yachts but more generally serving as a social club for boating enthusiasts.
dominio.observaciones: Yacht-clubs may encompass any type of boating activity (for example: racing) and are often associated with a particular marina or port.

dominio.definicion: Activities associated with the provision of retail services of unspecified nature.
dominio.observaciones: For example, laundry, media reproduction, clothing rental, and beauty treatment.

dominio.definicion: The laundering, dry-cleaning and/or pressing, of all kinds of clothing (including fur) and textiles.
dominio.observaciones: May be provided by mechanical equipment, by hand or by self-service coin-operated machines, whether for the general public or for industrial or commercial clients (for example: provision of linens or work uniforms). The dirty laundry may be collected, and the clean laundry delivered, to the client on a scheduled basis.

dominio.definicion: The enhancement of apparent personal beauty through a variety of hair (for example: washing, trimming and cutting, setting, dyeing, tinting, waving, or straightening), skin (for example: facial massage or the application of make-up) and/or nail care (for example: manicure or pedicure) services.
dominio.observaciones: May take place at a 'beauty salon', where beauty products may also be purchased.

dominio.definicion: The preparation and disposal (for example: through burial or cremation) of corpses (for example: human or animal) and related activities.
dominio.observaciones: Typically includes: preparing the dead for burial or cremation (for example: embalming and morticians' services); providing burial or cremation services; rental of equipped space in funeral parlours; rental or sale of graves; and maintenance of graves and mausoleums.

dominio.definicion: The burning of corpses as a means of disposal.
dominio.observaciones: It may include the processing or the pulverization of bone fragments. The remains may, for example, be scattered (for example: over the ocean), displayed in an urn, or buried.

dominio.definicion: The examination (as necessary) and preparation of corpses for funeral rites (for example: washing, dressing or casketing) and for subsequent disposal.
dominio.observaciones: A cold chamber may be used to keep the deceased as long as is necessary for identification purposes, or prior to post-mortem examination, or while awaiting burial.

dominio.definicion: Activities involved in the provision of sexual services and related forms of adult entertainment (comprising a number of forms of entertainment not considered suitable for children).
dominio.observaciones: For example, erotic acting and nude modeling for pornography, striptease dancing and performances in peep shows, waitstaffing in sexually-oriented businesses, live sex shows, professional domination, provision of erotic massage and engagement in phone sex.

dominio.definicion: The function of a site where a group of people with similar interests or backgrounds gather.
dominio.observaciones: Meeting places may be at residences, museums, restaurants, parks or a variety of other sites. Clandestine or covert activities may occur at meeting places.

definicion: The total length of a feature from end to end, as measured along its centerline and thus regardless of the path that the feature follows.
descripcion: The path may include vertical or high-slope sections that increase the distance travelled beyond that evident from an overhead perspective (for example: as seen in remote sensing imagery). The path may also alter dynamically (for exampl: due to changing loading conditions on a cable).

definicion: The purpose(s) of, or intended role(s) served by, the fence.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a fence function.

dominio.definicion: A fence designed to keep animals either contained inside of or excluded from an area.
dominio.observaciones: It must be of sufficient strength and size (including mesh size) to prevent the passage of the species to be restricted. An example of containment is a livestock fence; an example of exclusion is a rabbit or deer fence.

dominio.definicion: Low fencing designed to restrict water erosion.
dominio.observaciones: It is emplaced so as to surround a region where the soil has been disturbed (for example: a construction site) and is generally temporary in nature. It is typically less than 1 metre in height, supported by spaced stakes, and often constructed from a fabric that allows the slow passage of water.

dominio.definicion: A fence designed to prohibit people from entering an area.
dominio.observaciones: Often temporary, it may be primarily a visual marker (for example: a well-marked ribbon or tape suspended from spaced poles or a row of traffic cones) or it may provide a more significant physical barrier (for example: a line of 'saw horse' barricades or temporary chain-link panels) to crossing into the prohibited area.

dominio.definicion: A fence designed to securely preclude entry into an area.
dominio.observaciones: The physical barrier may be accomplished solely by the passive strength of the fence (for example: a chain-link mesh) and/or by specific deterrent features (for example: barbed wire or electrification).

dominio.definicion: Fencing emplaced so as to prevent wind-induced drifting of loose terrain surface material (for example: snow or sand).
dominio.observaciones: Typically 1 to 3 metres in height and often constructed from spaced vertical slats. Sand fences are generally permanent in nature, intended to promote dune formation, and often placed along the margins of beaches and/or adjacent to roads and walkways. Snow fences may only be emplaced seasonally and are generally located adjacent to roads and walkways.

definicion: The type of a fence based on the type of materials used in its construction.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a fence type.

dominio.definicion: Constructed of metal, usually in the form of bars or tubes, in a variety of styles depending on the locale and intended use.
Constructed of wood in a variety of styles depending on the locale and intended use.
Constructed of stones, usually quarried, shaped, and mortared.
Constructed of loose stones, generally those gathered from an adjacent field.
dominio.observaciones: Typically used to separate adjoining fields, often those of separate farms.

dominio.definicion: Constructed of twisted wire strands with short pointed pieces inserted at intervals.
dominio.observaciones: Barbed wire is also used as an obstruction in war.

dominio.definicion: Constructed of heavy wire in a diamond-shaped mesh.
Constructed of wire that is supported by insulators and electrified so as to shock an animal touching it.
dominio.observaciones: The shock is usually mild for animal fences but potentially life threatening for security fences.

dominio.definicion: Constructed of synthetic fibers manufactured in a woven or loose nonwoven manner to form a blanket-like material.
dominio.observaciones: Typically made from polypropylene or polyester, geotextile fabrics come in three basic forms: woven (looks like mail bag sacking), needle punched (looks like felt), or heat bonded (looks like ironed felt). Most commonly used as a soil reinforcement agent and as a filter medium.

dominio.definicion: Constructed of a woven, knit, or knotted material of open texture with evenly spaced holes (openings).
dominio.observaciones: Modern fence netting is typically made of material derived from synthetic polymers.

definicion: An indication that a feature is completely surrounded by a fence.
descripcion: A fence is a man-made barrier of relatively light structure used as an enclosure or boundary.

datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: An indication that the shoreline construction has one or more associated fenders which are designed to cushion the impact of a vessel or floating object to prevent damage.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

definicion: The scheduled duration for a ferry crossing, including the time necessary for loading and unloading.

datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying a ferry crossing duration.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: Formatted in accordance with ISO 8601:2004, 4.4.3.2, Time Interval - Duration - Format with designators, a combination of components with accurate duration (hour, minute and second) and components with nominal duration (year, month, week and day), as a single data element comprising up to twenty characters, where the number of years shall be followed by the designator [Y], the number of months by [M], the number of weeks by [W], and the number of days by [D]. The part including time components shall be preceded by the designator [T]; the number of hours shall be followed by [H], the number of minutes by [M] and the number of seconds by [S]. In these expressions the day component [nnD] is expressed as a multiple of the duration of a calendar day. The complete representation of the expression for duration shall be of the form [PnnYnnMnnDTnnHnnMnnS], for example: 'P00Y00M02DT02H20M00S' for 2 days, 20 hours and 20 minutes. Representations with reduced precision may be used in accordance with 4.4.3.2.c (for example: 'P02DT02H20M').

definicion: The type of a ferry crossing based on the maneuverability of the vessel.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a ferry crossing type.

dominio.definicion: A ferry that follows a fixed route guided by a cable.
A ferry that may have routes that vary with weather, tide and traffic.
A winter-time ferry that crosses a lead.

definicion: The number of individual ferry ramps at a ferry site.

definicion: A visual manoeuvre used to properly bring the aircraft into position for landing at final approach.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a final approach alignment.

dominio.definicion: A descent in an approved procedure where the navigation facility alignment is normally on the runway centerline, and glide slope (GS) information is provided.
dominio.observaciones: Final approach path is straight in to a landing surface (S 9R).

dominio.definicion: An extension of an instrument approach procedure which provides for visual circling of the aerodrome prior to landing.
A visual alignment manoeuvre required by a pilot executing an approach to one runway and cleared to land on a parallel runway.

definicion: An indication that a terminal segment point aids in establishing an aircraft on a final approach course.
descripcion: A final approach course fix is located on the final approach course of an Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) prior to the Final Approach Fix (FAF) or glide path intercept point. It may also take the place of the final approach point on a procedure that has no designated FAF.

definicion: The Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) 10-4 full name that designates a geopolitical entity (for example: a State).

definicion: The Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) 10-4 code that designates a principal administrative division and its administrating geopolitical entity (for example: a State).
descripcion: A four-character alphanumeric code consisting of the FIPS two-character 'country code,' followed by the FIPS two-character 'administrative division [extension] code'. Often termed an 'ADM1 code'. FIPS changes to 'ADM1 codes' are triggered by changes in territorial extent.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a FIPS 10-4 principal administrative division.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: A four-character alphanumeric code that includes only the letters A through Z and digits 0 through 9; punctuation marks are not allowed. The last two characters may be blank filled if principal administrative division information is either unknown or is not required.

nombre: FIPS 10-4 Principal Administrative Division Extension Code
definicion: The Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) 10-4 code that designates a principal administrative division of a geopolitical entity (for example: a State).
descripcion: A two-character alphanumeric designation that when prefaced with the two-character FIPS 'country code' to form a four-character code (for example: 'US01') is often referred to as an 'ADM1 code'. FIPS changes to 'ADM1 codes' are triggered by changes in territorial extent.

datatype.estructura: Formatted in accordance with ISO 8601:2000, 5.4.1, Combinations of date and time of day - Complete representation - Extended format, a calendar date and time representation, as a single data element comprising up to twenty characters, where [YYYY] represents a calendar year, [MM] the ordinal number of a calendar month within the calendar year, [DD] the ordinal number of a day within the calendar month, [hh] the ordinal number of an hour within the calendar day, [mm] the ordinal number of a minute within the hour, [ss] the ordinal number of a second within the minute, and an optional 'Z' when the time is according to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), as 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ' (for example: '1985-04-12T11:45:20Z' for 11 hours, 45 minutes and 20 seconds UTC on 12 April 1985). Representations with reduced precision may be used in accordance with 5.4.2 (for example: '1985-04-12' for 12 April 1985). Representations consistently using basic format (eliminating the hyphen '-' and the colon ':') may be used in accordance with 5.4.1 (for example: '19850412T114520Z').

A structure (usually portable) for catching fish.

Scallop fishing using an apparatus for collecting and bringing up objects or material from the bed of a river by dragging or scooping.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a floating barrier type.

dominio.definicion: A floating barrier for blocking a waterway (for example: a narrow harbor entrance or a river).
A floating barrier designed to collect and/or contain dredging debris.
A floating barrier designed to collect, contain, and transport floating logs timbered from nearby forests.
A floating barrier placed in the water to provide security or a highly visible line of demarcation.
dominio.observaciones: Commonly used for waterfront security around high value assets or installations or to provide a positive boat barrier between the general public and hazardous or restricted areas (for example: dams and waterfalls).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a flood control structure type.

dominio.definicion: An opening gate in a dyke.
A gate used only in a state of emergency (for example: to control or cause flooding).
An adjustable gate used to control floodwater.
A small fixed obstruction that is primarily located across intermittent watercourses in order to prevent, reduce or slow down the flooding of an area.
dominio.observaciones: Fixed barrages are often grouped together to form a series of obstructions down a watercourse. Materials used to construct fixed barrages are found locally.

dominio.definicion: A large movable barricade within a watercourse.
dominio.observaciones: Often constructed as a set, the movable barricades are connected to fixed structures within the watercourse or at the banks. These barriers are normally left open to allow for the passage of vessels and the movement of water and are closed during times of floods or storm surges. For example, the Thames Barrier.

definicion: An indication that a structure is floodlit.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The number of floors in a structure (for example: a building).

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: An indication that a feature has an associated fog detector light.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of mechanism used to generate a fog signal.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a fog signal generation type.

dominio.definicion: Signal generation is initiated by a self-regulating mechanism (for example: a timer or light sensor) and is self-powered.
The signal is generated by the motion of the sea surface (for example: a bell in a buoy).
dominio.observaciones: It is therefore not present during periods of relative calm.

dominio.definicion: The signal is generated by a manually operated mechanism (for example: a hand-cranked siren).
The signal is generated by the motion of air (for example: a wind-driven whistle).
dominio.observaciones: It is therefore not present during periods of relative calm.

definicion: The type of a fog signal based on its signal characteristics and method of generation.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a fog signal type.

dominio.definicion: Generates a ringing sound with a short range.
dominio.observaciones: The apparatus may be operated automatically, by hand or by wave action.

dominio.definicion: Generates a powerful low-pitched multi-toned sound, which often concludes with a brief sound of suddenly lowered pitch termed the 'grunt'.
dominio.observaciones: The apparatus is typically powered by compressed air.

dominio.definicion: Generates a sound produced by the periodic (for example: every few minutes) firing of an explosive charge.
Generates a sound produced by vibration of a disc when struck.
dominio.observaciones: The apparatus may be operated automatically, by hand or by wave action.

dominio.definicion: Generates a sound produced by the vibration of a diaphragm.
dominio.observaciones: Includes nautophones, reeds and tyfons. The apparatus may be powered by compressed air or electricity. There are a variety of horn types, differing greatly in their sound and power.

dominio.definicion: Generates a sound using a horn having a diaphragm oscillated by electricity.
Generates a radio signal.
Generates a loud prolonged or ululating sound.
dominio.observaciones: The apparatus is usually based on revolving a perforated disc over a jet of compressed air or steam. There are a variety of siren types, differing greatly in their sound and power.

dominio.definicion: A bell whose signal is transmitted through water.
Generates a shrill tone made by a jet of air passing through an orifice.
dominio.observaciones: The apparatus may be operated automatically, by hand, or by air being forced up a tube by waves acting on a buoy.

dominio.definicion: Generates a weak, high pitched sound produced by vibrating a narrow reed-shaped diaphragm.
dominio.observaciones: The apparatus is typically powered by compressed air.

dominio.definicion: No signal is produced.
Generates a sound using a horn having a diaphragm oscillated by compressed air or steam.

definicion: The predominant foliage type of the vegetation.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a foliage type.

dominio.definicion: Sheds its leaves each year at the end of the period of growth.
Having green foliage all the year round.
A mix of both deciduous and evergreen foliage.
Vegetation type of the temperately cool latitutes, nearly exclusively of coniferous trees.
dominio.observaciones: The widest extension of coniferous forests is found in the boreal climates.

dominio.definicion: Vegetation type of predominantly heat-loving deciduous trees like olive, laurel, holly oak, cork oak, not being subject to seasonally losing their foliage.

definicion: The source(s) of foreign government information (in addition to US controlled data) that were used to define the digital representation of the feature or data set.
descripcion: A list of trigraph country codes in accordance with ISO 3166 and and tetragraph international organizations (for example: 'NATO' for the North Atlantic Treaty Organization and 'SFOR' for Special Forces) that are applicable.

datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying a foreign government information.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: Contains the characters 'FGI' followed by a list of trigraph country codes in accordance with ISO 3166 and then by a list of tetragraph international organizations (for example: 'NATO') that are applicable. For example: 'FGI CRI LUX NATO'. Multiple values are individually separated by a single space and should be ordered alphabetically with the alphabetical trigraph country values preceding the alphabetical tetragraph values. If the specific government must be concealed, only the characters 'FGI' should be used.

definicion: The condition of a forest based on its appearance and/or maturation status.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a forest condition.

dominio.definicion: A forest left in its original state without any human impact (for example: silvicultural use or maintenance).
A natural reafforested wood (usually after forest fires) but less rich in species than a virgin forest.
A new planted forest intended for predominantly economic use.
A treeless zone within a forest area.
A forest area with tree seeds and/or newly planted trees under careful protection and management.
A forest area destroyed by wind and storm.
dominio.observaciones: It has not been cleared by humans.

dominio.definicion: New growing timber stocks after natural sowing.

definicion: The ratio of the area covered by forest within an area, relative to the entire area.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: A dimensionless quantity (a quantity with the dimension of 1).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A scaled dimensionless measure denoting one part in every hundred.

definicion: The intended function of a forest.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a forest function.

dominio.definicion: A shelter wood that may not be cleared and only may be cultivated to a limited degree.
dominio.observaciones: It predominantly serves as avalanche and flood protection.

dominio.definicion: A forest area that serves as recreation zone.
A forest area used as burial place for the deceased.
A protected forest area that develops under natural conditions without human influence.
A regularly cultivated forest specifically managed to meet one or more economic objectives.
A small wood planted for landscape architectural reasons.

definicion: The type of the forest defined by habitat characteristics.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a forest habitat.

dominio.definicion: A forest in the inundation area of a large river that is differentiated in softwood forest close to the river and hard wood flood plain forest on the upper banks.
A forest developing on flat moor land, all year round under the influence of groundwater.
A forest strip as vegetation formation in the wet-dry tropics along the valleys with or without running waters.
A forest in the montane belt of the high mountains or type of forest in mountainous countries.
Tropical montane rain forest wreathed in clouds between 1000 and 3000 metres elevation, all year round dominated by fog, rain and/or dew.
A forest area characterized by open woods on the threshold to the dense forest of the taiga.
Tropical coastal wood subject to the tides with stilt roots.
dominio.observaciones: Mostly at calm bays or river mouths on muddy ground.

dominio.definicion: A forest growing on dewatered bog areas as well as in temporarily drying swamp areas.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the Florida Everglades.

definicion: The type of a forest based on the predominant types of trees and the climate-based or altitude-based zone.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a forest type.

dominio.definicion: Most luxuriant vegetation form of the Earth and vegetation type of the rainy tropics.
Type of forest whose existence depends on rainfall.
Rain green forest of the wet-dry tropics with distinctive drought seasons.
Type of forest of the temperate subtropical zones.
Type of forest of the temperate climates.
Wide circumpolar zone of coniferous forests in the northern hemisphere south of the tundra.
Type of forest of the high mountainous regions below the timberline.

definicion: The type(s) of use of forest components.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a forest usage type.

dominio.definicion: The removal of trees for new plantings (for example: recultivation, reafforestation, park and garden layouts) or for seasonal use (for example: Christmas and festive occasions).
Clearing by cutting down the trees and burning the trunks for agricultural use of the ground.
The removal of wood for heating purposes (either industrial and/or private use).
The harvesting of woodland fruits (for example: berries or mushrooms) for commercial and/or private use.
Tapping trees for resin for commercial use (for example: resinoids).
Removal of wood for industrial finishing (for example: in furniture or packages) or for paper-production.
Use of the game population for nourishment; diminishing of game overpopulation.
Processing of wood for the production of charcoal for heating purposes.
Removal of the bark of cork trees.
Removal of the bark of trees for industrial purposes (for example: in tanning).
Use of forest areas for pasture.
Removal of natural saps from rubber-trees for industrial purposes.

definicion: The prevailing use of a forest for economic purposes.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a forestry form.

dominio.definicion: A type of forestry based on trees with ages of 50-100 years and thus high crowns.
dominio.observaciones: Preferred for its over all efficiency.

dominio.definicion: Varying composition of crown level heights, intermediate in utilization efficiency between high forest and low forest.
dominio.observaciones: Principally used for extraction of firewood and construction timber.

dominio.definicion: Containing few mature trees and generally of low crown level and low utilization efficiency.
dominio.observaciones: Principally used for extraction of firewood, brushwood and bark. Mostly no conifers.

definicion: The form of rule imposed on a people by the person or group wielding power or authority over that people.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a form of rule.

dominio.definicion: Absence of government or leadership.
Rule by male leadership.
Rule by the nobles or by the best citizens.
Absolute government by a single person or by a group.
The form of government in which the sovereign power is in the hands of the people.
Government by a single person or by a political party or by another group invested with supreme authority often created in time of emergency.
Rule by the senior members of society as a council of eldest.
Rule by female leadership.
Rule by the mother as head of the cultural group as determined by the female line of descent.
Rule by military leaders with supreme authority.
Government in which the supreme power is vested in a monarch.
Government in which the monarch is submitted to a constitution.
Government in which the monarch is the head of the executive only.
Rule by the father as head of the cultural group as determined by the male line of descent.
Rule by a person chosen by a god or a government of the priests.

definicion: An indication that a feature is fortified, enhanced with structures or equipment to be more protected than the general occurrence of this feature.

datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of a building that is fortified or reinforced to provide for defense from armed attack.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a fortified building type.

dominio.definicion: A detached fortified defensive building with loopholes.
dominio.observaciones: It is usually constructed of timber or concrete.

dominio.definicion: A large reinforced concrete and steel emplacement from which guns are fired.
dominio.observaciones: Casements are normally installed as part of coastal defences or fixed defensive lines.

dominio.definicion: The strongest, innermost part or central tower of a medieval castle.
A small circular fort with very thick walls, especially any of those erected in Britain as a coastal defence during the Napoleonic Wars.
dominio.observaciones: It usually includes a gun platform, ammunition magazine, and accommodations for a garrison.

dominio.definicion: A building of no specific structural type that has been reinforced to provide for improved defense from armed attack.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the U.S. Pentagon following the attack of 11 September, 2001.

dominio.definicion: A small low fortified emplacement for machine guns and anti-tank weapons.
dominio.observaciones: Pillboxes are usually made of concrete or steel and are typically found along trench lines and at critical points within defensive lines.

definicion: The altitude within which frequency reception is assumed to be interference-free.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 0.3048 metres.

definicion: The type of a covering of snow and/or ice based on its composition and structure.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a frozen cover type.

dominio.definicion: An expanse of packed snow, usually resulting from multiple snowfalls.
An extensive flat expanse of ice, especially located in the polar regions.

definicion: The primary method(s) of dispensing fuel.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a fuel dispensing method.

dominio.definicion: Fuel dispensing is known to be available, but the specific method is unknown.
Delivered by tanker trucks.
Accessed through a fixed network of hydrants.
dominio.observaciones: Typically supplied from a central tank storage area.

dominio.definicion: Delivered by manual laborers using relatively small storage containers (for example: barrels, drums, and cans).
dominio.observaciones: Often transferred using hand-operated pumps.

definicion: The number of fill stands used to transfer fuel from storage tanks into trucks.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The sum of the capacity of all fuel storage containers at a given location.
descripcion: Fuel storage containers could be tanks or drums, for example.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value that is restricted to be non-negative.
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a three dimensional (cubic) region that is (generally) the product of length, width, and height.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The derived unit of measurement of volume in the SI units system.

definicion: The method(s) of fuel storage.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a fuel storage method.

dominio.definicion: One or more buried storage tanks.
One or more aboveground storage tanks.
A mixture of aboveground and buried storage tanks.
One or more semi-buried storage tanks.
dominio.observaciones: For example, partially banked by soil.

dominio.definicion: A mixture of aboveground and semi-buried storage tanks.
A mixture of buried and semi-buried storage tanks.
One or more railway tank wagons.
dominio.observaciones: They are typically stored on a railway siding.

dominio.definicion: One or more tanker trucks.
A collection of barrels, drums, and/or cans.
dominio.observaciones: Generally of relatively small individual capacity (for example: 55 US gallons).

dominio.definicion: A mixture of storage tanks that are either buried, semi-buried, or aboveground.

definicion: The degree of surface-level wind damage due to tornadic winds as specified by the damage-based Fujita Tornado Scale.
descripcion: The categories are based upon the estimated maximum winds occurring within the tornado, however wind speed estimates associated with damage are not considered to be exact.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain category denoting a fujita tornado scale.

dominio.definicion: Some damage to chimneys; breaks twigs and branches off trees; pushes over shallow-rooted trees; damages signboards; some windows broken.
dominio.observaciones: Estimated maximum wind speed of 40-72 statute miles per hour, but remain below hurricane force.

dominio.definicion: Peels surfaces off roofs; mobile homes pushed off foundations or overturned; outbuildings demolished; moving autos pushed off the roads; trees snapped or broken.
dominio.observaciones: Estimated maximum wind speed of 73-112 statute miles per hour.

dominio.definicion: Roofs torn off frame houses; mobile homes demolished; frame houses with weak foundations lifted and moved; boxcars pushed over; large trees snapped or uprooted; light-object missiles generated.
dominio.observaciones: Estimated maximum wind speed of 113-157 statute miles per hour.

dominio.definicion: Roofs and some walls torn off well-constructed houses; trains overturned; most trees in forests uprooted; heavy cars lifted off the ground and thrown; weak pavement blown off roads.
dominio.observaciones: Estimated maximum wind speed of 158-206 statute miles per hour.

dominio.definicion: Well-constructed homes leveled; structures with weak foundations blown off some distance; cars thrown and disintegrated; large missiles generated; trees in forest uprooted and carried some distance away.
dominio.observaciones: Estimated maximum wind speed of 207-260 statute miles per hour.

dominio.definicion: Strong frame houses lifted off foundations and carried considerable distance to disintegrate; automobile-sized missiles fly through the air in excess of 100 metres (300 feet); trees debarked; incredible phenomena will occur.
dominio.observaciones: Estimated maximum wind speed of 261-318 statute miles per hour.

definicion: A complete name that is used to designate the entity as that designation would normally be written by the originating culture on a map or chart.
descripcion: It is generally considered to consist of a specific part, a generic part, and any articles or prepositions. The order of the parts may vary with the generic part appearing at the beginning, middle or end.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that may contain lexical characters and is 200 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: A complete name that is used to designate the entity as that designation would normally be written by the originating culture on a map or chart, except that its components have been arranged into an order that facilitates alphabetic ordering and search.
descripcion: The component order is such that the specific part of the name appears first, followed by an optional comma, the generic part of the name, and then finally any articles or prepositions (for example: 'Everest, Mount' or 'Mexico, Gulf of'). For some geographic names no reordering of the full name is required (for example: 'Tigrus River'). Geographic names that are believed to no longer exist are enclosed in double parenthesis, as: '(( Name ))'.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that may contain lexical characters and is 200 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

descripcion: The component order is such that the specific part of the name appears first, followed by an optional comma, the generic part of the name, and then finally any articles or prepositions (for example: 'Everest, Mount' or 'Mexico, Gulf of'). descripcion: It is generally considered to consist of a specific part, a generic part, and any articles or prepositions. The order of the parts may vary with the generic part appearing at the beginning, middle or end.

definicion: The general categories of function or use that a facility, site, or region serves or may serve.
descripcion: May be so designated by legal means (for example: statute, zoning, or treaty) or be the unplanned consequence of economic forces.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a functional use.

dominio.definicion: Of or pertaining to manufacturing and/or production.
Of or pertaining to the exchange of merchandise or services, especially on a large scale.
Of or pertaining to a society or organization for the promotion of a purpose, especially a charitable or social one.
Suitable for or characterized by residences, especially by private houses.
Of or pertaining to the science or practice of cultivating the soil and rearing animals.
Connected with the sea in relation to navigation and/or commerce.
Of or pertaining to displaced persons.
dominio.observaciones: Especially those in a foreign country. For example, those displaced by war, religious persecution, political troubles, or natural disaster.

dominio.definicion: Of or pertaining to the incarceration of prisoners serving terms of punishment detention, awaiting trial or other judiciary proceedings or awaiting further processing by authorities (for example: illegal immigrants awaiting deportation).
A designated conservation area in which the wildlife is protected (for example: from hunting and/or collecting).
dominio.observaciones: For example, wildlife areas, migratory bird sanctuaries, conservation areas and marine protected areas.

dominio.definicion: An area set apart by a governmental body, institution, or individual for a special purpose.
Of or pertaining to the refreshment and/or comfort produced by something affecting the senses or body.
Of or pertaining to concentrations of buildings and/or other structures that may have a variety of uses.
Of or pertaining to the conveyance of people and/or goods from one place to another.
Of or pertaining to the science or practice of medicine.
A forest that is protected from logging and other human activities detrimental to the environment.
Of or pertaining to the systematic instruction, schooling, or training of children and young people, or, by extension, instruction obtained in adult life.
Not of or pertaining to the exchange of merchandise or services, especially on a large scale.
Of or pertaining to the cultivation or development (for example: improvement by education and training) of the mind, tastes, and/or manners.
Of or pertaining to conduct of the policy, actions, and/or affairs of a State or other governing authority.

An area, usually on a military installation, where entrance or presence of unauthorized personnel is prohibited, typically due to the presence of unexploded munitions, mines, or sensitive environmental habitats.
Of or pertaining to the provision of services to the general population.
Of or pertaining to supporting the conduct of religious services, providing a place of worship, and/or the training of individuals for religious service.
Of or pertaining to security and crowd control.
Of or pertaining to use by an armed force.
Of or pertaining to the provision of public utilities (for example: electric power or water).
Of or pertaining to the provision of materials for construction and engineering.
Of, pertaining to, or suitable for bulk storage (for example: a fuel dump).

A commercial facility consisting of multiple office buildings tenanted by one or more non-retail businesses (for example: corporate management, consulting services, or research and development) and supportive businesses (for example: a restaurant serving mid-day meals or a post office) that share a common park-like setting consisting of landscaping (for example: lawns, ornamental plantings, or ponds), parking facilities, and common entrances from adjacent roads.
dominio.observaciones: May also include commercial tenants involved in light industry (for example: gem cutting or specialized electronics manufacture).

dominio.definicion: An area, that is intended to be used for research and/or scientific purposes.
dominio.observaciones: For example, an astronomic observatory with facilities like dish aerials, buildings and infrastructure.

definicion: The type of a gate (or similar route barrier) based on its intended use.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a gate use.

dominio.definicion: Crossing a road and preventing passage until a toll is paid.
Controls access to a level crossing.
dominio.observaciones: For example, at the intersection of a road and a railway where physical blockage of road traffic is desirable when a train is passing.

dominio.definicion: Crossing a road and preventing passage into a facility.
dominio.observaciones: May be manned by a guard or an automatic control device.

dominio.definicion: Crossing a road and preventing passage until approved by a border guard.

definicion: The type of a gemstone.
descripcion: A gemstone is a mineral that shows special colour, hardness, shine and other characteristics which renders it suitable for use as jewelry or for other decorative purposes.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a gemstone type.

dominio.definicion: A yellowish to brownish fossil resin.
A semiprecious stone with a variety of colours, dark red being the most common.
A intense blue, greenish-blue or violet-blue feldspathoid mineral.
dominio.observaciones: It is the principal constituent of lapis lazuli.

dominio.definicion: A mineral that occurs in nearly all colours, is transparent or nearly opaque.
dominio.observaciones: The transparent colored varieties exhibing opalescence are valued as gemstones.

dominio.definicion: A red variety of corundum.
A fine blue transparent variety of corundum.
A brillant green variety of beryl.
A white or lightly colored (yellow, blue, pink) mineral.
dominio.observaciones: Transparent topaz is used as a gemstone.

dominio.definicion: A colorless, naturally occuring crystalline form of carbon used as gem or for industrial purposes.
dominio.observaciones: It is the hardest substance known.

datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a character string. For example: Golden Gate Bridge.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The portion of a full name that references a common, often geomorphologic, feature.
descripcion: For example: a 'Mountain', a 'River', and a 'Sea'. The names of populated places are not considered to have a generic part.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that may contain lexical characters and is 128 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The portion of a full name that references a common, often geomorphologic, feature except that any diacritics and special characters have been replaced with their corresponding Roman characters.
descripcion: For example: a 'Mountain', a 'River', and a 'Sea'. The names of populated places are not considered to have a generic part.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that contains only non-lexical characters and is 128 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The geodesic distance to a geographic point or location.
descripcion: Geodesic distance is the shortest distance between any two points on a mathematically defined ellipsoidal surface.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 1,852.0 metres.

definicion: A datum describing the relationship of a two-dimensional coordinate system to the Earth.
descripcion: The datum (sometimes termed 'horizontal datum') defines a surface and two locally-orthogonal axes on that surface as the basis for specifying geodetic longitude and geodetic latitude.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geodetic datum.
