dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Voirol 1960' whose zero meridian is set at Paris and is intended to be used only in the geographic region of Algeria.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Wake Island 1952' which is based on astronomic observations and is intended to be used only in the geographic region of the Wake Atoll.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'World Geodetic System 1960' and intended to be used globally.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'World Geodetic System 1966' and intended to be used globally.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'World Geodetic System 1972' and intended to be used globally.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'World Geodetic System 1984' and intended to be used globally.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Yacare' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Uruguay.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Zanderij' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Surinam.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum is known but not specified.
The geodetic datum known as 'Co-ordinate System 1937 of Estonia' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Estonia.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Indian 1975 - Cycle 1' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Thailand.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'South American Geocentric Reference System' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of South America.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Pulkovo 1942' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Hungary.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Pulkovo 1942' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Poland.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Pulkovo 1942' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Czechoslovakia (prior to 1 January 1993).
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Pulkovo 1942' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Latvia.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Pulkovo 1942' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Kazakhstan.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Pulkovo 1942' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Albania.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Pulkovo 1942' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Romania.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

dominio.definicion: The geodetic datum known as 'Tokyo - Cycle 1' and intended to be used only in the geographic region of Korea.
dominio.observaciones: See U.S. DoD World Geodetic System 1984 - Its Definition and Relationships with Local Geodetic Systems, 3rd edition, Amendment 1.

definicion: The classification of the type of a feature with which a geographic name is associated, as used in the NGA Geographic Names Data Base (GNDB).
descripcion: A classification has a (unique, non-overlapping) set of associated 'member' geographic name designations. May be used to organize geographic names for the purposes of queries and/or presentation.

datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying a geographic name classification.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: A single character from the set { 'A': Administrative region; 'H': Hydrographic (including ocean areas within the 12 nautical mile limit of sovereignty); 'L: Locality or area; 'P': Populated place; 'R': Streets, highways, roads, or railroad; 'S': Spot feature; 'T': Hypsographic; ''U': Undersea (located under an ocean outside the 12 nautical mile limit of sovereignty); 'V': Vegetation }.

definicion: The designation of the type of a feature with which a geographic name is associated, as used in the NGA Geographic Names Data Base (GNDB).
descripcion: A designated feature type also has a (unique, single) geographic name classification.

datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying a geographic name designation.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: A two to five-character alphanumeric code that includes only the letters A through Z and digits 0 through 9.

definicion: The type of a geographic name based on its scope of use, quality of source and/or its transliteration status.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geographic name type.

dominio.definicion: An English name that is in widespread usage for a feature that is located in a region where English is not the official language.
The official local name for a feature that has been transliterated to the Latin/Roman script as necessary and is approved by the U.S. Board on Geographic Names (BGN).
A variant or alternate name for a feature that has been transliterated to the Latin/Roman script as necessary.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a former name, a name in local usage, alternate name spellings found in various sources, or a derived short name.

dominio.definicion: A local name for a feature that has been transliterated to the Latin/Roman script as necessary, where a native source for the name was either unavailable or nonexistant and a non-native source for the name was used instead and the resulting name could not be verified from a recent local official source.
dominio.observaciones: An unverified name is usually indicated in a gazetteer using the dagger symbol.

dominio.definicion: The official local name for a feature that remains in the original (non-Latin/Roman) script and is approved by the U.S. Board on Geographic Names (BGN).
A variant or alternate name for a feature that remains in the original (non-Latin/Roman) script.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a former name, a name in local usage, alternate name spellings found in various sources, or a derived short name.

dominio.definicion: A local name for a feature that remains in the original (non-Latin/Roman) script, where a native source for the name was either unavailable or nonexistant and a non-native source for the name was used instead and the resulting name could not be verified from a recent local official source.
dominio.observaciones: An unverified name is usually indicated in a gazetteer using the dagger symbol.

dominio.definicion: A historical name for a feature that has been transliterated to the Latin/Roman script as necessary.
A historical name for a feature that remains in the original (non-Latin/Roman) script.
A provisional name for a feature that has been transliterated to the Latin/Roman script as necessary.

definicion: The greatest distance at which a light can be seen (or signal detected) as a function of the curvature of the Earth and the heights of the light source and the observer.
descripcion: The effect of atmospheric refraction is considered, however the luminous intensity of the light is ignored.

datatype.definicion: An integer domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is an integer. For example, 6 (as in the length of a fathom in feet).
datatype.nota: The realization of this integer datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 1,852.0 metres.

definicion: The geographic region(s) in which a feature is located.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geographic region.

dominio.definicion: A region centred at the North Pole that generally encompasses those portions of North America, northern Europe, and northern Asia located northwards of the 66 degrees 33 minutes north parallel.
A continent whose general limits are on the north the Mediterranean Sea, on the east the Indian Ocean, and on the west the South Atlantic Ocean.
A continent located around the South Pole and bordered by the South Atlantic and South Pacific Oceans.
A continent whose general limits are on the north the Arctic Ocean, on the east the North Pacific Ocean, on the south the Indian Ocean, and on the west the Ural Mountains.
A continent whose general limits are on the northeast the South Pacific Ocean, on the south the Antarctic Ocean, and on the northwest the Indian Ocean.
A continent whose general limits are on the north the Arctic Ocean, on the east the Ural Mountains, on the south the Mediterranean Sea, and on the west the North Atlantic Ocean.
A continent whose general limits are on the north the Arctic Ocean, on the east the North Atlantic Ocean, and on the west the North Pacific Ocean.
A large group of islands in the South Pacific Ocean including Melanesia, Micronesia and Polynesia.
dominio.observaciones: May sometimes be used to include Australasia and the Malay Archipelago.

dominio.definicion: A continent whose general limits are on the east the South Atlantic Ocean, and on the west the South Pacific Ocean.
An ocean whose general limits are on the north the parallel of 60 degrees south and on the south the coast of Antarctica, including the Antarctic Peninsula.
An ocean situated round the North Pole, its southern limit generally following the northern coasts of North America, Greenland, and Eurasia.

An ocean whose general limits are the eastern coasts of North and South America, the southern coast of Greenland, the western coasts of Europe and Africa, and on the south the parallel of 60 degrees south.
An ocean whose general limits are the eastern coast of Africa, the southern coast of Asia, the western coast of Australia, and on the south the parallel of 60 degrees south.
A sea whose general limits are the coasts of southern Europe, western Asia and north Africa, opening only, on the west, to the North Atlantic Ocean through the Strait of Gibraltar.
An ocean whose general limits are the eastern coasts of South America and North America, the southern coast of Greenland, the western coasts of Europe.
An ocean whose general limits are the eastern coast of Asia, the western coast of North America, and the Equator.

An ocean whose general limits are the eastern coasts of Asia, Australia, Irian Jaya and Papua New Guinea, the western coasts of North and South America, and on the south the parallel of 60 degrees south.
An ocean whose general limits are the eastern coast of South America, the Equator, the western coast of Africa, and on the south the parallel of 60 degrees south.

An ocean-like region including the Eastern Archipelagic Seas whose general limits are the eastern boundary of the Indian Ocean, the south-eastern coast of Asia, and the western boundary of the Pacific Ocean.
An ocean whose general limits are the eastern coasts of Australia, Irian Jaya and Papua New Guinea, the Equator, the western coast of South America, and on the south the parallel of 60 degrees south.

definicion: The distance of the geoid above (positive) or below (negative) the mathematical reference ellipsoid.
descripcion: In respect to the World Geodetic System 1984 (WGS-84) defined ellipsoid, the difference between the WGS-84 ellipsoidal height and orthometric height is the WGS-84 geoid undulation.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The angle that a planar geologic surface is inclined from the horizontal.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

definicion: An indication that a geologic fault is visible at the ground surface.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The speed and/or continuity of a geologic mass movement.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geologic mass movement motion.

dominio.definicion: Movement without interruption.
Movement with interruption.
Mass movement which occurs in minutes and seconds.
dominio.observaciones: May be measured in metres per second. For example: rockfall, slumps and slides.

dominio.definicion: Mass movement which occurs during a longer period of time.
dominio.observaciones: May be measured in metres per annum. For example: solifluction.

definicion: The type of a geologic mass movement based on its cause, material type, material characteristics, morphology, water content, temperature, and/or the nature of its motion plane.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geologic mass movement type.

dominio.definicion: The period of very rapid flow of a surging glacier; also, the displacement or advance of ice resulting resulting from the rapid flow.
Temporary loss of soil strength due to shaking of the ground by an earthquake.
dominio.observaciones: It occurs in cohesionless soil. The temporary transformation from a solid to a liquid state is the result of increased pore pressure and reduced effective stress due to ground shaking.

dominio.definicion: A suspension of particles in turbulent gas, liquid, or a mixture of both, that behaves much like a fluid, as gas and/or liquid is forced upward through the bed and supports the solid particles.
dominio.observaciones: A fluidized bed will flow down an incline.

dominio.definicion: A general term covering a wide variety of mass-movement landforms and processes involving the downslope transport, under gravitational influence, of soil and rock material en masse.
A general term for a mass-movement landform and a process characterized by a flowing mass of predominantly fine-grained earth material posessing a high degree of fluidity during movement.
The very rapid downslope flowage of rock fragments may become further brocken or pulverized.
The relatively free falling or precipitous movement of a newly detached segment of bedrock of any size from a cliff or other very steep slope.
A avalanche consisting of relatively pure snow, although considerable earth and rock material may also be carried downward.
Collapse of rock overlying an opening along a rupture.
A mudflow composed chiefly of volcanoclasitc materials on the flank of a volcano.
dominio.observaciones: Lahar or volcanic mudflows occur on the slopes of some subaerial volcanoes. Cold lahars are mostly produced by heavy rain falling on unconsolidated ash. Hot lahars are formed when a pyroclastic flow enters a river.

definicion: The angle between a geologic strike line and true North.
descripcion: A strike line is the line of intersection between a planar geologic surface and the horizontal plane. The direction of a strike line is measured as an angle in a clockwise direction from true North (0 arc degrees).

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

definicion: The spatial arrangement of the components of a geologic structure.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geologic structure geometry.

dominio.definicion: The axis of an anticline.
dominio.observaciones: Anticline: a fold, generally convex upward, whose core contains the stratigraphically older rocks.

dominio.definicion: The axis of an fold.
dominio.observaciones: Fold: a curve or bend of a planar structure.

dominio.definicion: The axis of an syncline.
dominio.observaciones: Syncline: a fold, generally concave upward, whose core contains the stratigraphically younger rocks.

dominio.definicion: The direction taken by a structural surface (for example bedding or fault plane) as it intersects the horizontal (= strike line).
dominio.observaciones: The strike is measured as an angle in a clockwise direction from true north (0 arc degrees).

dominio.definicion: The direction of a maximum downhill slope of a planar feature.
dominio.observaciones: The direction is measured as an angle in a clockwise direction from true north (0 arc degrees).

dominio.definicion: The angle that a structural surface (for example bedding or fault plane) makes with the horizontal, measured perpendicular to the strike of the structure and in the vertical plane (0 arc degrees).

definicion: The classification of a relief-forming geological-hydrological process.
descripcion: For example, eluviation.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geologic-hydrologic process classification.

dominio.definicion: The mechanical erosion of rock surfaces by friction and impact, in wich the solid rock particles transported by wind, ice, waves, running water, or gravity are the tools of abrasion.
A large mass of snow, ice, soil, or rock, or mixtures of these materials, falling, sliding, or flowing very rapidly under under the force of gravity.
The process forming a ring fracture structure, caused by the lowering a more or less cilindrical block into a magma chamber.
Collective term for all frost-based movements in the soil.
The removal of material from a land surface by aeolian (wind) processes.
The process of surface discharge of water from an area by streamflow.
The formation of karst features by the solutional, and sometimes mechhanical, action of waterin a region of limestone, gypsum or other bedrock.
Gravitative transfer of material down a slope.
dominio.observaciones: It includes rockfalls, slumps an slides, debris-flows and turbidity-flows.

dominio.definicion: The slow viscous downslope flow of watterlogged soil and other unsorted and saturated surficial material (0.5 - 5 cm/yr).
dominio.observaciones: The slow soil movement occur primarly in periglacial areas.

dominio.definicion: A process of erosion occurring in the upper surface of limestone burried by alluvium or glacial deposits, whereby percolating waters creates voids in the limestone surface into which fine material from the overlying drift is washed.
The removal of surface materials by concentrated surface flow of water from flash floods, often causing extensive scouring and bank caving.
The mechanical destruction of the coastline and the removal of material by waves and currents.

definicion: The depth of a feature below average surface level as determined by a corresponding digital elevation matrix.
descripcion: If not obtainable, the average depth will be used.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The height of a feature above average surface level as determined by a corresponding digital elevation matrix.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The type of a geomorphic feature based on the local configuration of terrain slope(s) and aspect(s).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geomorphic type.

dominio.definicion: The location of maximum elevation of a terrain area, away from which water tends to flow in all directions.
The location of minimum elevation of a terrain area, towards which water flows from all directions.
The upper edge of a cliff or steep slope separating two comparatively level or more gently sloping surfaces.
The lower edge of a cliff or steep slope separating two comparatively level or more gently sloping surfaces.
The upper edge of a vertical (dip-slip) fault.
The lower edge of a vertical (dip-slip) fault.
The edge between adjoining slopes of terrain towards which water flows from opposite directions and along which water drains.
The edge between adjoining slopes of terrain from which water begins to flow in opposite directions.
The edge between adjoining slopes of terrain towards which water flows from opposite directions.
The edge between adjoining slopes of terrain where the slope changes both abruptly and significantly.

definicion: A general desription of the geophysical anomaly.
descripcion: A geophysical anomaly is an area where one or more geophysical parameters differ from the surroundings due to inhomogeneities in the underground composition.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that has no restrictions on lexicality or length.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a character string. For example: Golden Gate Bridge.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of a geophysical anomaly based on its observed characteristics.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geophysical anomaly type.

dominio.definicion: A difference between the observed (measured) gravity values and those calculated from the assumed Earth's model.
dominio.observaciones: The gravity anomalies are related to the differences in the subsurface mass distribution and are considered to be representing the variations.

dominio.definicion: A magnetic field remaining after allowance for some particular model (for example: the International Geomagnetic Reference Field).
dominio.observaciones: Strong magnetic anomalies are caused by magnetic geological features.

dominio.definicion: Deviation in the abundance of gamma rays with different specific energy values, caused by deviations in contents of the radioactive elements K, U and Th in the rock.
Deviation in ground electromagnetic field, induced from distant transmitters.
dominio.observaciones: For example: Very Low Frequency (VLF) and Horizontal loop method (HLEM) anomalies. Anomalies are used for tracking steep fracture zones or electrically leading zones.

dominio.definicion: Deviations in an electric ground potential field created by a locally transmitted electric current.
dominio.observaciones: The resistivity depends on rock type or type of sediment.

dominio.definicion: Deviations in the movement of the ground.

definicion: A description of the unique administrative circumstances of a geopolitical entity, if any.
descripcion: For example, for a dependent political entity the controlling political entity and the scope(s) of the control.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that may contain lexical characters and is 4095 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of a legally recognized geopolitical entity (for example: a State or a zone).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geopolitical entity type.

dominio.definicion: A territory that is not subject to a State.
dominio.observaciones: For example, Antarctica.

dominio.definicion: A territory governed by a subordinate administrative division in a State or other political entity.
A strip of territory in a border area where military activity is precluded.
dominio.observaciones: One of the lines in a DMZ generally serves as a line of separation (for example: armistice control, withdrawal or cease-fire line). For example, two two-kilometre-wide DMZs have existed on either side of the Military Demarcation Line between North and South Korea since the signing of the Armistice in July 1953.

dominio.definicion: A newly conquered territory under the control of an armed force.
A territory leased by one State from another.
dominio.observaciones: For example, leased by the United Kingdom from the People's Republic of China to form part of Hong Kong.

dominio.definicion: A State characterized by amorphous or nonexistent political organization, undetermined sovereignty, or indefinite territory.
dominio.observaciones: In particular, not recognized as an independent State by the United States.

dominio.definicion: A State that is constitutionally dependent on an independent State.
dominio.observaciones: For example New Caledonia, an overseas territory of France since 1956.

dominio.definicion: A self-governing State characterized by the traits of an independent political entity, that has entered into an association with another independent political entity for the conduct of certain affairs of state (for example: defence or foreign policy).
A territory constituting an independent State.
dominio.observaciones: In particular, a people politically organized into a sovereign State with a definite territory recognized as independent by the United States.

dominio.definicion: A State, within an independent State, characterized by a significantly high degree of political and constitutional autonomy in most affairs of state.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region as of 1 July 1997 and the Macau Special Administrative Region as of 20 December 1999.

dominio.definicion: A supranational region established, usually by treaty, principally to achieve a common basis for economic activity.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the European Union (EU) and the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA).

dominio.definicion: An area of land whose political status will be determined by future negotiation.
dominio.observaciones: Territory may include any geographical area under the jurisdiction of a sovereign and does not necessarily have a political division status. Currently limited in US State Department application to the Gaza Strip and the West Bank.

dominio.definicion: A delimited area separating two political entities or territories, within which certain activities are limited or prohibited.
dominio.observaciones: For example, military presence is minimal or absent. Currently limited in US State Department application to No Man's Land and the Gibraltar-Spain Neutral Zone.

definicion: The type of a geopolitical dividing line (for example: a boundary or a line of separation) based on the nature of its establishment and/or recognition.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a geopolitical line type.

dominio.definicion: A boundary separating subordinate administrative divisions (for example: a state, county, township, province, district, territory, and oblast) in a State or other geopolitical entity.
dominio.observaciones: States are generally divided into first-, second- and lower-order administrative divisions. With only minor exceptions (Egypt-Sudan, Kenya-Sudan), administrative boundaries are contiguous with international boundaries. In rarer instances, administrative boundaries serve in lieu of international boundaries (Ethiopia-Somalia and the former Oman-UAE boundaries).

dominio.definicion: A line of separation separating subordinate administrative divisions where two States or other political entities have agreed to a non-prejudicial de facto boundary while pending final de jure settlement.
dominio.observaciones: For example, between Somalia and Ethiopia.

dominio.definicion: A form of military disengagement line established by opposing groups as a result of an armistice (a temporary peace agreement).
dominio.observaciones: For example, the Armistice Line established in 1949 in the Middle East.

dominio.definicion: A line of separation between military forces that has been agreed by both forces but not necessarily accompanied by a cessation of hostilities.
dominio.observaciones: For example, between India and Pakistan in Kashmir established as a result of the Simla talks in 1972 that clearly delimited the 1949 Cease Fire Line with minor modifications.

dominio.definicion: A form of military disengagement line established by opposing groups as a result of the cessation of hostilities.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the Military Demarcation Line established in 1953 between North and South Korea.

dominio.definicion: A line created when political or military powers cannot quickly or easily agree to an alternate line of separation between contending parties.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the 38th parallel was created as a line of convenience between communist and democratic forces on the Korean peninsula in 1945.

dominio.definicion: A line established where active hostilities have been suspended, but where an armistice line has not yet been agreed.

datatype.estructura: Formatted in accordance with ISO 8601:2000, 5.4.1, Combinations of date and time of day - Complete representation - Extended format, a calendar date and time representation, as a single data element comprising up to twenty characters, where [YYYY] represents a calendar year, [MM] the ordinal number of a calendar month within the calendar year, [DD] the ordinal number of a day within the calendar month, [hh] the ordinal number of an hour within the calendar day, [mm] the ordinal number of a minute within the hour, [ss] the ordinal number of a second within the minute, and an optional 'Z' when the time is according to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), as 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ' (for example: '1985-04-12T11:45:20Z' for 11 hours, 45 minutes and 20 seconds UTC on 12 April 1985). Representations with reduced precision may be used in accordance with 5.4.2 (for example: '1985-04-12' for 12 April 1985). Representations consistently using basic format (eliminating the hyphen '-' and the colon ':') may be used in accordance with 5.4.1 (for example: '19850412T114520Z').

definicion: The class of a helicopter based on its performance during a critical power unit failure after take-off.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a helicopter performance class.

dominio.definicion: A helicopter with performance such that, in case of engine failure, it is able to land on the rejected take-off area or safely continue the flight to an appropriate landing area.

A helicopter with performance such that, in case of engine failure, it is able to safely continue the flight, except when the failure occurs prior to a defined point after take-off or after a defined point before landing, in which cases a forced landing may be required.
A helicopter with performance such that, in case of engine failure at any point in the flight profile, a forced landing must be performed.

dominio.definicion: An aerodrome or a defined place on a structure intended to be used wholly or in part for the arrival, departure, and/or surface movement of helicopters.
An aerodrome on land intended to be used either wholly or in part for the arrival, departure and surface movement of aircraft.
An institution or establishment providing inpatient medical or surgical treatment for the ill or wounded.
A building or facility other than a hospital.
A superstructure fitted for drilling or lifting operations for extraction and/or exploitation of natural resources.
A mooring structure used by tankers to load and unload in port approaches or in offshore oil and/or gas fields.
dominio.observaciones: The size of the structure may vary between that of a large mooring buoy and that of a manned structure that may be either floating or fixed to the sea bed.

dominio.definicion: A self-contained floatable or floating drilling machine that appears as an offshore working platform when in position for operations.
dominio.observaciones: Constructed in many forms, for example, as a jackup, a semisubmersible, and as a fully submersible.

dominio.definicion: An artificial structure that is located offshore.
dominio.observaciones: It usually has a surface that is raised above the sea and may be used as a working stage for conducting offshore operations (for example: drilling for petroleum and/or natural gas, loading and/or unloading vessels, or navigation support).

dominio.definicion: An installation supporting aircraft capable of taking off and landing on water.

datatype.estructura: Formatted in accordance with ISO 8601:2000, 5.2.1, Calendar date - month, as a single data element comprising five characters as two pairs of digits separated by a solidus ('/') where the first [MM] digit-pair represents the ordinal number of a calendar month within the calendar year, and the second [MM] digit-pair the ordinal number of a subsequent calendar month within the same or subsequent calendar year, as 'MM/MM' (for example: '03/09' for March through September). Either of the months may be left unspecified by the use of '--' (for example: '11/--' for November through an unspecified ending month).

definicion: The elevation from a specified vertical datum to the highest point on a feature.
descripcion: In the case of multiple features that may be stacked on each other (for example: a railway on a bridge, a superstructure on a building, or an aerial on a tower) the highest elevation is that of the entire feature stack. For example, the highest elevation of a church is that of its steeple and not that of the roof of the church itself. The church itself may have a height above surface level that excludes the additional height of the steeple superstructure located on the church roof.

definicion: The recognized historic significance of a site and/or facility, if any.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an historic significance.

dominio.definicion: Belonging to, and dating from, times long past.
dominio.observaciones: Generally of many hundreds, if not thousands, of years of age.

dominio.definicion: Designated as historic by a recognized authority.
dominio.observaciones: Generally of only a few hundred years of age or less.

dominio.definicion: Not ancient or otherwise of historic significance.
The site of a land battle of historic importance.
A site that has significance because of its association with an historic military event or activity other than a specific battle and its associated battlefield.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the (US) WWII Memorial, the (US) Vietnam Memorial, the (US) Marine Corps Memorial, Trafalger Square, the Arc d'Triomphe, and historical military facilities such as Hadrian's Wall, the Great Wall of China, and (US) Ft. McHenry.

dominio.definicion: A site that has significance because of its association with an historic political event or activity.
dominio.observaciones: For example, Lenin's Tomb, the Watergate Hotel, and Fords Theater.

dominio.definicion: A site that has significance because of its general importance to a nation.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the Statue of Liberty, the St. Louis Arch, the Brandenburg Gate, and Westminster Abbey.

dominio.definicion: A site that has significance because of its association with a religious event or activity.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the Western Wall, the Jordan River, and Lourdes.

definicion: The type of a potential or actual hostile incident.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a hostile incident type.

dominio.definicion: A violent public disorder.
dominio.observaciones: Usually involving a large crowd.

dominio.definicion: A surprise attack from concealment.
The explosion of land mines.
dominio.observaciones: A land mine is a receptacle containing explosive placed in or on the ground with the purpose of destroying enemy personnel and/or vehicles.

dominio.definicion: The explosion of an Improvised Explosive Device (IED).
dominio.observaciones: A bomb constructed and deployed in ways other than in conventional military action. It may be partially comprised of conventional military explosives, such as an artillery round, attached to a detonating mechanism.

dominio.definicion: An attack from a concealed shooter.
A violent conflict between local groups.
dominio.observaciones: Usually an autonomous ethnic group defined by linguistic and cultural characteristics.

dominio.definicion: A violent attack on the public with the goal of coercing the community or government.
An individual intent on taking their own life while causing maximal collateral damage.
Wilful or malicious destruction or damage to goods or property.
The use of a vehicle to cause damage.
dominio.observaciones: Usually with the aim of gaining access.

dominio.definicion: The act of illegally carrying off or leading away a person.
dominio.observaciones: Generally with the purpose of coercion.

dominio.definicion: The act of holding people in a place against their will.
dominio.observaciones: Always with the purpose of coercion gain on negociation.

dominio.definicion: An armed attack against a property or individual for financial gain.
The act of seizing control of a means of transport by force.
The act of sabotaging the network of utility.
dominio.observaciones: Includes jamming electronic communication.

dominio.definicion: The act of poisoning the water distribution network.
Chemical, Biological, Radiological, or Nuclear (CBRN) attack.
A planned public gathering with the aim of objecting to a specific issue or promoting a set of opinions or beliefs.
An act of intent to block the passage of vehicles and/or people.
dominio.observaciones: Generally done by any available movable materials (for example: cars or building materials) causing an obstruction for transportation network or buildings.

dominio.definicion: Direct enemy fire with hand guns (for example pistols and/or rifles) or anti-tank weapons (RPG).
Indirect enemy fire usually by artillery, mortar and/or missiles.
Location where unexploded devices (for example grenades, bombs and/or ammunition) except mines were found.

definicion: The type of a house of worship based on its use, structure and/or religious denomination served.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a house of worship type.

dominio.definicion: A large, imposing building functioning as a place of worship.
A Christian place of worship, usually smaller than a church, and especially one that is attached to a larger building (for example: a private house and/or an institution).
A building functioning as a place of worship for public, especially Christian, worship.
A shrine marking the burial place of an Islamic holy man.
A tall tower or turret connected with a mosque and surrounded by one or more projecting balconies from which a muezzin calls at hours of prayer.
A set of dwellings, buildings, and/or other structures that houses a community under religious vows.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a monastery or a convent.

dominio.definicion: An Islamic place of worship.
A Hindu or Buddhist temple or sacred building, usually in the form of a many-tiered tower with stories of diminishing size, each with an ornamented projecting roof.
A place of worship or devotion to a saint or deity.
A church that has been specially designated by religious authority.
A building regarded primarily as the dwelling-place, or devoted to the worship, of a god or gods.
A place for Jewish worship and religious instruction.
A round, usually dome-shaped, Buddhist shrine topped with a cupola.

definicion: The type of a hulk or permanently moored vessel based on its structure and/or use(s).
descripcion: For example, in the 19th Century with the advent of the steel-hulled steam-propelled warship, many proud first class ships-of-the-line were permanently moored, demasted, and turned into floating barracks or even prisons and/or brigs.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a hulk type.

dominio.definicion: A permanently moored floating structure (for example: an old ship) that is used as a restaurant.
A ship of historical interest permanently moored as a tourist attraction.
A permanently moored floating structure (for example: an old ship) that is used as a museum.
A permanently moored floating structure (for example: an old ship) that is used for accommodation.
dominio.observaciones: For example, as a hotel or for temporary housing.

dominio.definicion: A permanently moored floating structure, often constructed from old ships, used as a breakwater.
A permanently moored floating structure (for example: a specially constructed barge) that is used for gambling, often including other amenities.

A permanently moored floating structure that is used as an establishment, especially of a comfortable or luxurious kind, where paying visitors are provided with accommodation, meals, and/or other services.
A permanently moored floating structure (for example: an old ship) that is used for the storage of products and/or supplies.
A permanently moored floating structure (for example: an old ship) that is used as an institution or establishment providing inpatient medical or surgical treatment for the ill or wounded.
A permanently moored floating structure (for example: an old ship) that is used for relatively temporary occupancy.
dominio.observaciones: For example, to house military personnel.

dominio.definicion: A ship that has been abandoned at sea.
dominio.observaciones: It may be large enough to constitute a menace to navigation.

definicion: The Human Development Index (HDI) value within an area, as a category.
descripcion: It is used as a comparative measure of life expectancy, literacy, education, and standard of living for countries worldwide; as a standard means of measuring well-being, especially child welfare; and to determine and indicate whether a country is a developed, developing, or underdeveloped country and also to measure the impact of economic policies on quality of life.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a human development index.

dominio.definicion: HDI greater than or equal to 0.8, indicating a highly industrialized country, but with a very high per capita income.
HDI greater than or equal to 0.8, indicating a highly industrialized country with a relatively high per capita income.
HDI roughly equal to 0.8, indicating a developing industrialized country, but with only a medium per capita income.
HDI less than 0.8 and greater than or equal to 0.5, indicating a relatively low level industrialization, and with insufficient ecological structure.
HDI less than 0.5, indicating a developing country with no significant industrialization, and with wide spread poverty below the subsistence level.

definicion: The type(s) of a possible danger to human activity (for example: slipping) which may be present due to naturally occuring conditions (for example: algae covered rocks).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a human hazard.

dominio.definicion: Superficial damage to the skin, generally not penetrating deeper than the epidermis.

Marine life that pose hazards to man by direct contact (for example: jellyfish and sponges), injection (for example: stingrays and scorpionfish), by indirect contact with toxins produced by microorganisms (for example: pfiesteria and prorocentrum) or by predatorial animals (for example: sharks and barracudas).
dominio.observaciones: Waste and foreign species discharged in ballast water from ships (when purging procedures are not followed) are also considered a biological hazard.

dominio.definicion: Death caused by the filling of the lungs by a liquid causing the interruption of the body's exchange of oxygen from the air leading to asphyxia.
The situation of being physically unable to exit a site due to snagging and/or by being hampered by clothing or equipment.
Surfaces and/or protrusions are present that would puncture a person and/or their equipment under normal contact.
The area is susceptible to slick conditions and tripping hazards.
dominio.observaciones: For example, where algae is growing on a rock and a slip hazard exists.

definicion: The type of an administrative region based on the humanitarian relief organization that manages the region and provides relief efforts in the area.

datatype.nombre: Humanitarian Relief Administrative Region Type Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain category denoting a humanitarian relief administrative region type.

dominio.definicion: A territorial region where humanitarian relief is provided under the administrative control of the American Red Cross.
dominio.observaciones: The American Red Cross is a volunteer-led humanitarian organization providing relief to victims of disaster and helping people prevent, prepare for, and respond to emergencies. It operates by Congressional Charter in accordance with the treaties of Geneva, August 22, 1864, July 27, 1929, and August 12, 1949, establishing the Fundamental Principles of the International Red Cross Movement.

definicion: The height from a specified sounding datum to the bottom or base of a feature (for example: the base of a lighthouse).

definicion: The type of a hyperbolic sonar echo.
descripcion: Many areas of the sea floor return hyperbolic echoes. A wide variety of types and sizes are observed and range from small, barely resolvable hyperbole to large, quasi-hyperbolic forms. Hyperbolic echoes are returned from areas of gently undulating to rugged sea floor morphology. The type, size, and spacing of hyperbolic echo returns are dependant on several parameters including: water depth, amplitude, wavelength, spacing, shape and orientation of sea floor undulations, ship speed, ship course, and width of acoustic beam. In many instances hyperbolae are caused by the rugged structural morphology of surface features (for example: rugged seamounts, basement highs, and escarpments); such hyperbolae have no relationship to near-bottom sedimentation processes. However, many regions which return hyperbolae, especially continental rises, basin floors, and abyssal gaps, have thick sequences of undeformed, relatively flat-lying sediments beneath the sea floor. In these regions the hyperbolae are reflected from erosional/depositional bed forms created largely by deep thermohaline-induced flow (contour currents), or less commonly by downslope processes (for example: turbidity currents and slumps).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a hyperbolic echo type.

definicion: The type of a hypsographic portrayal line (for example: a contour line) based on the topography represented and/or portrayal interval.
descripcion: A contour line is an imaginary line on the ground connecting an infinite number of points of equal elevation. The vertical measurement between two contour lines is called the contour interval. Contour lines are numbered to indicate the elevation value of the contour line.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a hypsography portrayal type.

dominio.definicion: An accentuated subset of the contour lines, typically every fourth or fifth contour line depending on the contour interval, as an aid in identifying contour lines of different elevations.
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted by increased line weight. With few exceptions, index contour lines are continuous throughout a map even though the contour lines may coalesce (to carrying contour lines) because of steep slopes.

dominio.definicion: One of the three or four contour lines between adjacent index contour lines.
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted with about half the line weight of an index contour line. An intermediate contour line is normally continuous throughout a map, but may be dropped or joined with another contour line where the slope is steep and where there is insufficient space to show all of the intermediate contour lines.

dominio.definicion: An auxiliary contour line with one half the contour interval between intermediate contour lines.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a 20 metre intermediate contour interval and a 10 metre auxiliary contour interval.

dominio.definicion: A line depicting the estimated configuration of elevations between contour lines.
A closed index contour line delimiting an area of lower elevation than the surrounding terrain (a terrain depression) out of which there is no surface drainage.
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted with perpendicular ticks on the descending side of the depression index contour line, while maintaining index contour line weight.

dominio.definicion: A closed intermediate contour line delimiting an area of lower elevation than the surrounding terrain (a terrain depression) out of which there is no surface drainage.
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted with perpendicular ticks on the descending side of the depression intermediate contour line, while maintaining intermediate contour line weight.

dominio.definicion: A contour line substituted for a normal index contour line whenever there is a question as to its reliability (for example: due to glacial ice or cloud cover).
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted as a broken line while maintaining index contour line weight.

dominio.definicion: A closed index contour line delimiting a localized area of higher elevation than the surrounding terrain (a terrain mound) into which there is no surface drainage.
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted with perpendicular ticks on the descending side of the mound index contour line, while maintaining index contour line weight.

dominio.definicion: A closed intermediate contour line delimiting a localized area of higher elevation than the surrounding terrain (a terrain mound) into which there is no surface drainage.
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted with perpendicular ticks on the descending side of the mound intermediate contour line, while maintaining intermediate contour line weight.

dominio.definicion: A contour line substituted for a normal intermediate contour line whenever there is a question as to its reliability (for example: due to glacial ice or cloud cover).
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted as a broken line while maintaining intermediate contour line weight.

dominio.definicion: A contour line substituted for a normal auxiliary contour line whenever there is a question as to its reliability (for example: due to glacial ice or cloud cover).

dominio.aliases: Indefinite Auxiliary Contour, Approximate Supplementary Contour, Indefinite Supplementary Contour

dominio.definicion: An auxiliary contour line with one quarter the interval between intermediate contour lines.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a 20 metre intermediate contour interval and a 5 metre auxiliary contour interval.

dominio.definicion: A closed contour line substituted for a normal depression index contour line whenever there is a question as to its reliability (for example: due to glacial ice or cloud cover).
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted as a broken line while maintaining depression index contour line weight and associated perpendicular ticks.

dominio.definicion: A contour line that is used to portray important relief characteristics that would not otherwise be shown by index and intermediate contour lines.
dominio.observaciones: It is used in areas of extremely low relief (for example: in flat areas such as the North American Prairies) to assist the proper depiction of the slope of the land. An auxilary contour line is typically depicted as a screened line so that it is distinguishable from index and intermediate contour lines and not unduly prominent.

dominio.definicion: A closed contour line substituted for a normal depression auxiliary contour line whenever there is a question as to its reliability (for example: due to glacial ice or cloud cover).
dominio.observaciones: It is typically depicted as a broken line while maintaining depression intermediate contour line weight and associated perpendicular ticks.

dominio.observaciones: A carrying contour is used to portray a terrain area of steep (near vertical) slope (for example: a cliff).

dominio.definicion: A single contour line representing two or more auxiliary contour lines with different elevation values.
dominio.observaciones: A carrying contour is used to portray a terrain area of steep (near vertical) slope (for example: a cliff).

dominio.observaciones: A carrying contour is used to portray a terrain area of steep (near vertical) slope (for example: a cliff).

dominio.observaciones: It is used in terrain depressions of extremely low relief to assist the proper depiction of the slope of the land. dominio.definicion: A closed contour line substituted for a normal depression auxiliary contour line whenever there is a question as to its reliability (for example: due to glacial ice or cloud cover).
