dominio.observaciones: For example, a ditch or a canal.

dominio.definicion: Serves to drain the land.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a ditch.

dominio.definicion: Serves to collect, store or supply drinking water.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a reservoir.

dominio.definicion: Serves to collect, store or supply water for energy production.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a reservoir used by a hydroelectric power plant.

dominio.definicion: Serves as a barrier.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a moat.

dominio.definicion: Serves to prevent the flooding of land areas.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a flood detention basin or a spill-way.

dominio.definicion: Serves to collect, store or supply water for firefighting.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a fire water pond.

dominio.definicion: Used for the natural evaporation of water for the collection of salt.
Serves as the reservoir in a lock, bounded by lock walls and lock gates.
Serves as a water body in which people may swim.

Serves for the production process involving the culturing or farming (including harvesting) of aquatic organisms (for example: fish, molluscs, crustaceans, plants, crocodiles, alligators or amphibians) using techniques designed to increase the production.
dominio.observaciones: Culturing or farming refers to the rearing of individuals up to their juvenile and/or adult phase under captive conditions. In addition, it also encompasses individual, corporate or state ownership of the individual organisms throughout the rearing or culture stage, up to and including harvesting.

dominio.definicion: Serves for the treatment of water that consists of a bed of material (for example: sand) where water is filtered.
Serves for manufacturing and/or production.

definicion: An indication that a feature in an inland waterbody is an obstruction to vessel movement.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of an inland water based on its principal characteristics.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an inland water type.

dominio.definicion: A large body of water entirely surrounded by land.
dominio.observaciones: Usually larger than or equal to 15,625 square metres in extent.

dominio.definicion: A small body of generally still water entirely surrounded by land.
dominio.observaciones: Its bed is either hollowed out of the soil or formed by embanking and damming up a natural hollow (for example: by a beaver dam). Usually smaller than 15,625 square metres in extent.

dominio.definicion: A body of water entirely surrounded by land which is undifferentiated as to whether it is a lake, pond, or reservoir.
dominio.observaciones: Its bed is either hollowed out of the soil or formed by embanking and damming up a natural hollow, gorge, or river valley and may be of any size.

dominio.definicion: A substantial body of water impounded by a dam in which water is collected and stored for use.
dominio.observaciones: Used for flood control and/or as a source of water for irrigation, industrial processes, and/or human consumption.

dominio.definicion: A type of inland water constructed with a continuous man-made shoreline around its entire perimeter.
dominio.observaciones: It is usually surrounded by embankments. Basins are typically used to store water for irrigation, watering livestock, and less commonly for human consumption.

dominio.definicion: A small natural terrain depression in which water collects, especially a pool where animals come to drink.
A large expanse of saline water that is entirely surrounded by land and lacks a natural outlet.
dominio.observaciones: It may be intermittently connected with an ocean. Examples include the Aral, Caspian, Dead and Salton Seas, the Sea of Galilee, and the Great Salt Lake.

dominio.definicion: A natural flowing watercourse.
An artificial waterway with no flow, or a controlled flow, usable or built for navigation.
A pipe or artificial channel that is designed to transport water from a remote source, usually by gravity, for freshwater supply, agricultural, and/or industrial use.
dominio.observaciones: It may be supported by a bridge.

dominio.definicion: An artificial channel for a current of water, especially one built to provide water for industrial or agricultural purposes or for transporting water-borne materials.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a sluice, a flume, or a tailrace.

dominio.definicion: An artificial waterway with no flow, or a controlled flow, usually unlined, used for draining or irrigating land.

definicion: The type of an installation buoy based on structure and/or intended use.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an installation buoy type.

dominio.definicion: Incorporates a large buoy which remains on the surface at all times and is moored by 4 or more anchors.
dominio.observaciones: Mooring hawsers and cargo hoses lead from a turntable on top of the buoy, so that the buoy does not turn as the ship swings to wind and stream.

dominio.definicion: A mooring structure used by tankers to load and unload in port approaches or in offshore oil and gas fields.
dominio.observaciones: The size of the structure can vary between a large mooring buoy and a manned floating structure.

definicion: The name of the company or authority operating an installation.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that may contain lexical characters and is 255 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The function of a significant point within an Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP).
descripcion: For example: initial approach fix, final approach fix, or missed approach point.

datatype.nombre: Instrument Approach Procedure (IAP) Fix Role Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an instrument approach procedure fix role.

dominio.definicion: That fix or point of an instrument approach procedure where the final approach segment commences.
The fix or point that identifies the beginning of the instrument approach procedure.
The fix or point that identifies the beginning of the intermediate approach segment of an instrument approach procedure.
The point on the final approach course that signifies the termination of the final approach and the commencement of the missed approach segment.

nombre: Instrument Landing System (ILS) Facility Performance Category
definicion: The category of the operations indicating the precision required for defined decision heights and visibility requirements.
descripcion: For example: CAT I, CAT II, or CAT III.

datatype.nombre: Instrument Landing System (ILS) Facility Performance Category Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an instrument landing system facility performance category.

dominio.definicion: A facility which provides guidance information from the coverage limit of the ILS to the point at which the localizer course line intersects the ILS glide path at a height of 60 metres (200 feet) above the horizontal plane containing the threshold, and with either a visibility not less than 800 metres or a runway visual range not less than 550 metres.
dominio.observaciones: ILS or MLS are the facilities that provide guidance information.

dominio.definicion: A facility which provides guidance information from the coverage limit of the ILS to the point at which the localizer course line intersects the ILS glide path at a height of 60 metres (200 feet) but not lower than 30 metres (100 feet) above the horizontal plane containing the threshold and a runway visual range not less than 350 metres.
dominio.observaciones: ILS or MLS are the facilities that provide guidance information.

dominio.definicion: An ILS which, with the aid of ancillary equipment where necessary, provides guidance information from the coverage limit of the facility to, and along, the surface of the runway.
dominio.observaciones: ILS or MLS are the facilities that provide guidance information.

dominio.definicion: An ILS which, with the aid of ancillary equipment where necessary, provides guidance information from the coverage limit of the facility to, and along, the surface of the runway.
dominio.observaciones: This operation requires a decision height lower than 30 metres (100 feet), or no decision height; and runway visual range not less than 200 metres. ILS or MLS are the facilities that provide guidance information.

dominio.definicion: An ILS which, with the aid of ancillary equipment where necessary, provides guidance information from the coverage limit of the facility to, and along, the surface of the runway.
dominio.observaciones: This operation requires a decision height lower than 15 metres (50 feet), or no decision height; and a runway visual range less than 200 metres but not less than 50 metres. ILS or MLS are the facilities that provide guidance information.

dominio.definicion: An ILS which, with the aid of ancillary equipment where necessary, provides guidance information from the coverage limit of the facility to, and along, the surface of the runway.
dominio.observaciones: This operation requires no decision height; and runway visual range less than 200 metres. ILS or MLS are the facilities that provide guidance information.

dominio.definicion: A Microwave Landing System(MLS) which provides guidance information for an approach to a height above touchdown of not less than 60 metres (200 feet) and a runway visual range of not less than 550 metres (1,800 feet).

nombre: Instrument Landing System (ILS) Glide Path Angle
definicion: The angle between a straight line which represents the mean of the Instrument Landing System (ILS) glide path and the horizontal plane at the base of the glide slope antenna.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

nombre: Instrument Landing System (ILS) Glide Path Angle Accuracy
definicion: The accuracy of the angle of the Instrument Landing System (ILS) glide path installation emission, as compared to the published glide path angle.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value that is restricted to be non-negative.
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of an angle in two dimensions (the angle between two half-lines terminating at the same point).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of plane angle equal to pi/180, approximately 0.01745532925199433 radians.

nombre: Instrument Landing System (ILS) Reference Datum Height
definicion: The height of a point that is located above the intersection of the runway centre line and the threshold and through which the downward extended straight portion of the glide path passes.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

nombre: Instrument Landing System (ILS) Reference Datum Height Accuracy
definicion: The accuracy of the iInstrument Landing System (ILS) Reference Datum Height (RDH), as compared to the published reference datum height location.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value that is restricted to be non-negative.
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The set(s) of additional equipment needed to fly the instrument procedure in addition to that stated in the procedure name.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an instrument procedure additional equipment.

dominio.definicion: ADF required.

dominio.etiqueta: Automatic Direction Finder (ADF) for Missed Approach
dominio.definicion: ADF required for missed approach.

dominio.etiqueta: Automatic Direction Finder (ADF) for ILS Approach
dominio.definicion: ADF required for ILS approach.
DME required.
Dual ADF required.

dominio.etiqueta: Dual Automatic Direction Finder (ADF) and Distance Measuring Equipment (DME)
dominio.definicion: DME and dual ADF required for LOC approach.
Dual VHF communication required.

dominio.etiqueta: Dual VHF Omnidirectional Radio (VOR) Beacon with Distance Measuring Equipment (VORDME)
dominio.definicion: Dual VOR or VOR/DME required.

dominio.etiqueta: Global Position System (GPS) or Reduced Navigation Performance (RNP3) Equipment
dominio.definicion: GPS or RNP-0.3 required.
Radar required.
Radar or DME required.
Radar or RNAV required.
Special aircraft and aircrew certification required.

dominio.etiqueta: VHF Omnidirectional Radio (VOR) Beacon and ILS Localizer (VORLOC)
dominio.definicion: VOR and localizer required.

definicion: The purpose(s) of a route.
descripcion: Route may include more than one mode of transportation.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an intended route use.

dominio.definicion: Used to transport cargo (for example: automobiles or equipment), including bulk industrial materials (for example: cement, coal, or chemicals).
A route designated for evacuation operations.
dominio.observaciones: For example: evacuation routes which have been planned in case of natural disaster.

dominio.definicion: Use of a route to access installations for servicing equipment.
dominio.observaciones: For example: a route dedicated to access a wind farm.

dominio.definicion: Use of a route for the movement of military forces and materiel to and within operational areas.
dominio.observaciones: For example: transportation of equipment into theatre.

dominio.definicion: Use of a route in pursuit of monitoring an area.
dominio.observaciones: For example: a guard route.

dominio.definicion: Carrying passengers along a transportation route.
dominio.observaciones: Includes public and private transport.

dominio.definicion: A journey made to a sacred place as an act of religious devotion.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the holy pilgrimage to Mecca.

dominio.definicion: Movement as an activity or pastime pursued, habitually, for the pleasure or interest it gives.
A route designated for rescue operations.
dominio.observaciones: The route may be reserved for emergency services.

definicion: An indication that a feature (for example: a tunnel or a building) is artificially illuminated inside.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The total number of international aerodromes within an area.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: An indication that the route is part of the regional network of Air Traffic Service (ATS) routes, as defined by the ICAO regional Air Navigation Plan (ANP).

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of an interstate conflict within an area.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an international conflict type.

dominio.definicion: An organised armed and violent conflict for different reasons settled between two or more States.
A momentous juncture in, for example, politics, commerce, or domestic affairs.
The state of imminent evolution of a non-violent (non-warlike) confrontation into violent confrontation (war).

nombre: International Gravimetric Bureau (IGB) Unique Station Code
definicion: A unique identification number, assigned by the IGB, that is used to identify a base gravity station for reference in relation to a survey point.

datatype.nombre: International Gravimetric Bureau (IGB) Unique Station Code Structured Text
datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying an International Gravimetric Bureau (IGB) unique station code.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: A 6 digit positive (non-zero) integer.

definicion: The name(s) of the international organisation(s) of geopolitical importance of which the nation is a member.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an international organisation membership.

dominio.definicion: An association of 22 arab states (since 1945) for political, cultural, social economical and defence purposes.

dominio.etiqueta: Association of South East Asian Nations (ASEAN)
dominio.definicion: A geo-political and economic organization of 10 countries located in Southeast Asia, that was formed on August 8, 1967 by Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, and Thailand.
An organization consisting of fifty-three African states established in 2001 and formed as a successor to the amalgamated African Economic Community (AEC) and the Organisation of African Unity (OAU).
A loose confederation of nations that were formerly members of the British Empire (with one exception: Mozambique, which was a Portuguese possession).

A supranational and intergovernmental union of 27 nation-states in Europe that was established in 1992 by the Treaty on European Union (The Maastricht Treaty), and it is the de facto successor to the six-member European Economic Community.
A meeting of the heads of State or government of the European Union, and the President of the European Commission.

A military alliance established by the signing of the North Atlantic Treaty on 4 April 1949 based on a system of collective defence whereby its member states agree to mutual defense in response to an attack by any external party.
A member of NATO not participating through direct force integration.

A programme of practical bilateral cooperation between individual Partner countries and NATO that allows partner countries to establish an individual relationship with NATO, choosing their own priorities for cooperation.
An association of countries in the western hemisphere that was created in 1948 to promote military and economic and social and cultural cooperation.

dominio.etiqueta: Organisation of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC)
dominio.definicion: An organization of countries formed in 1961 to agree on a common policy for the production and sale of petroleum.

dominio.etiqueta: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
dominio.definicion: A group of 30 member countries sharing a commitment to democratic government and the market economy.
An international organization whose stated aims are to facilitate co-operation in international law, international security, economic development, social progress and human rights issues.

dominio.etiqueta: United Nations Security Council (UNSC) Permanent Member
dominio.definicion: A permanent member of the organ of the United Nations (U.N.) charged with maintaining peace and security among nations.
An international organization designed to supervise and liberalize international trade.

A Country that is not yet member of the European Union (EU) but has been imposed standards with regard to higher economical stability and political consolidation in order to ensure convergence to the EU.

dominio.etiqueta: European Union Partnership and Cooperation Agreement (PCA)
dominio.definicion: A legal Partnership and Cooperation Agreement (PCA) framework, based on the respect of democratic principles and human rights, setting out the political, economic and trade relationship between the European Union (EU) and its partner countries.
dominio.observaciones: Each PCA is a ten-year bilateral treaty signed and ratified by the EU and the individual state.

dominio.etiqueta: African, Caribbean and Pacific (ACP) Group of States
dominio.definicion: The African, Caribbean and Pacific Group of States (ACP) is composed of signatories to the Georgetown Agreement (1975) or the Partnership Agreement between the ACP and the European Union, officially termed the 'ACP-EC Partnership Agreement'.
An economic treaty between Canada, the United States, and Mexico to lower tariffs and create a free trade environment.
dominio.observaciones: The North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) was ratified by its member nations in 1994.

definicion: The type of route intersection traffic control based on the method(s) of warning and/or control.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an intersection control type.

dominio.definicion: Active signs, barriers, and/or lights at the intersection are used to control passage through the intersection.
dominio.observaciones: The signal devices (for example: stop lights) may be operated on a fixed schedule or may be sensitive to traffic conditions.

dominio.definicion: Signs adjacent to, or prior to arrival at, the intersection are used to control traffic by requiring that all vehicles stop before entering.
dominio.observaciones: Once stopped, vehicle drivers are expected to follow 'rules of the road' to determine order of precedence for passage through the intersection. The signs are usually fixed and generally unlighted.

dominio.definicion: The intersection is not controlled.
dominio.observaciones: Vehicle drivers must negotiate the intersection without guidance.

dominio.definicion: Markings on the route surface prior to arrival at the intersection are used to control intersection passage.
dominio.observaciones: The markings may, for example, indicate either yielding to other traffic before entering or stopping before entering and then following the 'rules of the road' to determine order of precedence for passage through the intersection.

dominio.definicion: Signs adjacent to, or prior to arrival at, the intersection are used to control traffic by requiring that all vehicles yield to crossing traffic.
dominio.observaciones: The signs are usually fixed and generally unlighted.

dominio.definicion: Signs placed along a route indicating that cars approaching from crossroads must yield before entering an intersection with the priority route.

definicion: A date on which a tract was inundated by water.

datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying an inundation date.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: Formatted in accordance with ISO 8601:2000, 5.2.1.1, Basic format, as a single numeric data element comprising eight digits, where [YYYY] represents a calendar year, [MM] the ordinal number of a calendar month within the calendar year, and [DD] the ordinal number of a day within the calendar month' as 'YYYYMMDD' (for example: '19850412' for 12 April 1985). Representations with reduced precision may be used in accordance with 5.2.1.2.a as 'YYYY-MM' (for example: '1985-04' for April 1985) or in accordance with 5.2.1.2.b as 'YYYY' (for example: '1985' for 1985).

definicion: The type of an inundation based on the cause of the flooding.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an inundation type.

dominio.definicion: A tract that may be flooded by either the regulation of the level of water or by the planned release of water impounded by a dam.
A tract that may be covered by naturally occurring flood water, excluding tidal waters.

definicion: The ratio of the area of crop irrigation relative to an entire area of cropland.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: A dimensionless quantity (a quantity with the dimension of 1).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A scaled dimensionless measure denoting one part in every hundred.

definicion: The method used to supply crops with water.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an irrigation method.

dominio.definicion: Plants are grown in raised beds or listed rows (in the case of row crops) with water distributed throughout the field via ditches or pipes, and between the beds or rows using furrows.
dominio.observaciones: Where ditches are used, manually controlled siphon tubes may be used move water from the main ditch to the furrow. When pipes are used, water flow can be controlled by turning it on or off at the local source or by using automatic or manually controlled gates to transfer it from one set of ditches to another. Unless the field is small or very level, parts of it may suffer from water-logging while other parts may be too dry. Depending on heat, wind, and soil permeability, much water may be lost before it can benefit the plants.

dominio.definicion: Water is piped to one or more central locations within the field and distributed by overhead high-pressure sprinklers or guns or by lower-pressure sprays.
dominio.observaciones: A system utilizing sprinklers, sprays, or guns mounted overhead on permanently installed risers is often referred to as a 'solid-set' irrigation system. Manually assembled systems of piping that are broken down to permit tillage and harvesting are sometimes called 'hand set' or 'hand move pipe'. Some sprinklers can also be hidden below ground level, if aesthetics is a concern, and pop up in response to increased water pressure. Sprinklers that spray in a fixed pattern are generally called sprays or spray heads. Higher pressure sprinklers that rotate are called rotors and are driven by a ball drive, gear drive, or impact mechanism. Rotors can be designed to rotate in a full or partial circle. Guns are similar to rotors, except that they generally operate at very high pressures. One drawback of overhead irrigation is that much water can be lost because of high winds or evaporation, and irrigating the entire field uniformly can be difficult or tedious if the system is not properly designed. Water remaining on plants' leaves may promote fungal and other diseases.

dominio.definicion: A form of overhead irrigation consisting of several segments of pipe (usually galvanized steel or aluminum) joined together and supported by trusses, mounted on wheeled towers with sprinklers positioned along its length, the system moving in a circular pattern and fed with water from the pivot point at the center of the arc.
dominio.observaciones: Most center pivot systems now have drops hanging from a u-shaped pipe called a gooseneck attached at the top of the pipe with sprinkler heads that are positioned a few feet (at most) above the crop, thus limiting evaporative losses. Drops can also be used with drag hoses or bubblers that deposit the water directly on the ground between crops. The crops are planted in a circle to conform to the center pivot.

dominio.definicion: A form of overhead irrigation similar to center pivot irrigation in which the equipment is configured to move in a straight line, where the water is pulled from a central ditch.

A form of overhead irrigation in which a series of pipes, each with a wheel of about 1.5 metre diameter permanently affixed to its midpoint and sprinklers along its length, are coupled together at one edge of a field with water supplied (for example: by using a large hose) at one end of the series. After sufficient water has been applied the assembly is rotated either by hand or with a purpose-built mechanism, so that the sprinklers move approximately 10 metres across the field, following which the water supply is reconnected. The process is repeated until the opposite edge of the field is reached.
dominio.observaciones: This system is less expensive to install than a center pivot, but much more labor intensive to operate, and it is limited in the amount of water it can carry. They are most often used for small or oddly-shaped fields, such as those found in hilly or mountainous regions, or in regions where labor is inexpensive.

dominio.definicion: Water is applied slowly to the roots of plants, by depositing the water either on the soil surface or directly to the root zone, typically through the use of 'emitters' (which emit the water in a slow stream) or 'micro-sprinklers' (which spray water in a small area).
dominio.observaciones: This type of system can be the most water-efficient method of irrigation, if managed properly, since evaporation and runoff are minimized. Drip irrigation is often combined with plastic mulch, further reducing evaporation. Drip irrigation can also be accomplished using porous clay vessels sunk into the soil and occasionally filled from a hose or bucket.

dominio.definicion: Water is delivered from below, absorbed upwards, and the excess collected for recycling.
dominio.observaciones: Typically, a solution of water and nutrients floods a container or flows through a trough for a short period of time, 10-20 minutes, and is then pumped back into a holding tank for reuse. It is similar in principle and action to subsurface drip irrigation, and results in mater and nutrient conservation. It is, for example, used in commercial greenhouse production, usually for potted plants.

dominio.definicion: Large steps are cut into hillsides, supported by stone or concrete walls, and as water flows down the hillside it is channelled to each plot, most often by ditches.
dominio.observaciones: Terracing is usually very labor-intensive, since fields are small and access to them may be steep and narrow making it difficult to mechanize the work. In addition, the walls need constant maintenance, especially in rainy climates. However, terracing does allow steep mountainsides to be used to grow plants (although it may be more cost-effective to use them only for animal pasturage).

definicion: The name of the island or group of islands where the feature is located.

definicion: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO 15924) four character code that designates a script.
descripcion: A script is a set of graphic characters used for the written form of one or more languages.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an ISO 15924 script.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: The four-letter codes shall be written with an initial capital Latin letter and final small Latin letters (taken from the range Aaaa to Zzzz). This serves to help differentiate script codes from language codes and country codes: so, for example, 'Mong mon MON' or 'Mong mn MN' would refer to a book in the Mongolian script, in the Mongolian language, originating in Mongolia.

definicion: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO 3166-1) two character code that designates a geopolitical entity (for example: a State).
descripcion: Also known as the 'alpha-2 code'. ISO changes to 'alpha-2 codes' are triggered by changes in the names of entities. Note that non-country 'reserved code elements' may be included (for example: 'EU' to designate the European Union).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO 3166-1) three character code that designates a geopolitical entity (for example: a State).
descripcion: Also known as the 'alpha-3 code'. ISO changes to 'alpha-3 codes' are triggered by changes in the names of entities.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO 3166-1) three digit number that designates a geopolitical entity (for example: a State).
descripcion: Also known as the 'numerical code'. ISO changes to 'numerical codes' are triggered by changes in the names of entities.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an ISO 3166-1 numeric code.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO 3166-1) full name that designates a geopolitical entity (for example: a State).

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that may contain lexical characters and is 200 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO 3166-2) one, two or three character code that is used in conjunction with the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code and a hyphen to designate a principal administrative subdivision of a geopolitical entity (for example: a State).
descripcion: For example, the US state of Virginia is designated as 'VA' and appears in the full ISO 3166-2 code as 'US-VA'.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an ISO 3166-2 extension code.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: A one, two or three-character alphanumeric code that includes only the letters A through Z and digits 0 through 9.

definicion: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO 3166-2) full name that designates a principal administrative subdivision of a geopolitical entity (for example: a State).

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that may contain lexical characters and is 200 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The International Organization for Standardization (ISO 3166-1) four character code that designates an obsolete code for a geopolitical entity (for example: a State).
descripcion: For example, 'DDDE' to designate that the withdrawn code for East Germany ('DD') is now covered by the code 'DE', the current code for Germany.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an ISO 3166-3 alpha-4 code.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: The first two characters are the withdrawn code from ISO 3166-1, while the last two characters are either: the ISO 3166-1 code that replaced it, the ISO 3166-1 code of the country that absorbed the country whose code is withdrawn, or the special code 'HH' to indicate that there is no single successor code.

definicion: An indication that a communication line is in the open by itself and is therefore isolated from other features.
descripcion: A communication line that is not isolated is located in the midst of other features.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type(s) of external starting capabilities for jet aircraft that are available at an aerodrome.
descripcion: A Jet Aircraft Starting Unit is also commonly referred as a 'JASU'.

definicion: The number of jet aircraft starting units per type available for use at an aerodrome.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The facility is certified to perform oil analysis for the U.S. military in accordance with Joint Ail Analysis Program (JOAP) regulations.
descripcion: According to JOAP procedures the facility must provide oil analysis support to the other services within its capabilities. The JOAP uses oil analysis as a maintenance diagnostic tool to determine the internal condition of aeronautical and non-aeronautical engines, transmissions, and gearboxes, and their oil-wetted components through the analysis of used lubricating oils, grease, and fluids. Its goal is flight safety, enhanced equipment readiness, reduced maintenance costs, and the extension of component life and determine the suitability of lubricants and fluids for continued use, resulting in savings and early detection of harmful conditions that, if not corrected, could promote premature component failure.

datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of a land mine based on its intended use(s).
descripcion: A land mine is a receptacle containing explosive placed in or on the ground with the purpose of destroying enemy personnel and/or vehicles.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a land mine type.

dominio.definicion: Designed to immobilize or destroy battle tanks and their occupants.
Designed to kill or incapacitate dismounted soldiers, and on occasion civilians.
Designed to immobilize or destroy battle tanks and/or dismounted soldiers, and on occasion civilians.
A disarmed mine that is used for practice purposes.
A 'smart' anti-tank mine designed to produce a mobility or catastrophic kill by a top or side attack when a target vehicle activates the fuse with acoustic or seismic signals.
dominio.observaciones: When activated, an infrared-sensored, explosive-formed penetrating or a shaped-charge rocket warhead sublet is launched and the warhead acquires the target.

dominio.definicion: A mine designed to act as a phony or decoy.
dominio.observaciones: Employed to entice or deceive the enemy.

dominio.definicion: Dispersed by field artillery and using ground sensors (for example: seismic, acoustic, and/or magnetic) to activate itself against moving targets within a designated range.
A mine designed to act against aircrafts (for example: helicopters).
dominio.observaciones: It may be activated by the downward air pressure from an active helicopter rotor.

dominio.definicion: A mine designed to work in inland waterbodies (for example: rivers) against boats and ships.
dominio.observaciones: These mines are no naval mines and floating down a stream, etc.

dominio.definicion: The land reclamation predominantly for its future use for residential purposes.
The land reclamation predominantly for its future use for agricultural purposes.
The land reclamation predominantly for its future use for transport facilities.

definicion: The nature(s) of a geographic area based on its physical and/or spatial characteristics.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a landscape morphology.

dominio.definicion: A range or series of natural elevations of the Earth's crust.
A natural elevation of the earth's surface rising high above the surrounding land.
A hollow place on the earth's surface.
A depression in the earth's surface bounded by hills or mountains, usually with a stream flowing through it.
A flat region on or close to sea level.
A flat upland region or table land, a plateau.
The outfall region of a running water into a large water body or river.
A region of wind-shaped ridges of sand, situated at sea coasts or in deserts.
A wooded country; a land covered with forests.
Any sea or water studded with islands.
A region occupied by numerous lakes.
A permanently wet area of land consisting of incompletely decayed organic material and mainly stagnant fresh water.
dominio.observaciones: It is generally too soft to bear the weight of any heavy body.

dominio.definicion: An open space of country, especially covered with shrubs and coarse herbage often of the genus Erica.
A costal region where the level of water rises or falls with the tides.
Complex name for a large mountainous area of extreme height and with a steep relief above 1501 metres in height.
Complex name for a larger mountainous area of less height and steepness compared to high mountains with a height from 301 to1500 metres.
Localised area of the earth's crust that is prone to localized volcanic activity.
dominio.observaciones: A volcanic field usually contain 10 to 100 volcanoes, such as cinder cones and are usually in clusters. Lava flows may also occur. They may occur as a monogenetic volcanic field or a polygenetic volcanic field.

dominio.definicion: An area composed of small mountains with even rounded forms up to 300 metres in height.
Single rocks with pointed tops, rising isolated or as a series.
A long, deep hollow caused by a torrent, a gorge, a narrow gully or a cleft.
A region covered by masses of ice that often descend slowly to lower regions; the polar ice-sheet regions.
A tract of low land covered partially or wholly with water, situated in coastal areas.
An area characterized by a maze of very closely spaced, deep, narrow, steep-sided erosional ravines, and sharp crests and pinnacles.
A zone of variable width straddling the shoreline.
dominio.observaciones: For example, Barbary Coast or Costa del Sol.

dominio.definicion: A high projection of land extending into a large body of water beyond the line of the coast.
A near-level shallow, natural depression or basin, usually containing an intermittent lake, pond, or pool.
An elongated area of land projecting into a body of water and nearly surrounded by water.
A pointed elevation atop a mountain, ridge, or other hypsographic feature.
An elevated plain with steep slopes on one or more sides and often with incised streams.
An extensive area of comparatively level to gently undulating land, lacking surface irregularities, and usually adjacent to a higher area.
A long narrow elevation with steep sides and a more or less continuous crest.
An extensive interior region of high land with low to moderate surface relief.

A tract of alluvial land, often more or less triangular in shape, enclosed or traversed by the diverging mouths of a watercourse and generally extending into a larger waterbody (for example: a lake or a sea).
An area characterized by permanent soil-moisture.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a bog, a swamp, a marsh, or a flood land.

dominio.definicion: A vast level grassy usually treeless plain.
An arid and treeless uncultivated sparsely populated tract of land.
A natural depression in arid or semi-arid regions whose bed is covered with salt encrusted clayey soil.
An area of irregular carbonate rocks in which erosion has produced fissures, sinkholes, underground streams, and caverns.

definicion: The probability range of landslide susceptibility, occurrence and/or related hazard, as a category.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a landslide hazard category.

dominio.definicion: There exists a high estimated susceptibility to the occurrence of landslides and the historical record documents a moderate frequency of landslide occurrence, with at least 1.5 percent and up to 15 percent of the identified area involved.
dominio.observaciones: Susceptibility to the occurrence of a landslide is the probable degree of response of the areal rocks and soils to natural or artificial cutting or loading of slopes or to anomalously high precipitation. High susceptibility is present when more than 15 percent of the identified area may be involved.

dominio.definicion: There exists a high estimated susceptibility to the occurrence of landslides and the historical record documents a low frequency of landslide occurrence, with less than 1.5 percent of the identified area involved.
dominio.observaciones: Susceptibility to the occurrence of a landslide is the probable degree of response of the areal rocks and soils to natural or artificial cutting or loading of slopes or to anomalously high precipitation. High susceptibility is present when more than 15 percent of the identified area may be involved.

dominio.definicion: There exists a moderate estimated susceptibility to the occurrence of landslides and the historical record documents a low frequency of landslide occurrence, with less than 1.5 percent of the identified area involved.
dominio.observaciones: Susceptibility to the occurrence of a landslide is the probable degree of response of the areal rocks and soils to natural or artificial cutting or loading of slopes or to anomalously high precipitation. Moderate susceptibility is present when at least 1.5 percent and up to 15 percent of the identified area may be involved.

dominio.definicion: The historical record documents a high frequency of landslide occurrence, with more than 15 percent of the identified area involved in such events.
dominio.observaciones: The estimated susceptibility to the occurrence of landslides is less than or equal to the historical incidence.

dominio.definicion: The historical record documents a moderate frequency of landslide occurrence, with at least 1.5 percent and up to 15 percent of the identified area involved in such events.
dominio.observaciones: The estimated susceptibility to the occurrence of landslides is less than or equal to the historical incidence.

dominio.definicion: The historical record documents a low frequency of landslide occurrence, with less than 1.5 percent of the identified area involved in such events.
dominio.observaciones: The estimated susceptibility to the occurrence of landslides is less than or equal to the historical incidence.

descripcion: Used, for example, for identification of alternate local official names of non-international features.

The language of Albania, constituting a separate branch of the Indo-European family.
The Semitic language of Amhara, the principal language of modern Ethiopia.
The Semitic language originally of the Arabs, now spoken in much of the Middle East and North Africa.
An English-based pidgin used as a lingua franca in Fiji and especially in Vanuatu (formerly New Hebrides).
The Slavonic language of Bulgaria.
The Sino-Tibetan language of the Burmese people.
The Romance language of Catalonia.

The North Germanic language of Denmark.
The language of the Netherlands (spoken also in what is now North Belgium).

dominio.definicion: The Finno-Ugric language of Estonia.

The Romance language of Italy.

The chief spoken language in Rwanda.

dominio.definicion: A Bantu language spoken in Burundi and adjacent parts of Tanzania, Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda.

The Shan language of the Tai people of Laos and northeastern Thailand.

The language of the geographic name source should be distinguished from the language of origin or etymology of a geographic name; for example, considering the place name 'San Jose, California' the language of the source of this geographic name may be English if it is determined from a United States map, regardless of the fact that this geographic name means 'St. Joseph, California' in Spanish.

datatype.estructura: Formatted in accordance with ISO 8601:2000, 5.4.1, Combinations of date and time of day - Complete representation - Extended format, a calendar date and time representation, as a single data element comprising up to twenty characters, where [YYYY] represents a calendar year, [MM] the ordinal number of a calendar month within the calendar year, [DD] the ordinal number of a day within the calendar month, [hh] the ordinal number of an hour within the calendar day, [mm] the ordinal number of a minute within the hour, [ss] the ordinal number of a second within the minute, and an optional 'Z' when the time is according to Coordinated Universal Time (UTC), as 'YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ' (for example: '1985-04-12T11:45:20Z' for 11 hours, 45 minutes and 20 seconds UTC on 12 April 1985). Representations with reduced precision may be used in accordance with 5.4.2 (for example: '1985-04-12' for 12 April 1985). Representations consistently using basic format (eliminating the hyphen '-' and the colon ':') may be used in accordance with 5.4.1 (for example: '19850412T114520Z').

descripcion: The primary alignment of a feature is its established direction of flow or use (for example: a road, a power line, a river, a rapid, and/or a bridge). A feature-specific rule may apply. In the case of a bridge, the length is the distance between the bridge abutments along the bridge centreline. In the case of a dam, the length is the distance along the dam crest. dominio.definicion: A tectonic plate covering the continent of Africa and extending westward to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.
A tectonic plate covering the continent of Antarctica and extending outward under the surrounding oceans.
dominio.observaciones: The Antarctic plate is roughly 16.9 million square kilometers in extent. It is the fifth biggest plate in the world.

dominio.definicion: A largely continental tectonic plate covering the Arabian peninsula and extending northward to Turkey.
A mostly oceanic tectonic plate underlying Central America and the Caribbean Sea off the north coast of South America.
dominio.observaciones: The Caribbean plate is roughly 3.2 million square kilometers in extent.

dominio.definicion: An oceanic tectonic plate beneath the Pacific Ocean off the west coast of Central America.

A tectonic plate covering Eurasia (a landmass consisting of the continents Europe and Asia) except that it does not cover the Indian subcontinent, the Arabian subcontinent, and the area east of the Verkhoyansk Range in East Siberia.
dominio.observaciones: It is the third largest tectonic plate.

dominio.definicion: A tectonic plate arising from the Juan de Fuca Ridge, and subducting under the northerly portion of the western side of the North American Plate.
An oceanic tectonic plate in the eastern Pacific Ocean basin off the west coast of South America.
A tectonic plate covering most of North America, extending eastward to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge and westward to the Cherskiy Range in East Siberia.
An oceanic tectonic plate beneath the Pacific Ocean.
An oceanic tectonic plate beneath the Pacific Ocean to the east of the Philippines.
A tectonic plate that is currently forming and is a part of the African Plate that is moving eastward from the East African Rift Zone.
A tectonic plate covering the continent of South America and extending eastward to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.
A minor tectonic plate to the northwest of the Solomon Islands in the south Pacific Ocean.
dominio.observaciones: The Solomon Sea Plate is roughly 0.25 million square kilometers in extent.

dominio.definicion: A small tectonic plate containing the Fiji Islands and the surrounding Ocean.
dominio.observaciones: The Fiji Plate is roughly 1.1 million square kilometers in extent. It is bordered northerly by the Pacific Plate and southerly by the Australian Plate. It is southwesterly from the Bismarck Plate.

dominio.definicion: A tectonic plate located beneath the Pacific Ocean off the coast of northern California.
dominio.observaciones: The Gorda Plate is roughly 0.07 million square kilometers in extent.

dominio.definicion: A small tectonic plate located in the eastern Mediterranian Sea under southern Greece and far western Turkey.
dominio.observaciones: The Aegean Sea Plate is sandwiched between the African Plate to the south and the Eurasian Plate to the north. Its southern edge is a subduction zone south of Crete and the northern edge is a divergent boundary responsible for the formation of the Gulf of Corinth.

dominio.definicion: A continental tectonic plate consisting primarily of the country of Turkey.
dominio.observaciones: The easterly side of the Anatolian Plate is a boundary with the Arabian Plate, the East Anatolian Fault, a left lateral transform fault. The westerly side is a boundary with the Aegean Sea Plate. The southerly and southwesterly sides join with the African Plate.

dominio.definicion: A small tectonic plate consisting the eastern part of Italy and the Adriatic Sea.
dominio.observaciones: The Apulian Plate carries primarily continental crust that broke away from the African Plate.

dominio.definicion: A tectonic plate underlying Iran, parts of Iraq and Pakistan.
dominio.observaciones: The Iranian Plate is squashed between the Arabian Plate to the south and the Eurasian Plate to the north.

dominio.definicion: A small tectonic plate bordered northerly by the Pacific Plate and southerly by the Australian Plate.
dominio.observaciones: The Bismarck Plate is roughly 0.3 million square kilometers in extent. . It contains the Bismarck Sea.

dominio.definicion: A major tectonic plate that includes the continent of Australia and the surrounding ocean.
dominio.observaciones: The Australian Plate is roughly 47 million square kilometers in extent. It is bordered northerly by the Eurasian and the Indian Plate, easterly by the Pacific Plate, southerly by the Antarctican Plate and westerly by the Somali Plate.

dominio.definicion: A tectonic plate including the sub-continent of India and a portion of the basin under the Indian Sea.
dominio.observaciones: The Indian Plate is roughly 11.9 million square kilometers in extent. It was originally a part from the ancient continent of Gondwanaland from which it split off. The Indian Plate is bordered northerly by the Eurasian Plate and southerly by the Australian Plate. Easterly it is bordered by the Somali Sub-Plate and the Arabian Plate.

dominio.definicion: An oceanic tectonic plate bordering the South American Plate on the north and the Antarctic Plate on the south and west.
dominio.observaciones: The Scotia Plate is roughly 1.6 million square kilometers in extent.
