An oven for hardening, burning, or drying materials (for example: grain, meal, and/or clay), especially a brick-lined oven used to bake or fire ceramics.
dominio.observaciones: May also be used for calcining lime.

dominio.definicion: A building that is used for the changing or refining of a particular materials.
A room or building housing pumps for raising, compressing, and/or transferring fluids.
A building involved in the production or distribution of petroleum, oil and/or natural gas.
A facility for processing natural fibres (for example: wood) into flexible sheets or rolls of paper by deposit from an aqueous suspension.
A place where ships are built or repaired.
A facility for the production of fabricated structural steel products (for example: girders and/or plates).
dominio.observaciones: May be specifically restricted to a factory where steel is rolled into sheets.

dominio.definicion: A facility for the manufacturing of motor vehicles.
A building, or part of a building, in which broken and/or damaged goods (for example: equipment) are restored to sound condition.
A facility for the generation of chilled liquid and/or gas for cooling purposes.
An establishment for storing, purifying, and to supply an area or town.
A relatively small building that is separate from but is located near a main building and whose industrial use has not been determined.
A facility where petroleum and/or petroleum products are refined.
An operational area with buildings and/or facilities for the desalination and purification of seawater.
The manufacture of glass in all its forms, made by any process, and products composed of glass.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example, the manufacture of: flat glass, including wired, coloured or tinted flat glass; toughened or laminated flat glass; glass in rods or tubes; glass paving blocks; glass mirrors; multiple-walled insulating units of glass; bottles and other containers of glass or crystal; drinking glasses and other domestic glass or crystal articles; glass fibres, including glass wool and non-woven products thereof; laboratory, hygienic or pharmaceutical glassware; clock or watch glasses, optical glass and optical elements not optically worked; glassware used in imitation jewellery; glass insulators and glass insulating fittings; glass envelopes for lamps; and glass figurines.

dominio.definicion: The manufacture of articles of concrete, cement and/or plaster.
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example, the manufacture of: precast concrete, cement or artificial stone articles for use in construction (for example: tiles, flagstones, bricks, boards, sheets, panels, pipes, or posts); prefabricated structural components for building or civil engineering of cement, concrete or artificial stone; plaster articles for use in construction (for example: boards, sheets, or panels); building materials of vegetable substances (for example: wood wool, straw, reeds, or rushes) agglomerated with cement, plaster or other mineral binder; articles of asbestos-cement or cellulose fibre-cement (for example: corrugated sheets, other sheets, panels, tiles, tubes, pipes, reservoirs, troughs, basins, sinks, jars, furniture, or window frames); other articles of concrete, plaster, cement or artificial stone (for example: statuary, furniture, bas- and haut-reliefs, vases, or flowerpots); powdered mortars; and ready-mix and dry-mix concrete and mortars.

dominio.definicion: Handling the isotope separation that is the process of concentrating specific isotopes of a chemical element by removing other isotopes (for example: separating natural uranium into enriched uranium and depleted uranium, or the separation of plutonium from spent nuclear fuel).
dominio.observaciones: This process is crucial in the manufacture of uranium fuel for nuclear power stations, and is also required for the creation of nuclear weapons.

dominio.definicion: Involved in the process of producing or processing substances, often artifically prepared, containing nitrogen, phosphorus, and/or potassium that are added to soil in order to fertilize it.

The manufacture of semi-finished products and various metal castings by a process of introducing molten metal into a mold, allowed it to solidify in the shape inside the mold, and then removing the mold.
The manufacture of air (for example: airplaces or helicopters) and spacecraft (for example launch vehicles or satellites) and related equipment.
dominio.observaciones: It includes, for example, the manufacture of: airplanes for the transport of goods or passengers, for use by the defence forces, for sport or other purposes; helicopters; gliders and hang-gliders; dirigibles and hot air balloons; parts and accessories of the aircraft of this class (for example: fuselages, wings, doors, control surfaces, landing gear, fuel tanks, nacelles, airscrews, helicopter rotors and propelled rotor blades, motors and engines of a kind typically found on aircraft, or parts of turbojets and turbopropellers for aircraft); and ground flying trainers. It also includes, for example, the manufacture of spacecraft and launch vehicles, satellites, planetary probes, orbital stations, shuttles, and intercontinental ballistic (ICBM) and similar missiles.

definicion: The geographic distribution of marine organisms defined by historical events (for example: migration, extinction, or speciation).
descripcion: For example, the geographic region used by marine species during a portion of their life cycle (spawning, feeding, nursery, migration, and shelter), but most habitats support only a subset of these activities. Marine species may change habitats with changes in life history stage, seasonal and geographic distributions, abundance, and interactions with other species.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a marine biogeography.

dominio.definicion: The geographical range of localities inhabited by a species or other group.
dominio.observaciones: The range may be continuous or discontinuous (with gaps).

dominio.definicion: The locality where a given species feeds or where food is abundant and available.
The locality where a given species spawns.
The locality to which a given species migrates during the winter, being located away from feeding and spawning areas.

definicion: The method by which a marine farm is enclosed.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a marine farm enclosure method.

dominio.definicion: A barrier enclosing an area, typically consisting of posts connected by wire and/or wood.
Poles or stakes placed in shallow water to outline fishing grounds or to catch fish.
An open-meshed material of twine or cord for catching fish.

definicion: The depth range within the water column of a typical habitat in which marine organisms are found.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The type of a marine navigation line based on construction and/or intended use.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a marine navigation line type.

dominio.definicion: A straight line that marks the boundary between a safe and a dangerous area or that passes clear of a navigational danger.
dominio.observaciones: Sectors of lighthouse lights are usually bounded by clearing lines.

dominio.definicion: A line passing through one or more fixed marks.
A line passing through one or more clearly defined objects, along the path of which a vessel can approach safely up to a certain distance off.

definicion: The type of a marine rescue station based on its available equipment and intended use(s).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a marine rescue station type.

dominio.definicion: Equipment for saving life at sea is maintained, including a lifeboat.
dominio.observaciones: The type of lifeboat may vary from fast, long distance boats to inflatable inshore boats.

dominio.definicion: Equipment for saving life at sea is maintained, including a rocket.
dominio.observaciones: The rocket may be used for signalling and/or for life-saving purposes.

dominio.definicion: Equipment for saving life at sea is maintained, including both a lifeboat and a rocket.
A shelter providing protection from danger and/or distress at sea for shipwrecked mariners.
A shelter providing protection from danger in areas exposed to extreme and sudden tides or tidal streams.
A lifeboat is moored ready for use.
A radio station is reserved for emergency situations.
dominio.observaciones: May also be a public telephone.

dominio.definicion: Medical first aid equipment is available.

definicion: The ecological or environmental niche that is inhabited by a marine species.
descripcion: A habitat is the natural environment in which an organism lives, or the physical environment that surrounds (influences and is utilized by) a species population.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a marine species habitat code.

dominio.definicion: The species lives in close relation with the bottom and depending on it.
dominio.observaciones: For example: cods, groupers and lobsters are demersal species. The term 'demersal fish' usually refers to the living mode of the adult.

dominio.definicion: The species spends most of its life swimming in the water column with little contact with, or dependency on, the bottom.
dominio.observaciones: Usually refers to the adult stage of the species.

definicion: The type of a marine warning signal based on the type(s) of information conveyed.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a marine warning signal type.

dominio.definicion: Warns of the presence of a danger to navigation.
Warns of the presence of a maritime obstruction.
Warns of the presence of a cable.
Warns of activity in a military practice area.
Receives or transmits distress signals.
Displays a visual signal to indicate a weather forecast.
Conveys information about storm conditions.
Conveys information about ice conditions.
An accurate signal marking a specified time or time interval.
dominio.observaciones: Such signals are usually sent from an observatory by radio or telegraph, but visual signals are used at some ports. It is used primarily for determining errors of timepieces.

dominio.definicion: Conveys information on tidal conditions in the area in question.
Conveys information on condition of tidal currents in the area in question.
Conveys information on measured tidal heights in the area in question.
Conveys information on condition of tidal heights above the chart or local datum in the area in question.
A signal or message warning of diving activity.
Conveys information on measured (non-tidal) water levels in the area in question.

definicion: The type of an aggressive act based on the method of approach to a vessel, the threat made and/or the consequences of the act.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime aggressive action.

dominio.definicion: An unexpected and/or unwarrented inspection of a vessel and/or its operations.
Unauthorized individuals boarded or attempted to board a vessel with intent to steal either goods and/or the vessel, or abduct crew and/or passengers.
Attack with weapons without boarding.
dominio.observaciones: No aggressor has entered the vehicle.

definicion: The type of maritime transportion used by aggressors in order to approach a victim.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime aggressor transport.

dominio.definicion: Approached on foot from a pier.
Approached by swimming.
Conveyed by small inflatable watercraft.
Conveyed by fishing boat(s).
Conveyed by yacht(s).
Conveyed by speedboat(s).
Conveyed by military vessel(s).
Attack conveyed by flying vehicle(s).

definicion: The type of maritime restriction(s) in an area that are designated by an appropriate authority.
descripcion: May be in accordance with certain specified conditions. The official legal statue of each kind of restricted area defines the kind of restriction(s).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime area restriction.

dominio.definicion: An area known to be free of maritime restrictions.
An area where birds are bred and protected.
An agreed protection zone that has been established to ensure the conservation of fish stocks and establish maritime jurisdiction.
An area managed so as to preserve the relation of plants and living creatures to each other and to their surroundings.
An area where fish are protected.
An area where wild animals or birds hunted for sport or food are kept undisturbed for private use.
An officially designated area in which there may be restrictions on entry, fishing, anchoring, and/or other activities in order to protect the marine environment.
An area managed so as to preserve its flora, fauna, and/or physical features.
dominio.observaciones: It may include both land and sea areas.

dominio.definicion: An area where seals are protected.
A water area in which fishing frequently occurs.
An offshore zone in which exclusive fishing rights and management are held by a coastal nation.
An offshore zone within the Fishery Limits of a coastal nation within which fishing rights have been granted to foreign fishermen.
An offshore zone within which fishing rights have been asserted unilaterally.

dominio.etiqueta: International Council for the Seas (ICES) Fishery Zone
dominio.definicion: An offshore management zone defined by the International Council for the Exploration of the Seas (ICES) and used for the purpose of fishery statistics and regulations in the north-east Atlantic.
A designated area of water where a vessel may adjust its compass by a process of 'swinging ship'.
dominio.observaciones: Normally accompanied by a 'swinging buoy' that is used to place the vessel on various headings and then comparing magnetic compass readings with the corresponding magnetic directions, to determine deviation. The results are used to adjust the vessel compass to compensate.

dominio.definicion: An area, usually about two cables diameter, within which ship's magnetic fields may be measured; sensing instruments and cables are installed on the sea bed in the range and there are cables leading from the range to a control position ashore.
An area where dredging is taking place.
The main travelled part of a waterway.
An area around certain wrecks of historical importance to protect the wrecks from unauthorized interference by diving, salvage or deposition (including anchoring).
An offshore area officially designated as suitable for the burning of chemical waste by specially equipped ships.
An area that has been mutually agreed between two or more coastal States for the joint exploitation of resources of the sea and seabed.
dominio.observaciones: A Joint Economic Development Zone generally straddles the 'national' waters of the coastal States, consequently the maritime boundary between the recognised 'national' waters of the States is separate from the boundary of the Zone itself.

dominio.definicion: A location where a significant number of persons have perished as a direct result of a vessel or structure sinking and their remains cannot be recovered, the wreck and immediate area may be declared as a Mass Grave or more specifically, a War Grave.
dominio.observaciones: Such sites are protected from disturbance by International Law.

dominio.definicion: An area within which maritime pollution is reported according to an established matrix of locations.
An area that may have been laid and maintained with explosive mines.
dominio.observaciones: The mining may have been for either defence or practice purposes.

dominio.definicion: An area, now clear, that was previously laid and maintained with explosive mines.
dominio.observaciones: The mining may have been for either defence or practice purposes.

dominio.definicion: An area in which natural gas occurs in quantities worthy of exploitation.
dominio.observaciones: May contain offshore and/or underwater constructions.

dominio.definicion: An area in which petroleum occurs in quantities worthy of exploitation.
dominio.observaciones: May contain offshore and/or underwater constructions.

dominio.definicion: An area of the sea that is being reclaimed as land, usually by the dumping of earth and other material.
An area where marine research takes place.
An area in which there is danger of serious grounding of a vessel so that it is not soon refloated.
An area in which people may swim and therefore vessel movement may be restricted.
An area where vessels turn.
An area reserved for vessels waiting to enter a harbour.
An area within which people may water ski and therefore vessel movement may be restricted.

An area, not exceeding 200 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured, subject to a specific legal regime established in the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).

An area extending to the outer edge of the continental margin (the submerged prolongation of the land mass of a coastal State, consisting of the shelf, the slope and the rise, but does not include the deep ocean floor with its oceanic ridges) or a minimum of 200 nautical miles distant from the territorial baseline.
dominio.observaciones: (UNCLOS Article 76, Continental shelf, item 7) The coastal State shall delineate the outer limits of its continental shelf, where that shelf extends beyond 200 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured, by straight lines not exceeding 60 nautical miles in length, connecting fixed points, defined by coordinates of latitude and longitude.

dominio.definicion: An area extending to the limit of the continental shelf or continental margin determined in accordance with the provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
dominio.observaciones: (UNCLOS Article 76, Continental shelf, item 1) The continental shelf of a coastal State comprises the seabed and subsoil of the submarine areas that extend beyond its territorial sea throughout the natural prolongation of its land territory to the outer edge of the continental margin, or to a distance of 200 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured where the outer edge of the continental margin does not extend up to that distance.

dominio.definicion: A zone contiguous to a coastal state's territorial sea, which may not extend beyond 24 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured.
dominio.observaciones: The coastal state may exercise certain control in this zone subject to the provisions of International Law.

dominio.definicion: A belt of water of a defined breadth but not exceeding 12 nautical miles measured seaward from the territorial sea baseline.
Waters on the landward side of the baseline of the territorial sea and including landlocked waters within the State.
An area in which a vessels' speed must be reduced in order to reduce the size of the wake it produces.

The boundary of an area in which vessel traffic services are provided by a relevant authority that are primarily designed to improve safety and efficiency of traffic flow and the protection of the environment.
dominio.observaciones: Vessel traffic services may range from simple information messages, to extensive organization of the traffic involving national or regional schemes.

definicion: The type(s) of circumstance(s) influencing the safety of navigation that mariners should observe in an area.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime caution type.

dominio.definicion: An area designated for transfer of cargo from one vessel to another to reduce the draught of the larger vessel.
An area that contains ice conditions hazardous to navigation of which the mariner must be aware.
An area where water is taken into a channel or pipe from a river or other body of water.
An area in which reclaimed water or treated effluent (for example: from a sewage treatment plant or refinery) is discharged to a receiving water body, often via a diffuser.
A sensitive area specially regulated to prevent discharge of pollutants from vessels.
An area containing one or more submarine cables.
An area containing one or more submarine pipelines.
An area containing one or more submarine sewers.

An area in which military munitions that have been: primed, fuzed, armed or otherwise prepared for action; have then been fired, placed, dropped, launched or projected; and remain unexploded by design or malfunction.
dominio.observaciones: Includes: High-explosive warheads, rocket motors, practice munitions with spotting charges, torpedoes, artillery and mortar ammunition, grenades, incendiary munitions, electroexplosive devices, and propellant-actuated devices.

dominio.definicion: A straight line on a chart that either marks the boundary between a safe and a dangerous area, or that passes clear of a navigational danger.
dominio.observaciones: Sectors of lighthouse lights are usually bounded by clearing lines.

dominio.definicion: A demarcation line established in accordance with the International Regulations for Avoiding Collisions at Sea (COLREGS).
The area over which a harbour authority has jurisdiction.
The edge of an ocean current along which it contacts another current or stationary surrounding waters.
dominio.observaciones: Often marked by an abrupt change in colour, water temperature and density, and by breakers and other surface phenomena. For example, the West Wall and the North Wall of the Gulf Stream.

dominio.definicion: An area in which work is in progress that may affect navigation.
dominio.observaciones: For example, changing the bottom depth (for example: dredging, laying pipeline, tunnel construction), the shape of the coast (for example: land reclamation), and/or the appearance of the horizon for a vessel (for example: construction of structures).

definicion: The type of a maritime geopolitical dividing line (limit) based on the nature of its establishment and/or recognition.
descripcion: Generally established and recognized in accordance with International Law (for example: the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS)).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime geopolitical limit type.

dominio.definicion: The boundary at sea between two coastal States as established by International Law.
The line from which the outer limits of the territorial sea and certain other outer limits are measured.
The limit of a belt of water of a 3 nautical mile breadth measured seaward from the territorial sea baseline.
The limit of a belt of water of a defined breadth but not exceeding 12 nautical miles measured seaward from the territorial sea baseline.
The limit of a zone contiguous to a coastal state's territorial sea, which may not extend beyond 24 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured.
dominio.observaciones: The coastal state may exercise certain control in this zone subject to the provisions of International Law.

dominio.definicion: The limit of the continental shelf or continental margin determined in accordance with the provisions of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
dominio.observaciones: (UNCLOS Article 76, Continental shelf, item 1) The continental shelf of a coastal State comprises the seabed and subsoil of the submarine areas that extend beyond its territorial sea throughout the natural prolongation of its land territory to the outer edge of the continental margin, or to a distance of 200 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured where the outer edge of the continental margin does not extend up to that distance.

dominio.definicion: The limit defined by the outer edge of the continental margin (the submerged prolongation of the land mass of a coastal State, consisting of the shelf, the slope and the rise, but does not include the deep ocean floor with its oceanic ridges) or a minimum of 200 nautical miles distant from the territorial baseline.
dominio.observaciones: (UNCLOS Article 76, Continental shelf, item 7) The coastal State shall delineate the outer limits of its continental shelf, where that shelf extends beyond 200 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured, by straight lines not exceeding 60 nautical miles in length, connecting fixed points, defined by coordinates of latitude and longitude.

dominio.definicion: The limit of the exclusive economic zone, which is an area, not exceeding 200 nautical miles from the baselines from which the breadth of the territorial sea is measured, subject to a specific legal regime established in the Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS).
The boundary of an area within which national custom regulations are in force.

definicion: The type of a maritime light based on its structure, location and/or intended use(s).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime light type.

dominio.definicion: A light illuminating a sector of very narrow angle and intended to mark a direction to follow.
A light associated with other lights so as to form a leading line to be followed.
A light established for aeronautical navigation and may be of higher power than marine lights and visible from well offshore.
A light marking an obstacle which constitutes a danger to air navigation.
A light used to automatically determine conditions of visibility which warrant the turning on or off of a sound signal.
A broad beam light used to illuminate a structure or area.
A light whose source has a linear form generally horizontal, which can reach a length of several metres.
A light placed on or near the support of a main light and having a special use in navigation.
A powerful light focused so as to illuminate a small area.
A light available as a backup to a main light which will be illuminated should the main light fail.
A light which enables its approximate bearing to be obtained without the use of a compass.
In a leading lights, the light is in the upper position on the lead as viewed from seaward.
In a leading lights, the light is in the lower position on the lead as viewed from seaward.
A group of lights of identical character and almost identical position, that are disposed horizontally.
A group of lights of identical character and almost identical position, that are disposed vertically.
In a leading lights, the light is in the front position on the lead as viewed from seaward.
In a leading lights, the light is in the rear position on the lead as viewed from seaward.
A sodium directional light giving a yellow background to a screen on which a vertical black line will be seen by an observer on the centre-line.
dominio.observaciones: A short-range (up to 2 kilometres) light.

dominio.definicion: A light presenting different appearances (in particular, different colours) over various parts of the horizon of interest to maritime navigation.

definicion: The type of a maritime navigation beacon based on its design and/or structure.

datatype.nombre: Maritime Navigation Beacon Structure Type Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime navigation beacon structure type.

dominio.definicion: A beacon fixed to a vertical pipe structure that oscillates around a universal coupling connected to a sinker.
dominio.observaciones: The beacon is kept upright by the buoyancy of a submerged floating chamber and is primarily designed to mark narrow channels with greater precision than conventional buoys.

dominio.definicion: A solid structure of the order of 10 metres in height used as a navigational aid.
A mound of stones, usually conical or pyramidal, raised as a landmark or to designate a point of importance in surveying.
A structure consisting of strips of metal or wood crossed or interlaced to form a structure to serve as an aid to navigation or as a support for an aid to navigation.
A long pile (for example: a heavy timber or section of steel, wood, or concrete) forced into the earth that may serve as an aid to navigation or as a support for an aid to navigation.
dominio.observaciones: A topmark may or may not be present.

dominio.definicion: A tree without roots stuck or spoiled into the bottom of the sea to serve as a navigational aid.

definicion: The type of a beacon based on its significance to maritime navigation.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime navigation beacon type.

dominio.definicion: A beacon used to indicate that the best navigable water is to be found in one particular of the quadrants that are bounded by the four bearings NW, NE, SE and SW taken from the position of the mark.
A beacon used to indicate a lateral limit of navigable water.
A beacon indicating a mooring or moorings.
A beacon associated with a large (up to 6 metres in diameter) buoy carrying oceanographic and meteorological sensors together with an on-board data recording system.
dominio.observaciones: When anchored by means of an elastic mooring an accelerometer mounted within the buoy registers the rate at which the buoy is rising or falling as it follows the pattern of waves; by integrating against time, the acceleration signal can be converted to vertical displacement.

dominio.definicion: A beacon indicating an aeronautical anchorage (for example: for seaplanes).
A beacon indicating the limit of a spoil ground.
A beacon fixed to a vertical pipe structure that oscillates around a universal coupling connected to a sinker.
dominio.observaciones: The beacon is kept upright by the buoyancy of a submerged floating chamber and is primarily designed to mark narrow channels with greater precision than conventional buoys.
dominio.aliases: Articulated Light, Buoyant Beacon, Pivoted Beacon

dominio.definicion: A buoy equipped with a marker radiobeacon serving as an aid to navigation and secured to its charted position by a mooring.
A transponder beacon transmitting a coded signal on radar frequency, permitting an interrogating craft to determine the bearing and range of the transponder.
A long pile (for example: a heavy timber or section of steel, wood, or concrete) forced into the earth that may serve as an aid to navigation or as a support for an aid to navigation.
dominio.observaciones: A topmark may or may not be present.

dominio.definicion: A mound of stones, usually conical or pyramidal, raised as a landmark or to designate a point of importance in surveying.
A tall spar-like beacon fitted with a permanently submerged buoyancy chamber, the lower end of the body is secured to seabed sinker either by a flexible joint or by a cable under tension.
A beacon indicating a firing danger area.
A beacon distinctively marked to aid in its identification (for example: as a weapons target, or for identification on a photograph).
A beacon indicating the position of a ship which is used as a target during military exercises.
A beacon indicating a degaussing range.
A beacon of relevance to barges.
A beacon indicating the position of submarine cables or the point at which they run on to the land.
A beacon indicating the position of an outfall or the point at which it leaves the land.
A beacon used to record data for scientific purposes.
A beacon indicating a recreation zone.
A beacon identifying a leading line for vessels when they are in transit.
dominio.observaciones: A maritime aid to navigation so located as to indicate the path to be followed.

dominio.definicion: A beacon forming part of a transit indicating one end of a measured distance.
A beacon indicating a traffic separation scheme.
A beacon indicating an area where anchoring is prohibited.
A beacon indicating that berthing is prohibited.
A beacon indicating that overtaking is prohibited.
A beacon indicating a one way route.
A beacon indicating that vessels must not generate excessive wake.
A beacon indicating that a speed limit applies.
A beacon indicating the place where the bow of a ship must stop when traffic lights show red.
A beacon indicating that a ship should sound its siren or horn.
A beacon indicating the minimum vertical space available for passage.
A beacon indicating the maximum draft of vessels permitted.
A beacon indicating the minimum horizontal space available for passage.
A beacon warning of strong currents.
A beacon indicating that berthing is allowed.
A beacon indicating an overhead power cable.
A beacon indicating the gradient of the slope of a dredge channel edge.
A beacon indicating the presence of a telephone.
A beacon indicating that a ferry route crosses the ship route.
dominio.observaciones: Often includes a 'sound ships siren' mark.

dominio.definicion: A beacon indicating the position of submarine pipelines or the point at which they run on to the land.
A beacon indicating a clearing line.
A beacon providing or indicating a place of safety.
A beacon indicating a foul ground.
A beacon installed for use by yachtsmen.
A beacon indicating an area where helicopters may land.
A beacon indicating a location at which a GPS position has been accurately determined.
A beacon indicating an area where seaplanes land.
A beacon indicating that diving may take place or be taking place in the vicinity.
A privately maintained beacon.
A beacon indicating an area in which people may swim and therefore vessel movement may be restricted.
A beacon equipped with an unlighted daymark identified by its colour, shape, and number depending on the purpose of the beacon.
A beacon indicating that the preferred channel in a lateral system of beaconage is to port.
dominio.aliases: Preferred Channel to Port Lateral Mark

dominio.definicion: A beacon indicating that the preferred channel in a lateral system of beaconage is to starboard.
dominio.aliases: Preferred Channel to Starboard Lateral Mark

dominio.definicion: A beacon identifying the starboard hand edge of a channel, according to the locally administered direction of beaconage in the IALA lateral system.
dominio.observaciones: Its colour and shape will vary between IALA regions A and B.

dominio.definicion: A beacon identifying the port hand edge of a channel, according to the locally administered direction of beaconage in the IALA lateral system.
dominio.observaciones: Its colour and shape will vary between IALA regions A and B.

dominio.definicion: A beacon used to indicate that the best navigable water is to be found in the quadrant bounded by the two bearings NW and SW taken from the position of the beacon.
A beacon used to indicate that the best navigable water is to be found in the quadrant bounded by the two bearings SE and SW taken from the position of the beacon.
A beacon used to indicate that the best navigable water is to be found in the quadrant bounded by the two bearings NE and SE taken from the position of the beacon.
A beacon used to indicate that the best navigable water is to be found in the quadrant bounded by the two bearings NW and NE taken from the position of the beacon.
A beacon on a buoy used for loading tankers with gas or oil.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a catenary anchor leg mooring (CALM) or a single buoy mooring (SBM).

dominio.definicion: A beacon indicating that entry is prohibited.
A beacon indicating that work (generally construction) is in progress.

An articulated beacon consisting of an unlighted panel of adequate viewing area to be seen at the required distance and having a distinctive shape, colour and/or number that serve to facilitate its recognition against a daylight viewing background.
dominio.observaciones: The beacon is fixed to a vertical pipe structure that oscillates around a universal coupling connected to a sinker and is kept upright by the buoyancy of a submerged floating chamber. It is primarily designed to mark narrow channels with greater precision than conventional buoys.

dominio.definicion: A beacon consisting of an unlighted triangle-shaped panel of adequate viewing area to be seen at the required distance and having a distinctive colour and/or number that serve to facilitate its recognition against a daylight viewing background.

A beacon consisting of an unlighted rectangle-shaped panel of adequate viewing area to be seen at the required distance and having a distinctive colour and/or number that serve to facilitate its recognition against a daylight viewing background.
A small, insubstantial navigational mark.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a staff placed on top of a rock or shoal to mark a hazard or serve as a navigational aid.

dominio.definicion: A tree without roots stuck or spoiled into the bottom of the sea to serve as a navigational aid.
A solid structure of the order of 10 metres in height used as a navigational aid.
A structure consisting of strips of metal or wood crossed or interlaced to form a structure to serve as an aid to navigation or as a support for an aid to navigation.
A beacon indicating a borehole that produces or is capable of producing oil or natural gas.
A beacon indicating the point at which a channel divides separately into two channels.
A beacon indicating the existence of a fish, mussel, oyster or pearl farm and/or culture.
A beacon indicating the existence or the extent of an artificial reef.
A beacon primarily used to indicate an area or feature referred to in nautical documents (for example: chart, Sailing Directions or Notices to Mariners) rather than to assist navigation.
A beacon providing information to the mariner.
A beacon indicating that special caution must be exercised in the vicinity of the beacon.
A beacon indicating an anchorage.
A beacon indicating the location at which a restriction or requirement exists.

A beacon consisting of an unlighted square-shaped panel of adequate viewing area to be seen at the required distance and having a distinctive colour and/or number that serve to facilitate its recognition against a daylight viewing background.

definicion: The type and/or number of features associated with a maritime navigation line (for example: a leading line, a transit line, or a clearing line).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting maritime navigation line features.

dominio.definicion: One feature other than a directional light is associated with a leading line or a clearing line.
A directional light is associated with a leading line or a clearing line.
Two or more lights are associated with a leading line or a clearing line.
Two or more beacons are associated with a leading line or a clearing line.

dominio.etiqueta: Two other than Two Lights or Beacons
dominio.definicion: Two or more features, other than two lights or two beacons, are associated with a leading line or a clearing line.
Multiple measured distance markers are associated with a leading line or a clearing line.
A directional radiobeacon is associated with a leading line or a clearing line.
A Moire effect light is associated with a leading line or a clearing line.
dominio.observaciones: A Moire effect light is a sodium directional light giving a yellow background to a screen on which a vertical black line will be seen by an observer on the centre-line.

dominio.definicion: A leading radio transponder beacon (RACON) is associated with a leading line or a clearing line.

definicion: An indication that a feature is significant to maritime safety of navigation and is marked (for example: by a light or beacon) by a maritime-specific navigational aid.
descripcion: Mariners may also use other prominent features (for example: rotating aeronautical beacons or lighted structures) for informal navigational purposes.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of maritime navigation restriction(s) in an area that are designated by an appropriate authority.
descripcion: May be in accordance with certain specified conditions. The official legal statue of each kind of restricted area defines the kind of restriction(s).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime navigation restriction.

dominio.definicion: An area within which anchoring is not permitted.
A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which anchoring is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.
An area within which fishing is not permitted.
A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which fishing is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.
An area within which trawling is not permitted.
A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which trawling is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.
An area within which navigation and/or anchoring is prohibited.
A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which navigation is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.
An area within which dredging is not permitted.
A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which dredging is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.
An area within which diving is not permitted.
A specified area designated by appropriate authority, within which diving is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.
An area where vessels must not generate excessive wake.
dominio.observaciones: Mariners must adjust the speed of their vessels to reduce the wave or wash which may cause erosion or disturb moored vessels.

dominio.definicion: An area designated by the IMO to be avoided, defined as a routeing measure.
An area within which the erection of permanent or temporary fixed structures or artificial islands is prohibited.
An area within which discharging or dumping is prohibited.
A specified area designated by an appropriate authority, within which discharging or dumping is restricted in accordance with specified conditions.
An area within which industrial and/or mineral exploration and/or development are prohibited.
A specified area designated by an appropriate authority, within which industrial and/or mineral exploration and/or development is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.
An area within which excavating a hole on the sea-bottom with a drill is prohibited.
A specified area designated by an appropriate authority, within which excavating a hole on the sea-bottom with a drill is restricted in accordance with certain specified conditions.
An area within which the removal of historical artifacts is prohibited.
An area within which cargo transshipment (lightering) is prohibited.
An area within which the dragging of anything along the bottom (for example: bottom trawling) is prohibited.
An area within which a vessel is prohibited from stopping.
An area within which landing is prohibited.
An area within which speed is restricted (a speed limit applies).
An area around a navigational aid within which navigation and/or anchoring is prohibited.

The area around an offshore installation within which vessels are prohibited from entering without permission; special regulations protect installations within a safety zone and vessels of all nationalities are required to respect the zone.
An area within where ships are prohibited to navigate and/or anchor.
dominio.observaciones: Usually no restriction is imposed for smaller vessels.

definicion: An indication that a structure (for example: a maritime navigation beacon or a maritime navigation light) has an associated maritime radiobeacon.
descripcion: A maritime radiobeacon is an electronic aid to maritime navigation consisting of a radio transmitter that broadcasts distinctive and/or characteristic signals.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of an electronic aid to maritime navigation consisting of a radio transmitter that broadcasts distinctive and/or characteristic signals.
descripcion: For example, a directional radio beacon or a radar marker (RAMARK).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime radiobeacon type.

dominio.definicion: A system used by ships and vessel traffic systems (VTS) principally for identification of vessels at sea and providing a means for ships to exchange ID, position, course, speed and other ship data with all other nearby ships and VTS stations.
dominio.observaciones: It may be shore-based, either marking the location of an aid to navigation (normally reporting every three minutes and serving in a manner similar to a RACON) or it may provide text messages, time synchronization, meteorological or hydrological information, navigation information, and/or the position of other vessels (normally reporting every ten seconds).

dominio.definicion: A radio station which need not necessarily be manned, the emissions of which, radiated around the horizon, enable its bearing to be determined by means of the radio direction finder of a ship.
A special type of radiobeacon station the emissions of which are intended to provide a definite track for guidance.

dominio.etiqueta: Long Range Air Navigation System (LORAN) C
dominio.definicion: A shore-based radio navigation system using low frequency radio transmitters that may be used by ships or aircraft to determine their position based on the time interval between radio signals received from three or more stations.
dominio.observaciones: It operates in the low frequency 90 to 110 kHz band. LORAN use is in deep decline, with GPS being the primary replacement. The Russian counterpart of LORAN is known as 'CHAYKA'.

dominio.definicion: A coastal radio station that is prepared to provide QTG service (to transmit upon request from a vessel a radio signal, the bearing of which can be taken by that vessel).
dominio.observaciones: The international system of Q-signals defined a series of three-character abbreviations wherein 'QTG' indicated a request for a '1 minute call signal for radio compass bearings'.

dominio.definicion: A wide-band beacon that transmits either continuously or periodically on the radar bands and is used to mark maritime navigational hazards.
dominio.observaciones: The transmission forms a line of Morse characters on a plan position indicator (PPI) radar display that radiates from the centre of the display to its edge. Periodic transmissions every few seconds are often used so that important radar targets behind the RAMARK beacon are not masked by the Morse characters. RAMARK beacons are less commonly used than RACON beacons which give the location as well as the bearing of the hazard and clutter the radar display less.

dominio.definicion: A type of radar transponder commonly used to mark maritime navigational hazards.
dominio.observaciones: When a RACON receives a radar pulse, it responds with a signal on the same frequency that leaves an image on the plan position indicator (PPI) radar display that radiates from the centre of the display to its edge. This takes the form of a short line of dots and dashes forming a Morse character radiating away from the location of the beacon, the length of the line usually corresponding to the equivalent of a few nautical miles on the display.

dominio.definicion: A radio station intended to determine only the direction of other stations by means of transmission from the latter.

A special type of radiobeacon station emitting a beam of waves to which a uniform turning movement is given, the bearing of the station being determined by means of an ordinary listening receiver and a stop watch.
dominio.observaciones: Also referred to as a rotating loop radiobeacon.

definicion: The type(s) of activities of significance to navigation and/or operation that take place at a maritime station.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime station type.

dominio.definicion: Watch keeping stations at which a watch is kept either continuously, or at certain times only.
The office or place where martime firefighting services may be obtained.
The headquarters of a local water-police force.
Communicates a signal or message conveying information about ice conditions.
A place at which life saving equipment is held.
A signal station for the control of vessels within a port.
The office or headquarters where the services of a pilot may be obtained.
Signals of an unspecified nature are made to ships at sea.
A mast from which pennants are flown (for example: from its cross yard and gaff) to signal messages to nearby vessels (for example: in a harbour).
dominio.observaciones: For example, used to signal regularly updated meteorological data.

dominio.definicion: Communicates a signal or message conveying information about storm conditions.
Communicates a signal or message conveying information on tidal conditions in the area.
Communicates a visual time signal in form of the position and/or movement of a ball.
Communicates an accurate signal marking a specified time or time interval.
dominio.observaciones: Used primarily for determining errors of timepieces.

dominio.definicion: An unmanned station that is equipped for observation and study of oceanographic phenomena.
Displays a visual signal to indicate a weather forecast.
A device (for example: located on a vessel or an aid to navigation) that transmits a warning signal during periods of low visibility, especially due to fog.
Communicates a signal or message conveying information on condition of tidal currents in the area.
A signal station displaying traffic signals.
A signal station for the control of vessels wishing to pass under a bridge.
A signal station for the control of vessels entering or leaving a lock.
A signal station displaying International Port Traffic signals.
Communicates a signal or message warning of activity in a military practice area.
Warning signals are made to ships at sea.
A radar station established for traffic surveillance.
A distinctive structure on shore from which personnel keep watch upon events at sea or along the coast.

definicion: The type(s) of item(s) removed as a consequence of an aggressive action on or against a vessel.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime stolen item.

dominio.definicion: Cargo of unspecified nature.
Cargo that could be utilized in a dangerous manner (for example: toxic chemicals).
Money in amounts exceeding that normally carried on a vessel.
Fuel, either from the vessel stores or from the cargo.
dominio.observaciones: Includes all materials required for power generation, for example diesel fuel, gasoline, and lubricating oil.

dominio.definicion: The food, medical supplies, spare parts and other provisions carried for the day-to-day running of a vessel.
Spare parts carried to maintain the vessel.
Weapons of unspecified nature.
Radio communication equipment.
Safety equipment.

definicion: The type of a maritime track based on direction, restrictions, and other characteristics.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime track type.

dominio.definicion: A straight route (known as a recommended track, range or leading line), which comprises at least two structures (usually beacons or daymarks) and/or natural features, which may carry lights and/or top-marks.
dominio.observaciones: The structures/features are positioned so that when observed to be in line, a vessel can follow a known bearing with safety.

dominio.definicion: A route (known as a recommended track or preferred route) that is not based on a series of structures and/or natural features in line.

definicion: The type of a component of a maritime Traffic Separation Scheme (TSS) based on its purpose.
descripcion: A TSS is a routeing scheme whose intent is to reduce the risk of collision in congested and/or converging areas by separating traffic moving in opposite, or nearly opposite, directions.

datatype.nombre: Maritime Traffic Separation Scheme Component Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a maritime traffic separation scheme component.

dominio.definicion: The outer limit of a traffic lane part or a roundabout.

A zone separating the lanes in which ships are proceeding in opposite or nearly opposite directions; or separating traffic lanes designated for particular classes of ships proceeding in the same direction.

A line separating traffic lanes in which ships are travelling in opposite or nearly opposite directions; or separating traffic lanes designated for particular classes of ships proceeding in the same direction.
A point used to delineate the center of a roundabout or specific traffic separation scheme instructions.
An area within defined limits in which one-way traffic flow is established in the inbound direction.
dominio.observaciones: The inbound direction is determined to be the direction of the flood tide, or where no tides are experienced the direction into a harbour or river. To avoid confusion use traffic separation scheme lane part.

dominio.definicion: An area within defined limits in which one-way traffic flow is established in the outbound direction.
dominio.observaciones: The outbound direction is determined to be the direction of the ebb tide, or where no tides are experienced the direction from a harbour or river. To avoid confusion use traffic separation scheme lane part.

dominio.definicion: An area within defined limits in which one-way traffic flow is established and the direction of flow of traffic is uniform.
An area within defined limits in which traffic moves in a counter-clockwise direction around a specified point or zone.
A defined area where traffic lanes cross.
A routeing measure comprising an area within defined limits where ships must navigate with particular caution and within which the direction of traffic flow may be recommended.
dominio.observaciones: Often associated with the termination of a Traffic Separation Scheme (TSS).

dominio.definicion: A routeing measure comprising a designated area between the landward boundary of a traffic separation scheme and the adjacent coast, to be used in accordance with the provisions of the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea.

definicion: The class of a radio marker beacon based on the shape and power of its signal.
descripcion: For example: a fan marker, a low-powered fan marker, or a Z marker.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a marker radio beacon class.

dominio.definicion: A type of marker radio beacon, the emissions of which radiate in a vertical fan-shaped pattern for general use.
A type of marker radio beacon, the emissions of which radiate in a vertical fan-shaped pattern at a lower power than the fan marker, for low altitude use.
dominio.observaciones: A low power radio marker beacon is normally used as an ILS radio marker beacon.

dominio.definicion: A type of marker radio beacon, the emissions of which radiate in a vertical cone-shaped pattern.

The 'bone' shape refers to the radio signal emanating from the station, which protrudes an emission in the shape of a 1 nautical mile diameter tube from the surface to 300 metres (1000 feet) above ground level, and an emission in a sphere shape, beginning

definicion: The type of a radio marker beacon based upon distances and frequency modulation, as measured on the Instrument Landing System (ILS) glide path and localizer course line.
descripcion: For example: outer, middle, or inner.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a marker radio beacon type.

dominio.definicion: A marker beacon used in conjunction with the backcourse of a localizer.
dominio.observaciones: Identification signals of marker beacons used in conjunction with the back course of a localizer shall be clearly distinguishable from the inner, middle and outer marker beacon identifications.

dominio.definicion: A marker beacon used with an ILS (CAT II) precision approach located between the middle marker and the end of the ILS runway.
dominio.observaciones: The signal is keyed at six dots per second on a 3000 Hz modulation frequency. The signal can be received both aurally and visually by compatible airborne equipment that it is at the designated decision height (DH), normally 100 feet above the touchdown zone elevation, on the ILS CAT II approach. It also marks progress during a CAT III approach.

dominio.definicion: A marker beacon that defines a point along the glideslope of an ILS normally located at or near the decision height of an ILS Category I approach.
dominio.observaciones: The signal is keyed to transmit alternate dots and dashes at the rate of 95 dot/dash combinations per minute on a 1300 Hz modulation frequency. The signal can be received aurally and visually by compatible airborne equipment. The middle marker should be located 1 050 metres (3 500 feet) plus or minus 150 metres (500 feet), from the landing threshold at the approach end of the runway and at not more than 75 metres (250 feet) from the extended centre line of the runway.

dominio.definicion: A marker beacon at or near the glideslope intercept altitude of an ILS approach.
dominio.observaciones: The signal is keyed to transmit two dashes per second on a 400 Hz modulation frequency. The signal can be received aurally and visually by compatible airborne equipment. The Outer Marker is normally located four to seven miles from the runway threshold on the extended centerline of the runway.

definicion: The type of a marsh based on its morphology and/or dominant vegetation.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a marsh type.

dominio.definicion: A marsh occurring in a uniformly shallow marsh depression or swale, having a gradual gradient from the edge to the deepest portion.
dominio.observaciones: Water levels fluctuate rapidly and the marsh edge may be poorly defined.

dominio.definicion: A marsh occupying the contact zone between high and low water marks bordering semipermanent or permanent lakes.
dominio.observaciones: The marsh, usually found along protected shorelines, behind barrier beaches in lagoons, on islands, or in embayments, is subject to flooding by a rise in lake levels, wind waves, or surface runoff.

dominio.definicion: A marsh occupying shorelines, bars, stream beds, or islands in continuously flowing watercourses.
dominio.observaciones: The marsh is subject to prolonged annual flooding and is commonly covered by thick layers of sediments.

definicion: The type of a mast based on its intended function.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a mast type.

dominio.definicion: A staff or pole on which a flag is raised.
A mast used to secure an airship.
A structure serving as a support for one or more lights.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a light standard or a lamp post.

dominio.definicion: A metal strip or rod, usually made of copper or aluminum, installed to protect the structure or surrounding area from damage due to lightning strikes.

definicion: The facilities available at a location or in the near vicinity for the handling of materials (for example: cargo).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting material handling facilities.

dominio.definicion: Equipment for handling bulk (unpackaged) cereal grains (for example: wheat) and derivatives.
dominio.observaciones: Includes pneumatic, mechanical and electrical equipment for handling, conveying, cleaning, weighing, and storing free-flowing and non-free-flowing cereal grains and derivatives.

dominio.definicion: Equipment for handling bulk (unpackaged) ore (for example: bauxite and iron).
dominio.observaciones: Includes mechanical and electrical equipment for handling, conveying, weighing, and storing free-flowing ores.

dominio.definicion: Ship-to-shore and onshore container handling equipment.
dominio.observaciones: The most widely used type of container is the general purpose (dry cargo) container having a nominal length and height of 20' x 8.5', 40' x 8.5', and 40' x 9.5' ('high cube').

dominio.definicion: Tractors and related equipment capable of handling semi-trailers, terminal containers and roll trailers.
Facilities for handling cargo that rolls on wheels (for example: vehicles and trailers) and is driven onto the transport (for example: vessel deck or hold, and rail wagon) and later driven off.
One or more cranes for ship-to-shore cargo transfer.
Equipment for handling bulk liquids (for example: chemicals, petrochemicals, petroleum products and vegetable oils).
dominio.observaciones: Includes hydraulic, mechanical and electrical equipment for pumping, metering, filtering, weighing, and storing free-flowing liquids.

dominio.definicion: Equipment for handling bulk (unpackaged) fuel (for example: steam coal, coke, liquid propane gas (LPG) and compressed natural gas (CNG)).
dominio.observaciones: Includes equipment for handling, conveying, weighing, and storing free-flowing fuels.

dominio.definicion: Equipment for loading and unloading rail wagons.
dominio.observaciones: Includes equipment for handling bulk, breakbulk, containerized and/or roll-on roll-on commodities.

dominio.definicion: A skilled civilian workforce is available to support material handling operations.
dominio.observaciones: Used to load and/or unload, for example, breakbulk cargo (not carried in containers and not shipped as liquid or dry bulk).

dominio.definicion: Vehicles with a pronged device for lifting and carrying heavy items.
Equipment to align the local dock level with the deck and/or loading areas of vessels.
dominio.observaciones: Includes facilities to adjust the local dock level and/or adjustable ramps supporting vehicle and/or rail access.

dominio.definicion: A platform powered by synchronous electric motors used to lift vessels (larger than boats) in and out of the water.
A wheeled vehicle designed to straddle, lift and carry containers or vessels within its own framework.
dominio.observaciones: It is used for moving, and sometimes stacking, shipping containers and vessels.

dominio.definicion: Access to roads suitable for the vehicular transport of materials, equipment, and other cargos.
No specific material handing facilities are available.
dominio.observaciones: All transport loading and/or unloading is accomplished using manual labor.

definicion: The maximum number of aircraft that can be handled at the facility.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity per unit time.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A scaled dimensionless rate denoting one part in one day, that time which is 24 hours in duration, being 86,400 seconds.

definicion: The highest altitude or flight level authorized by the designated authority for aircraft operations.
descripcion: When specified, the maximum altitude overrides the vertical upper limit, in those parts of the airspace where the vertical upper limit is situated below the maximum altitude.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 0.3048 metres.

definicion: The maximum depth of water that the object was designed to hold.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The highest elevation of terrain or vertical obstacles within a quadrant bounded by lines of geographic longitude (meridians) and geographic latitude (parallels).
descripcion: Maximum elevation figures are shown over land masses as well as over open water areas containing man-made obstacles such as oil rigs.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 0.3048 metres.

definicion: The maximum water velocity, inclusive of high water due to runoff.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a (directionless) rate of motion (change in position per unit time).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The derived unit of measurement of speed in the SI units system.

definicion: The maximum number of students.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The maximum number of teaching staff.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The maximum distance from the bottom to the top of a terrain (or waterbody floor) obstacle.
descripcion: May be a height or a depth.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

nombre: Maximum Permitted Storage of Explosive Substances
definicion: The total amount of explosive material, measured as the Net Explosive Quantity (NEQ), that may be stored at a facility.
descripcion: The NEQ is defined as the total mass of the contained explosive substances, without the packaging, casings etc. of a shipment of munitions, fireworks or similar products. It also includes the mass of the TNT-equivalent of all contained energetic substances.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value that is restricted to be non-negative.
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of the property of a body that causes it to have weight in a gravitational field.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "mass", defined as equal to the mass of the international prototype of the kilogram.

definicion: The maximum slope (rate of upward inclination of the surface from the horizontal) of the surface of a feature.
descripcion: For example: the terrain or a waterbody floor.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: A dimensionless quantity (a quantity with the dimension of 1).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A scaled dimensionless measure denoting one part in every hundred.

definicion: The maximum height of a vehicle that can pass through the obstructing feature on a travelled way.
descripcion: The height limitation assumes that the vehicle is less than 12 metres long and has a maximum rectangular width of 2.6 metres.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
