The alkaline earth, calcium oxide, a brittle white caustic solid which is obtained by heating limestone.
dominio.observaciones: It combines with water with the evolution of much heat, and is used as a refractory and a constituent of mortar, a source of slaked lime, and in many industrial processes.

dominio.definicion: Natural gas that has been liquefied for ease of transport by cooling the gas to -162 Celsius.
dominio.observaciones: It stored in a vacuum bottle-type container at very low temperatures and under moderate pressure. Natural gas has 600 times the volume of LNG.

dominio.definicion: A mixture of propane and butane, usually with propylene and butylenes present in small concentration and a powerful odorant, ethyl mercaptan, added so that leaks can be detected easily.
dominio.observaciones: It becomes liquid at room temperature at 6 bar pressure, so it is supplied in pressurised steel bottles. The liquefied gas has an expansion ratio of about 250:1. Used as a fuel in heating appliances and vehicles. LPG is manufactured during the refining of crude oil, or extracted from oil or gas streams as they emerge from the ground.

dominio.definicion: Timber sawn into rough planks or otherwise partly prepared.
A material for surfacing roads, consisting of broken stone or ironstone slag bound with tar alone, or of tar mixed with pitch or creosote.
dominio.observaciones: Historically, water-bound rather than using tar or pitch.

dominio.definicion: A hard grey brittle chemical element, atomic number 25, which is one of the transition metals. (Symbol Mn.)
dominio.observaciones: Used in steels and magnetic alloys.

dominio.definicion: Marble in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: Limestone that has been recrystallized by metamorphism and is capable of taking a polish, especially one that is pure white or has a mottled surface.

dominio.definicion: Building materials (for example: stone, brick, concrete, hollow-tile, concrete block, gypsum block, or other similar building units or materials and/or a combination of the same) bonded together with mortar to form a structure (for example: a wall, a pier, or a buttress).
Any items which are essential in carrying out the treatment of a patient's illness or injury.
dominio.observaciones: Includes topicals and dressings, antiseptics, bandages, cotton, first aid kits, contraceptives, syringes, ice bags, thermometers, sun lamps, vaporizers, heating pads, and medical appliances (such as braces, canes, crutches, walkers, eyeglasses, and hearing aids).

dominio.definicion: Any of the class of substances that are characteristically lustrous, ductile, fusible, malleable solids and are good conductors of heat and electricity.
dominio.observaciones: For example, gold, silver, copper, iron, lead, tin, and certain alloys (as brass and bronze).

dominio.definicion: The milk of ruminants (for example: cows, goats, and sheep) used as food for humans.
dominio.observaciones: Generally, an opaque white or bluish-white fluid secreted by the mammary glands of female mammals for nourishing their young.

dominio.definicion: A highly refined petroleum distillate.
dominio.observaciones: Used as a lubricant, a solvent, and medicinally as a laxative.

dominio.definicion: Any of various bivalve molluscs belonging chiefly to the marine superfamily Mytilacea or to the freshwater superfamily Unionacea.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the common edible marine bivalve, Mytilus edulis, which has a dark grey, slightly elongated shell and adheres by a byssus, frequently in large aggregations.

dominio.definicion: No product is produced.
Hydrocarbon-based fuel that is either liquid or gas at standard temperature and pressure.
Any of numerous liquids with a smooth sticky feel that are immiscible with water (but miscible with organic solvents), flammable, and chemically neutral.
dominio.observaciones: For example, crude oil (or a refined product of this), lubricating oil, or vegetable oil.

dominio.definicion: A native mineral containing a precious or useful substance, especially metal, in such quantity and form as to make its extraction profitable.
Any of various bivalve molluscs of the family Ostreidae, several of which are eaten (especially raw) as a delicacy and may be farmed for food or pearls.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the common European Ostrea edulis, and members of the widespread genus Crassostrea.

dominio.definicion: Any of various usually small and sometimes stemless fan palms.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the dwarf fan palm of the Mediterranean (Chamaerops humilis), the Sabal palmetto, and Serenoa repens of the south-eastern United States.

dominio.definicion: Any tree or shrub of the large, chiefly tropical, monocotyledonous family Palmae, typically having an unbranched stem with a crown of very large leaves either palmate or pinnate in shape.
dominio.observaciones: Also, any of various palmlike plants of other families, such as cycads.

dominio.definicion: Material in the form of thin flexible (frequently white) sheets made from the pulp of wood or other fibrous matter which is dried, pressed, and often bleached.
dominio.observaciones: Used for writing, printing, or drawing on, or for wrapping and/or covering.

dominio.definicion: Small, smooth, rounded stones, that have been worn by the action of water, ice, and/or sand.
A dark viscous liquid consisting chiefly of hydrocarbons that is present in some rocks.
dominio.observaciones: It is usually refined before use (for example: as a fuel for heating, lighting, and in internal combustion engines) and may be used as a feedstock in chemical production.

dominio.definicion: Any of a large class of substances which are polymers based on synthetic resins or modified natural polymers.
dominio.observaciones: May be moulded, extruded, or cast while soft or liquid, and then set into a rigid or slightly elastic form, usually by heating or cooling.

dominio.definicion: Porphyry in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: An unstratified or igneous rock having a homogeneous groundmass containing larger crystals of one or more minerals (frequently feldspar). For example, a hard rock quarried in ancient Egypt, having crystals of white or red plagioclase feldspar in a fine red groundmass of hornblende or apatite. Loosely, any attractive red or purple stone taking a high polish.

dominio.definicion: Water that is safe for drinking and cooking.
Reinforced concrete in which internal stresses have been introduced to reduce potential tensile stress in the concrete resulting from loads.
A light spongy form of volcanic glass, usually of pyroclastic origin and with a high silica content.
dominio.observaciones: Used, for example, as an abrasive (for example: in cleaning, polishing, removing stains and/or dead skin) or as an absorbent for moisture.

dominio.definicion: Quartz in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: A trigonal rock-forming mineral consisting of silica, massive or crystallizing in colourless or white hexagonal prisms. Found widely in igneous and metamorphic rocks. Often coloured by impurities (as amethyst, citrine, cairngorm).

dominio.definicion: Any material or combination of materials which spontaneously emits ionizing radiation (for example: nuclear particles and/or gamma rays).
Poured concrete containing steel bars or metal netting to increase its tensile strength.
The grain of the grass Oryza sativa, a major world cereal.
Stones of any size.
Any of various artificial polymeric substances that are tough and elastic.
dominio.observaciones: Originally an organic substance made from the coagulated latex of various plants, especially Hevea brasiliensis, which in its natural state is thermoplastic.

dominio.definicion: A white or (when impure) reddish-brown mineral crystallizing in the cubic system (sodium chloride, NaCl).
dominio.observaciones: Obtained by mining or by evaporation of seawater and used especially for seasoning and preserving food.

dominio.definicion: Granular material consisting of small eroded fragments of (mainly siliceous) rocks, finer than gravel and larger than a coarse silt grain.
dominio.observaciones: Generally ranging between 0.074 millimetres (No. 200 sieve) and 4.76 millimetres (No. 4 sieve) in size. Often a major constituent of a beach, desert, or the bed of a river or sea. Used for various purposes, as in smoothing stone, founding, or as an ingredient in mortar.

dominio.definicion: Sandstone in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: Any of various sedimentary rocks composed of sand grains, especially of quartz, cemented together. Typically red, yellow, brown, grey, or white in colour.

dominio.definicion: Schist in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: A coarse-grained pelitic metamorphic rock that has a structure marked by parallel layers of various minerals and can be split into thin irregular plates.

dominio.definicion: Scoria in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction.
dominio.observaciones: Rough masses resembling clinker, formed by the cooling of volcanic ejecta, and of a light aerated texture.

dominio.definicion: Any macroscopic marine alga that grow in long narrow ribbons.
dominio.observaciones: Algae may be moored or floating. For example, sea grass, kelp, or sargasso.

dominio.definicion: Waste, especially excremental, matter conveyed in sewers.
Calcareous remains of macroscopic marine animals, whole or in fragments.
A thin rectangular tile used as a roofing material and/or for cladding walls.
dominio.observaciones: Often made of wood or bituminous materials.

dominio.definicion: A fine strong soft lustrous protein fibre produced by silkworms.
dominio.observaciones: Used to make thread for textiles. Also produced by various invertebrates, especially by the caterpillars of certain moths and by many spiders.

dominio.definicion: A precious metal which is characterized by its lustrous white colour and great malleability and ductility, and is a chemical element of the transition series, atomic number 47. (Symbol Ag.)
A mass of snow flakes (minute hexagonal ice crystals).
dominio.observaciones: Usually as the result of snow falling on the ground.

dominio.definicion: The material comprising the thin top layer of much of the Earth's land surface, composed of fragmented rock particles with humus, water, and air.
Any of various primitive sessile aquatic (chiefly marine) animals of the phylum Porifera, which have porous baglike bodies with a skeleton of hard spicules or elastic fibres.
Any of numerous artificially produced alloys of iron containing up to 3 percent of other elements (including less than about 2.2 percent carbon) and having great strength and malleability.
dominio.observaciones: Able to be tempered to many different degrees of hardness. Used for making tools, weapons, and/or machinery.

dominio.definicion: Pieces of rock or mineral substance (other than metal) of definite form and size, usually artificially shaped, and used for some special purpose.
dominio.observaciones: Used, for example, for building, for paving, or in the form of a block, slab, or pillar set up as a memorial and/or a boundary-mark.

dominio.definicion: Any of the class of simple carbohydrates (for example: sucrose, glucose, lactose, and other saccharides) composed of one or more monosaccharide units, that are soluble in water, usually optically active, frequently sweet to the taste, and directly or indirectly fermentable.
dominio.observaciones: Obtained from various plants, especially the sugar cane and sugar beet, used in cookery, confectionery, and brewing.

dominio.definicion: A monoclinic hydrated silicate of magnesium, occurring as white, grey, or pale green masses or translucent laminae that are very soft and have a greasy feel.
Natural or synthetic fibres, filaments, threads, or yarns, and the cloth fabrics that are woven or bonded from such them.
Material used in thatching (for example: straw, reeds, and/or palm leaves).
A beam or piece of wood forming or capable of forming part of any structure.
A preparation of the dried leaves of the plants Nicotiana tabacum or Nicotiana rustica.
dominio.observaciones: It is smoked (for example: in pipes, cigarettes, and cigars), for its pleasantly relaxing effects, taken as snuff, or chewed.

dominio.definicion: Travertine in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: A white or light-coloured concretionary limestone, usually hard and semi-crystalline, precipitated from water holding calcium carbonate in solution (for example: in hot springs).

dominio.definicion: Tufa in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction.
dominio.observaciones: A soft porous calcium carbonate rock formed by deposition around mineral springs. Also any friable porous stone formed of consolidated, often stratified material.

dominio.definicion: A heavy radioactive metallic chemical element of the actinide series, atomic number 92, which occurs in pitchblende and other ores. (Symbol U.)
dominio.observaciones: Important as the fissile material in nuclear reactors and weapons.

dominio.definicion: A product whose primary ingredient is vegetation.
dominio.observaciones: For example, rattan furniture, sisal rope, vegetable oil, and many foodstuffs.

dominio.definicion: The transparent, colourless, tasteless, odourless, liquid compound of hydrogen and oxygen (formula H2O).
dominio.observaciones: Forms the main constituent of seas, lakes, rivers, and rain, and is put to many domestic and industrial uses.

dominio.definicion: Alcoholic liquor produced from fermented grape juice.
dominio.observaciones: Also, alcoholic liquor resembling wine made from the fermented juice of other fruits, or from grain, flowers, and the sap of various trees.

dominio.definicion: The hard, compact, fibrous substance of which the roots, trunks, and branches of trees and shrubs consist.
dominio.observaciones: Consists largely of secondary xylem, which forms the strengthening and water-transporting tissue of the plant.

dominio.definicion: Pieces of wood separated by a cutting instrument, usually in large volume.
dominio.observaciones: For example, chips for use in manufacturing pressed board.

dominio.definicion: A hard lustrous bluish-white metallic chemical element, atomic number 30, which is obtained from sphalerite and other ores. (Symbol Zn.)
dominio.observaciones: Used for roofing, galvanizing iron, and making alloys with copper.

dominio.definicion: Water from which all contaminants have been removed through a process of distillation.
Madrepore in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: A stony and/or silaceous coral.

dominio.definicion: White soft earthy limestone consisting almost wholly of calcite and derived chiefly from microscopic salt water fossil shells and fragments.
White to gray accumulation on lake bottoms caused by precipitation of calcium carbonate (CaCO3) mixed with microscopic fresh water fossil shells and fragments.
Mosslike colonies of sessile, polypoid aquatic animals that reproduce by budding.
Marine protozoa with amoeba-like bodies and radiating filamentous pseudopods.
A compound produced by chemical reactions in living organisms.
dominio.observaciones: May also be synthesized using non-biologic processes.

dominio.definicion: A compound or element (for example: hydrogen) produced from petroleum or natural gas (as a feedstock).
Breccia in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: A sedimentary rock consisting of angular, coarse-grained fragments cemented together by a fine-grained matrix (for example: by lime).

dominio.definicion: Dolerite in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: An igneous rock chemically the same as basalt and gabbro but medium-grained with a usually ophitic texture. Usually dark coloured and fine or medium textured. Occurs in minor intrusions such as sills and dykes.

dominio.definicion: Gneiss in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: A foliated, usually coarse-grained, metamorphic rock in which bands of granular minerals alternate with bands of flaky or prismatic ones. Formed by the metamorphism of granite and other igneous rocks, and typically consisting of feldspar, quartz, and mica. Usually of a streaked, wavy or banded appearance.

dominio.definicion: Limestone in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: A sedimentary rock composed chiefly of calcium carbonate. Yields lime when calcined and is used as a building material and in the making of cement.

dominio.definicion: Quartzite in the form of blocks, slabs, and other shapes for use in construction (for example: building or paving).
dominio.observaciones: A extremely compact, hard, granular rock consisting essentially of quartz. It is a metamorphosed sandstone in which the siliceous element is often so blended with the quartz grains so as to give the rock a nearly homogenous texture.

dominio.definicion: Smooth parallel-sided flat plates used for making tiles for roofing and flooring.
dominio.observaciones: A dense, fine-grained, metamorphic rock that develops a characteristic cleavage which may be at any angle with the original bedding plane. Typically dark grey, blue, or green in colour.

dominio.definicion: The stems or stalks of certain cereals, chiefly wheat, barley, oats, and rye, especially when dry and separated by threshing.
dominio.observaciones: Used as thatch, as litter and fodder for cattle, filling for bedding, and plaited or woven as material for hats and/or baskets.

dominio.definicion: A petroleum fraction used as fuel in diesel engines.
Steam and/or hot water generated and circulated to transfer heat.
dominio.observaciones: For example, used to heat residential buildings from a central heating plant.

dominio.definicion: Devices that operate according to the principles or methods of electronics (for example: incorporating transistors or electron tubes).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: computers, hand-held calculators, audio communication devices (for example: telephones and cell phones), entertainment devices (for example: televisions, radio receivers, compact disc and video disc players, and personal digital music players), and display devices (for example: cathode ray tubes, liquid crystal displays, and digital projectors).

dominio.definicion: Devices whose primary function is to transmit, control, or convert electricity into another form of energy (for example: kinetic, thermal, or radiant).
dominio.observaciones: Includes, for example: motors, transformers, switchgear, industrial equipment (for example: drill presses, lathes, milling machines, and assembly line machinery), domestic electrical appliances (for example: ovens, freezers, toasters, stoves, washing machines, and clothes dryers), and lighting equipment.

dominio.definicion: Water saturated or strongly impregnated with salt, especially sodium chloride.
dominio.observaciones: May be used as a feedstock in petrochemical refineries and in oil and gas well drilling and workover operations.

dominio.definicion: Substances, often artifically prepared, containing nitrogen, phosphorus, and/or potassium that are added to soil in order to fertilize it.
A hard white lustrous metal which is a chemical element of the transition series, atomic number 24. (Symbol Cr.)
dominio.observaciones: It is much used in alloys and corrosion-resistant coatings.

dominio.definicion: A hard silvery-white metal which is a chemical element of the transition series, atomic number 28. (Symbol Ni.)
dominio.observaciones: It is used especially in special steels, magnetic alloys, and catalysts.

dominio.definicion: A silvery lustrous malleable metal which is a chemical element (atomic number 50). (Symbol Sn.)
dominio.observaciones: It occurs chiefly in the mineral cassiterite, resists atmospheric corrosion, and is used in making alloys (for example: bronze or pewter) and tin plate.

dominio.definicion: Military weapons, especially including bombs, missiles, warheads, mines and/or ammunition.
dominio.observaciones: Specifically, weapons charged with: explosives; propellant; pyrotechnics; initiating composition; or nuclear, chemical, or biological material for use in military operation.

dominio.definicion: A pale, light, faintly scented oil extracted from olive pulp.
dominio.observaciones: Used especially in cookery.

dominio.definicion: Products resulting from the slaughtering and processing of whales.
dominio.observaciones: For example: whale meat (a delicacy), whale oil, ambergris, baleen, and ivory.

dominio.definicion: A mixture of crude oil (petroleum) and/or natural gas that is extracted from underground reservoirs and separated and/or cleaned as necessary before transport and use.
dominio.observaciones: After processing (for example: refining) it may be used as a primary energy source (for example: as fuel oil or natural gas) or as the raw material for chemical manufacturing (for example: the production of plastics, solvents, pesticides, or fertilizers).

dominio.definicion: Ceramic wares that contain clay that is formed into objects (for example: vessels generally designed for utilitarian purposes), and hardened by firing at high temperature.
dominio.observaciones: The clay may be mixed with other minerals, formed while wet and then fired. After applying a glaze the object may be fired a second time.

dominio.definicion: The blackish residue consisting of impure carbon obtained by removing water and other volatile constituents of organic materials, usually produced by heating wood in the absence of oxygen.
dominio.observaciones: Its primary use is as a fuel, which burns hotter and cleaner than wood.

dominio.definicion: A fine, powdery substabce, or meal, produced by grinding and sifting grain, especially wheat, or any of various edible roots or nuts.
A form of natural gas extracted from coal beds, consisting almost entirely of methane, with little heavier hydrocarbons such as propane or butane, and no natural gas condensate.
dominio.observaciones: It often contains up to a few percent carbon dioxide, but essentially no hydrogen sulfide. In underground coal mining it presents a serious safety risk (of explosion).

dominio.definicion: A low-density mixture of hydrocarbon liquids that are present as gaseous components in the raw natural gas produced from many natural gas fields and which condenses out of the raw gas if the temperature is reduced to below the hydrocarbon dew point temperature of the raw gas.
dominio.observaciones: Condensate ('wet gas') wells produce raw natural gas along with natural gas condensate (liquid).

dominio.definicion: An extremely low-density gas that is principally extracted from natural gas wells in Texas, Oklahoma, and Kansas in the U.S.
Very hot subsurface fluids, principally a mixture of water and steam, extracted by wells.
dominio.observaciones: Depending on the temperature, pH and mineral content, may be used in either dry steam, flash steam or binary-cycle power plants.

dominio.definicion: Coverings designed to be worn on a person's body, usually for functional purposes (for example: protection from the environment).
dominio.observaciones: Most commonly created from cloth fabrics, leather and/or fur. Clothing often has important social (for example: uniforms) and cultural (for example: differences between male and female) functions, with styles varying widely. Clothing may be either mass-manufactured in standard sizes ('ready-to-wear') or individually sized (tailored or 'made-to-measure'). Clothing worn on the feet (for example: boot, sandal, shoe) is generically termed 'footwear'. Clothing worn on the head (for example: hat, helmet, turban) is generically termed 'headgear'.

dominio.definicion: Food intended for animals.
Dung or compost (to be) spread over or mixed with soil to fertilize it.
A petroleum-based oil or grease that is blended or compounded for its lubricating properties.
dominio.observaciones: Lubricants are applied between the moving parts of machinery in order to reduce friction and consequent wear (for example: motor oils used in internal combustion engines). Lubricants may also be used to protect a part from dirt and moisture.

dominio.definicion: A fuel made from vegetable oils (for example: soybean or canola), animal fats, and/or recycled grease, and intended for use in diesel engines.
dominio.observaciones: For U.S. Energy Information Administration reporting, it is a fuel composed of mono-alkyl esters of long chain fatty acids derived from vegetable oils or animal fats, designated B100, and meeting the requirements of American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) D 6751. It can serve as a substitute for petroleum-derived diesel or distillate fuel.

definicion: The quantity of products produced per unit of time.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity per unit time.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A scaled dimensionless rate denoting one part in one tropical year, that time which the Sun takes to return to the same position in the cycle of seasons as seen from Earth, that was 365.270535606 days in duration at noon 1 January 2000 (J2000.0), being 31559374.2763456 seconds at that time.

definicion: The type of a natural element considered important enough to be protected against endangering influences.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a protected natural element.

dominio.definicion: Protection of flora-fauna-habitats against harmful influences.
Protection of the regional climate against altering influences.
Protection of the soil against altering influences (for example: erosion).
Protection of the water against altering influences.

definicion: The type of protective step taken to preserve the environment against threats.
descripcion: For example, protection against emissions or natural influences.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a protective function.

dominio.definicion: Protection of the cultural landscape close to the banks of a water body against flooding.
Protection of residental and settlement areas against noise disturbance.
Protection of the landscape against endangering dust emissions.
Protection of the landscape against the impact of destructive winds.
Protection of the cultural landscape against avalanches.
dominio.observaciones: Avalanches can be either snow or rock slides, or rock falls.

dominio.definicion: Protection of the landscape against erosion.

definicion: A code denoting the organisation or country that is responsible for establishing and setting the protective marking level.
descripcion: The text could be a trigraph country codes in accordance with ISO 3166, tetragraph or pentagraph international organizations (for example: 'NATO' for the North Atlantic Treaty Organization and 'SFOR' for Stabilisation Forces) or any name of agency or company.

datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying an owner authority.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of a facility or building that is used for accommodating the public but not as a permanent or long term dwelling.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a public accommodation facility type.

dominio.definicion: A restaurant where lodging may be available.
A public establishment where meals and/or refreshments may be obtained.
An establishment, especially of a comfortable or luxurious kind, where paying visitors are provided with accommodation, meals, and/or other services.
A public house of lodging and entertainment for strangers and travellers.
A roadside hotel catering primarily for motorists.
dominio.observaciones: Typically comprised of self-contained accommodation with adjacent parking space.

dominio.definicion: A place where guests or clients report upon arrival.
A place where food is served, especially at a workplace.
dominio.observaciones: For example:at a military base, industrial facility, or educational facility.

dominio.definicion: A location for gambling, often with other amenities.
dominio.observaciones: Typically includes gaming tables, slot machines, and other gambling devices.

definicion: The type of a facility or building that is used to provide service(s) to the general population.
descripcion: The service(s) may be associated with a government or private entity but are not normally associated with the act of governing.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a public service facility type.

dominio.definicion: An institution or establishment providing inpatient medical or surgical treatment for the ill or wounded.
The headquarters of a local police force and that is where those under arrest are first charged.
A building housing a warden employed to maintain and protect a forest and/or other natural region.
A building used in the diagnosis and care of outpatients.
A building or room where postal business (for example: where mail is handled and/or where stamps and other postal materials are sold) may be carried on.
A building that houses both fire-fighting equipment and personnel.
A structure at, or in which, motor vehicles are refuelled, serviced, and sometimes repaired.
The headquarters of a local water-police force.
Houses personnel and equipment used to help (someone or something) out of a dangerous, harmful, and/or unpleasant situation.
A facility used for medical research and/or the practice of medicine.
An establishment for the medical treatment and recuperation of invalids, especially convalescents or the chronically sick.
A building that houses both a fire and a police station.
A relatively small building that is separate from but is located near a main building and whose public service use has not been determined.
A location at which information is provided about a region for the assistance of tourists, and to promote tourism as an industry.
dominio.observaciones: In many countries such locations may be marked with an "i" symbol on associated signage.

dominio.definicion: A location established with free access for the population from crisis and war areas, where the maintenance of the necessities of life (for example: food, medical supply, shelter).
dominio.observaciones: For example: operated by the Red Cross.

dominio.definicion: The provision of animal health care and control activities for farm animals or pet animals.
An institution or home for orphans, especially a residential institution devoted to the care of orphans.
dominio.observaciones: Orphans are children whose parents are deceased or otherwise unable to care for them.

definicion: Specifies a specific paragraph in a publication (for example: a Notice to Mariners).

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that may contain lexical characters and is 255 characters in maximum length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The configuration of a pylon or pole.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a pylon configuration.

dominio.definicion: Having a configuration like the capital letter 'A' when viewed from the side.
Having a configuration like the capital letter 'H' when viewed from the side.
Having a configuration like the serif capital letter 'I' when viewed from the side.
dominio.observaciones: There may be several, often alternating, cable support stubs along the upper portion.

dominio.definicion: Having a configuration like the capital letter 'Y' when viewed from the side.
Having a configuration like the capital letter 'T' when viewed from the side.
dominio.observaciones: May have multiple horizontal bars, each supporting a separate set of cables.

definicion: The primary type of material composing a pylon.
descripcion: The basis for 'primary' may be, for example, compositional dominance or structural organization.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a pylon material.

dominio.definicion: A light silvery ductile and malleable metal, not readily tarnished by air, which is a chemical element, atomic number 13. (Symbol Al.)
A substance or preparation formed by the combination or mixture of various ingredients, especially a compound artificial substance serving the purpose of a natural one.
A heavy-duty building material made from a mixture of broken stone or gravel, sand, cement, and water, that forms a stonelike mass on hardening.

Building materials (for example: stone, brick, concrete, hollow-tile, concrete block, gypsum block, or other similar building units or materials and/or a combination of the same) bonded together with mortar to form a structure (for example: a wall, a pier, or a buttress).
Any of the class of substances that are characteristically lustrous, ductile, fusible, malleable solids and are good conductors of heat and electricity.
dominio.observaciones: For example, aluminum, copper, iron and certain alloys (as brass, bronze and steel).

dominio.definicion: Composed in part, but not completely, by metal.
The hard, compact, fibrous substance of which the roots, trunks, and branches of trees and shrubs consist.
dominio.observaciones: Consists largely of secondary xylem, which forms the strengthening and water-transporting tissue of the plant.

dominio.definicion: Any of numerous artificially produced alloys of iron containing up to 3 percent of other elements (including less than about 2.2 percent carbon) and having great strength and malleability.
dominio.observaciones: Able to be tempered to many different degrees of hardness and much used for making tools, weapons, and machinery.

dominio.definicion: Any material consisting of glass filaments woven into a textile or paper, or embedded in plastic, for use as a construction or insulation material.
A malleable, magnetic, readily oxidizable metal which is a chemical element of the transition series, atomic number 26. (Symbol Fe.)
dominio.observaciones: Occurs abundantly in certain ores and in meteorites, and is widely used, chiefly in alloys such as steel.

definicion: The type(s) of racing held at a site or facility.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a racing type.

dominio.definicion: Athletes employing track bicycles compete for speed and/or endurance over a fixed course.
dominio.observaciones: Usually held on specially-built banked tracks or velodromes (but many events are held at older velodromes where the track banking is relatively shallow). May also be held on grass tracks marked out on flat sports fields.

dominio.definicion: Camels mounted by riders compete for speed and/or endurance over a fixed course.
dominio.observaciones: Race distances generally vary between 4 to 10 kilometres and may include anywhere from 15 to 70 camels or more. Australian high-speed camel races are just 400 metres long.

dominio.definicion: Dogs chase a lure (traditionally an artificial hare or rabbit) on a track until they arrive at the finish line.
dominio.observaciones: The greyhound, a breed of hunting dog, has been primarily bred for coursing game and racing.

dominio.definicion: Unsaddled Standardbred horses race in a specified gait (either trotting or pacing) pulling a two-wheeled cart (called a sulky).
Saddled horses mounted by riders compete for speed and/or endurance over a fixed course.
dominio.observaciones: Thoroughbred races cover moderate distances at very fast paces. Quarter horse racing involves short distance sprinting while Arabian racing is based on endurance.

dominio.definicion: Athletes employing ice skates compete for speed and/or endurance over a fixed course.
dominio.observaciones: Ice skates are boots with blades attached to the bottom, used to propel the skater across a sheet of ice.

dominio.definicion: Athletes employing motor vehicles compete for speed and/or endurance over a fixed course.
dominio.observaciones: Includes specialized categories such as: single-seater, touring car, production car, one-make, stock car, drag, sports car, and various forms of motorcycles.

dominio.definicion: Athletes employing roller skates compete for speed and/or endurance over a fixed course.
dominio.observaciones: Roller skates are boots with either two front and two rear wheels (termed a 'quad skate'), or two to five wheels arranged in a single line (termed an 'inline skate') attached to the bottom, used to propel the skater across flat surfaces.

dominio.definicion: Athletes on foot compete for speed and/or endurance over a fixed course.

definicion: The type of a motor vehicle used in racing, based on its design and motive power.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a racing vehicle type.

dominio.definicion: A single-seat, open-cockpit, open-wheel racing car with substantial front and rear wings, and an engine positioned behind the driver.
dominio.observaciones: The regulations governing the cars are unique to the Formula One World Championship. The Formula One regulations specify that cars must be constructed by the racing teams themselves, though the design and manufacture can be outsourced.

dominio.definicion: A single-seat open-cockpit open-wheel racing car with the engine in the rear whose technical specifications are set by the Indy Racing League.
dominio.observaciones: When raced in the Indianapolis 500, special low-drag adjustable 'Speedway' wings are added.

dominio.definicion: A single-track, two-wheeled, motor vehicle.
dominio.observaciones: Motorcycle types vary from production line to custom built vehicles to maneuver over either smooth road surfaces or dirt tracks.

dominio.definicion: A standard production pickup truck modified to enhance its maximum speed.
dominio.observaciones: They are mechanically similar to coupe-shaped stock cars, with the main difference being the worse aerodynamics. Typical modifications include larger engines and specialized suspensions, chassis, brakes, and safety equipment.

dominio.definicion: A standard production passenger vehicle modified to enhance its maximum speed.
dominio.observaciones: They often exceed 320 kilometres per hour (200 miles per hour) by being more powerful than regulation assembly-line automobiles. Typical modifications include larger engines and specialized suspensions, chassis, brakes, and safety equipment.

definicion: The physical mounting and/or configuration of a radar antenna.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a radar antenna configuration.

dominio.definicion: Enclosed in a hemispherical structure, generally as a protection from the weather.
Mounted on a small, relatively lightweight post (for example: a small timber or a hollow cylinder of wood or metal) set up vertically, or nearly so.
Enclosed in an essentially spherical structure that is transparent to radio waves, generally as a protection from the weather.
dominio.observaciones: May be on the ground or on the roof of a structure.

dominio.definicion: Enclosed in an essentially spherical structure that is transparent to radio waves and mounted on a tall, substantial tower (for example: a lattice-work metal tower).
An aerial and reflector, usually joined as a single structure, that is rotatable.
dominio.observaciones: Usually rotates in a fixed scanning pattern.

dominio.definicion: Mounted on a tall, substantial tower (for example: a lattice-work metal tower).

definicion: An indication that radar monitoring is available via a specified communications service.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: An indication that an object has an associated radar reflector.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The primary purpose served by a radar station.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a radar station function.

dominio.definicion: Established principally to determine the presence and position of airborne objects (for example: aircraft, balloons, and missiles) in a region, monitoring their individual tracks, and often associated with equipment used to identify and potentially communicate with those objects.
Established for the surveillance and direction of maritime traffic by use of radar.
Established to detect and warn of distant approaching aircraft and/or missiles through the use of a long-range radar.
Established to locate precipitation, calculate its motion, estimate its type (for example: rain, snow, and hail), and forecast its future position and intensity through the use of a weather radar.
Established for tracking satellites in orbit, processing data, and in turn transmitting controlling instructions back to the satellites.
Established to detect and display an aircraft's position operating in an airport terminal area (ASR) and en route (ARSR) between terminal areas.

Established to determine the presence and position of potentially hostile airborne objects in a region, monitor their individual tracks, and direct an associated weapon system intended to destroy those objects (for example: aircraft and missiles) or their source (for example: a gun battery).
Established to support the launch, tracking, and control of rocket boosters for spacecraft and/or other payloads.
dominio.observaciones: The payload trajectory may be either orbital or sub-orbital, and the payload may be manned (for example: the US Space Shuttle) or unmanned (for example: a ballistic missile).

dominio.definicion: Established to determine the position of aircraft and vehicular traffic on aerodrome movement surfaces (for example: runways and taxiways), to enable traffic coordination so as to avoid accidents.
dominio.observaciones: The ground surveillance radar is used to augment visual observation by control tower personnel.

dominio.definicion: Established at an aerodrome to determine the position of an aircraft during final approach, in terms of lateral and vertical deviations relative to a nominal approach path, and in range relative to touchdown.
dominio.observaciones: Precision approach radars are designated to enable pilots of aircraft to be given guidance by radio communication during the final stages of the approach to land.

definicion: The distance between two successive peaks (or other points of identical phase) on a electromagnetic wave in the radar band of the electromagnetic spectrum.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: An indication that the communication channel has been checked in flight by the appropriate authority.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

nombre: Radio Communication Channel Selective Calling (SELCAL) Available
definicion: An indication that selective calling (SELCAL) is available on the particular frequency.
descripcion: Selective calling is a system which permits the selective calling of individual aircraft over radio telephone channels linking a ground station with the aircraft.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The directionality of the communication channel.
descripcion: For example: uplink, downlink, or bidirectional.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a radio communication direction.

dominio.definicion: The communication channel is capable of two way transmission.
The communication channel is capable of only transmission from the aircraft.
The communication channel is capable of only transmission from the aircraft to a specific ground station.
The communication channel is capable of only transmission from the ground.
The communication channel is capable of only transmission from the ground to a specific aircraft.

definicion: The allowable circular sector coverage of a navigational aid signal.

datatype.nombre: Radio Navigation Service Coverage Type Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a radio navigation service coverage type.

dominio.definicion: The signal's anticipated performance parameters have not been determined by flight check.
The actual coverage/range as determined by flight check.
dominio.observaciones: The signal's anticipated performance parameters as determined by flight check.

dominio.definicion: Signal usage is limited to the defined sector.

definicion: The type of factor which would detract expected performance of a navigational aid signal circular sector.

datatype.nombre: Radio Navigation Service Limitation Type Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a radio navigation service limitation type.

dominio.definicion: There is a probability that a signal in space available to an aircraft does not meet specified characteristics as defined in ICAO Annex 10.
The signal in space to an aircraft cannot be received due to navigation aid technical or physical limitations.
The signal in space available to the aircraft does not meet specified characteristics as defined in ICAO Annex 10.
The signal may cause the airborne equipment to occasionally observe brief course needle oscillations.
dominio.observaciones: Pilots flying over unfamiliar routes are cautioned to be on the alert for these vagaries, and in particular, to use the 'to/from' indicator to determine positive station passage.

dominio.definicion: The signal's pattern is distorted due to the strength and phase of reflection resulting in permanent and stable signal propagation delay.
dominio.observaciones: Especially prevalent when radio transmitters are situated in mountain ridges.

definicion: Tabulates types of radio stations.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a radio station classification.

dominio.etiqueta: Circular (non-directional) marine or aeromarine radio beacon

dominio.definicion: A type of long-range position fixing radio beacon.

dominio.etiqueta: Coast Radio Station providing QTG Service

definicion: The radiofrequency band the equipment or facility operates in.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a radiofrequency band.

dominio.definicion: The satellite frequency band between 1 GHz and 2 GHz.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The satellite frequency band between 2 GHz and 4 GHz.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The satellite frequency band between 4 GHz and 8 GHz.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The satellite frequency band between 8 GHz and 12 GHz.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The satellite frequency band between 12 GHz and 18 GHz.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The satellite frequency band between 18 GHz and 27 GHz.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The satellite frequency band between 27 GHz and 40 GHz.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The satellite frequency band between 40 GHz and 50 GHz.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The satellite frequency band between 50 GHz and 75 GHz.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The radiofrequency band between 30 kHz and 300 kHz, known as LF.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The radiofrequency band between 300 kHz and 3 MHz, known as MF.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The radiofrequency band between 3 MHz and 30 MHz, known as HF.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The radiofrequency band between 30 MHz and 300 MHz, known as VHF.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The radiofrequency band between 300 MHz and 3 GHz, known as UHF.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

dominio.definicion: The radiofrequency band between 3 kHz and 30 kHz, known as VLF.
dominio.observaciones: See IEEE Std 521-2002.

definicion: The class of a railway based on its importance in the general transportation network.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a railway class.

dominio.definicion: A rail-based high-speed inter-city transport system.
dominio.observaciones: Usually operated over long distances. For example, the French TGV (Train a Grande Vitesse).

dominio.definicion: A chief railway line operated over long distances and typically passing without interruption through multiple urban areas.
dominio.observaciones: Usually must not be occupied or traversed without proper authority. Primarily carries freight and is accordingly operated at a relatively slow speed.

dominio.definicion: A secondary railway line running from a main line to a terminus.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a railhead.

definicion: The average length of railways (in kilometres) per 100 square kilometres, within an area.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent per unit surface area.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of linear density equal to one thousandth of a metre per square metre.

definicion: The distance between a single pair of rails of a railway, measured along the shortest distance from inside rail to inside rail.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The classification of a railway based on the distance between a single pair of rails, measured along the shortest distance from inside rail to inside rail.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a railway gauge classification.

dominio.definicion: A railway gauge broader than the standard 4 feet 8.5 inches (approximately 1.435 metres).
A railway gauge narrower than the standard 4 feet 8.5 inches (approximately 1.435 metres).
The standard railway gauge of 4 feet 8.5 inches (approximately 1.435 metres).
dominio.observaciones: The railway gauge of Great Britain and the United States.

dominio.definicion: A railway in which the track is a single rail, on or suspended from which vehicles run.

definicion: An indication that a railway track is located within the bounds of a roadbed.
descripcion: For example, an infrequently used railway spur in a roadway or a carline running (regularly) in a roadway.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The method by which electrical power is distributed on a railway, if any.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a railway power method.

dominio.definicion: Electrical power is transferred using an electrified third rail.
Electrical power is transferred from an overhead power line.
Electrical power is not provided by the railway.
dominio.observaciones: On-board electrical generators or batteries may be used.

definicion: The maximum load allowable from a single axle of a railway vehicle (for example: a locomotive or a rail wagon) on a railway track.
descripcion: The maximum allowable load is calculated in terms of equivalent uniform load for trains travelling at 30 kilometres per hour where the units of measurement are understood to be tons per linear metre per track.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of the property of a body that causes it to have weight in a gravitational field.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of mass equal to 2,000 pounts (0.9071847 tonne or 907.1847 kilograms).

definicion: The use(s) to which a railway is put as part of a transportation system.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a railway use.

dominio.definicion: A track for streetcars, trolleys, and other mass transit rail systems.
A railway running underground, especially beneath the streets and buildings of a city.
dominio.observaciones: Usually includes those portions of an underground railway system that may not be underground.

dominio.definicion: A railway designed to efficiently transport logs from remote logging sites.
dominio.observaciones: Usually narrow gauge and more curved than railways intended for high-speed transport.

dominio.definicion: A railway reproduced at a smaller size than normal.
dominio.observaciones: Usually designed as an amusement ride.

dominio.definicion: A rail-based high-speed public transport system.
dominio.observaciones: Usually located within a metropolitan area.

dominio.definicion: A slipway in which the cradle travels on rails to facilitate the handling of vessels.
A railway laid down on a public road or street for tramcars.
A railway designed to operate on steep grades.
dominio.observaciones: Usually includes mechanical components (for example: a rack) to insure traction at all times.

dominio.definicion: Maintained as an historical exhibit at a railway museum.
An automated rail or guideway system that runs along dedicated ways.
dominio.observaciones: May operate according to a fixed schedule or on-demand (sometimes capable of bypassing individual stations). Generally consisting of vehicles having capacities of 12 to 100 people. Examples of this type of system include the Personal Rapid Transit (PRT) at West Virginia University and airport people-movers in U.S. cities such as Seattle, Dallas-Ft. Worth and Miami.

dominio.definicion: A railway operated over long distances and typically passing without interruption through urban areas.

definicion: The radius of effectiveness of an omnidirectional radiometric navigational aid.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 1,852.0 metres.

definicion: The range from a navigational aid at which it normally can be detected.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 1,852.0 metres.

definicion: The relative difficulty of traversing a rapid based on the International Scale of River Difficulty.
descripcion: The scale was developed by American Whitewater, a river conservation group.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a rapid class.

dominio.definicion: Fast moving water with riffles and small water waves. Few obstructions, all obvious and easily missed with little training.
dominio.observaciones: Risk to swimmers is slight; self-rescue is easy.

dominio.definicion: Straightforward rapids with wide, clear channels which are evident without scouting.
dominio.observaciones: Occasional maneuvering may be required, but stones and medium sized water waves are easily missed by trained paddlers. Swimmers are seldom injured and group assistance, while helpful, is seldom needed. Rapids that are at the upper end of this difficulty range are designated 'Class II+'.

dominio.definicion: Rapids with moderate, irregular water waves which may be difficult to avoid and which can swamp an open canoe; strong eddies and powerful current effects can be found, particularly on large-volume rivers.
dominio.observaciones: Complex maneuvers in fast water current and good boat control in tight passages or around ledges are often required; large wavess or strainers may be present but are easily avoided. Scouting is advisable for inexperienced parties. Injuries while swimming are rare; self-rescue is usually easy but group assistance may be required to avoid long swims. Rapids that are at the lower or upper end of this difficulty range are designated 'Class III-' or 'Class III+' respectively.

dominio.definicion: Intense, powerful but predictable rapids requiring precise boat handling in turbulent water; depending on the character of the river, it may include large, unavoidable water waves and holes or constricted passages demanding fast maneuvers under pressure.
dominio.observaciones: A fast, reliable eddy turn may be needed to initiate maneuvers, scout rapids, or rest. Rapids may require 'must' moves above dangerous hazards. Scouting may be necessary the first time down. Risk of injury to swimmers is moderate to high, and water conditions may make self-rescue difficult. Group assistance for rescue is often essential but requires practiced skills. A strong Eskimo roll is highly recommended. Rapids that are at the lower or upper end of this difficulty range are designated 'Class IV-' or 'Class IV+' respectively.

dominio.definicion: Extremely long, obstructed, or very violent rapids which expose a paddler to added risk; drops may contain large, unavoidable water waves and holes or steep, congested chutes with complex, demanding routes.
dominio.observaciones: What eddies exist may be small, turbulent, or difficult to reach. Rapids may continue for long distances between pools, demanding a high level of fitness. At the high end of the scale, several of these factors may be combined. Scouting is recommended but may be difficult.

dominio.definicion: These runs have almost never been attempted and often exemplify the extremes of difficulty, unpredictability and danger.
dominio.observaciones: The consequences of errors are very severe and rescue may be impossible. For teams of experts only, at favourable water levels, after close personal inspection and taking all precautions. After a Class VI Rapid has been run many times, its rating may be changed to an appropriate Class 5.x rating.

definicion: The flow capacity of a feature as stated in the design.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity (volume) of fluid which passes through a given surface per unit time.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of volume flow that is approximately 0.0002777 cubic metres per second.

definicion: The principal 'raw', or input, material(s) involved in a production activity.
descripcion: If multiple 'raw' materials are specified then they are usually listed in descending order of importance.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a raw material.

dominio.definicion: A light silvery ductile and malleable metal, not readily tarnished by air, which is a chemical element, atomic number 13. (Symbol Al.)
Black or brownish-black, solid or viscous, bituminous pitch, of natural occurrence or produced from petroleum.
The hollow stem of numerous, mainly tropical, giant grasses belonging to the genus Bambusa and various related genera.
dominio.observaciones: Used as a stick or as a material in manufacture.

dominio.definicion: A dark, fine-grained igneous rock, often displaying columnar structure and usually composed largely of plagioclase with pyroxene and olivine.
An earthy rock consisting of hydrated alumina with variable proportions of iron oxides and other impurities.
dominio.observaciones: The major commercial source of aluminium.

dominio.definicion: Large water- or weather-worn stones.
Containing calcium carbonate and/or other, usually insoluble, calcium salt.
A powdered substance, usually consisting of a strong mortar of calcined lime and clay, mixed with water and applied as a paste which hardens into a stony consistency.
dominio.observaciones: Used for binding together stones and/or bricks and for forming structures (for example: floors and/or walls).

dominio.definicion: A distinct substance obtained by or used in a chemical process.
A stiff tenacious fine-grained earth consisting mainly of hydrated aluminosilicates, which become more plastic when water is added and can be moulded and dried.
dominio.observaciones: Used to make bricks and/or pottery.

dominio.definicion: A hard opaque black or blackish mineral, mainly carbonized plant matter, found in seams or strata at or below the Earth's surface.
dominio.observaciones: Used as fuel and in manufacture (for example: to produce gas and/or tar).

dominio.definicion: Water-worn rounded stones, especially of the size used for paving.
Coal deprived by dry distillation of its volatile constituents.
A coarse-grained sedimentary rock composed of rounded fragments embedded in a matrix of a cementing material such as silica.
A malleable and ductile reddish metal which is a chemical element of the transition series, atomic number 29. (Symbol Cu.)
dominio.observaciones: Used especially for electrical conductors and as the base of alloys.

dominio.definicion: A usually hard calcareous substance secreted by many marine polyps as an external skeleton for support and habitation.
dominio.observaciones: Occurs in both single specimens and extensive accumulations. A similar substance may be produced by other lime-secreting marine organisms.

dominio.definicion: The soft white fibrous substance which surrounds the seeds of various plants of the tropical and subtropical genus Gossypium.
dominio.observaciones: Used for making thread and cloth.

dominio.definicion: Water from which the salt has been removed (especially seawater).
A usually colourless or lightly tinted precious stone of great brilliance, hardness, and value, occurring chiefly in alluvial deposits.
dominio.observaciones: The hardest naturally occurring substance, commonly used for cutting and abrading.

dominio.definicion: A soft, friable, porous material consisting of fossilized microscopic unicellular alga that have rigid siliceous cell walls.
dominio.observaciones: Used for filters and insulation.

dominio.definicion: A sedimentary rock composed chiefly of a hexagonal carbonate of calcium, magnesium, and usually iron that occurs as translucent crystals of various colours, alone or with calcite.
Power in the form of an electric current.
dominio.observaciones: Also, the product of electromotive force (voltage) and electric current.

dominio.definicion: Water solidified by exposure to cold.
dominio.observaciones: For example, snow or ice.

dominio.definicion: A gaseous hydrocarbon or hydrocarbon mixture that a suitable for burning in order to provide heat, light, or power.
A substance made by fusing soda and/or potash with other ingredients.
dominio.observaciones: Usually transparent, lustrous, hard, and brittle.

dominio.definicion: A precious metal which is characterized by its yellowish colour, resistance to tarnishing and corrosion, and great malleability and ductility, and is a chemical element of the transition series, atomic number 79 (symbol Au).
Collectively, the fruit or seeds of cereal grasses.
dominio.observaciones: For example, corn and wheat.

dominio.definicion: Any of a broad class of granular crystalline plutonic rocks, consisting essentially of quartz, orthoclase, feldspar, and mica or hornblende.
dominio.observaciones: Often used for building.

dominio.definicion: Plant material (for example: straw and/or tall coarse grass), possibly also containing the slices of soil to which the plant material is attached.
Small water-worn or pounded stones.
dominio.observaciones: Sometimes with an intermixture of sand and/or clay. Used for laying paths and roads.

dominio.definicion: Any igneous rock of dark-green appearance, especially containing chlorite, epidote, and/or hornblende.
dominio.observaciones: Includes nephrites and, in particular, jade.

dominio.definicion: Ground calcareous remains of macroscopic marine animals.
Frozen water, a brittle transparent crystalline solid.
A malleable, magnetic, readily oxidizable metal which is a chemical element of the transition series, atomic number 26. (Symbol Fe.)
dominio.observaciones: Occurs abundantly in certain ores and in meteorites, and is widely used, chiefly in alloys such as steel.

dominio.definicion: The fluid or semifluid magma or molten rock which flows from a volcano or other fissure in the Earth.
A soft, heavy, malleable, bluish-grey metal that is a chemical element, atomic number 82, occurring in galena and other minerals. (Symbol Pb.)
The alkaline earth, calcium oxide, a brittle white caustic solid which is obtained by heating limestone.
dominio.observaciones: It combines with water with the evolution of much heat, and is used as a refractory and a constituent of mortar, a source of slaked lime, and in many industrial processes.

dominio.definicion: Natural gas that has been liquefied for ease of transport by cooling the gas to -162 Celsius.
dominio.observaciones: LNG is stored in a vacuum bottle-type container at very low temperatures and under moderate pressure. Natural gas has 600 times the volume of LNG.

dominio.definicion: A mixture of propane and butane, usually with propylene and butylenes present in small concentration and a powerful odorant, ethyl mercaptan, added so that leaks can be detected easily.
dominio.observaciones: It becomes liquid at room temperature at 6 bar pressure, so it is supplied in pressurised steel bottles. The liquefied gas has an expansion ratio of about 250:1. Used as a fuel in heating appliances and vehicles. LPG is manufactured during the refining of crude oil, or extracted from oil or gas streams as they emerge from the ground.

dominio.definicion: Timber sawn into rough planks or otherwise partly prepared.
A hard grey brittle chemical element, atomic number 25, which is one of the transition metals. (Symbol Mn.)
dominio.observaciones: Used in steels and magnetic alloys.

dominio.definicion: Limestone that has been recrystallized by metamorphism and is capable of taking a polish, especially one that is pure white or has a mottled surface.
Any of the class of substances that are characteristically lustrous, ductile, fusible, malleable solids and are good conductors of heat and electricity.
dominio.observaciones: For example, gold, silver, copper, iron, lead, tin, and certain alloys (as brass and bronze).

dominio.definicion: A highly refined petroleum distillate.
dominio.observaciones: Used as a lubricant, a solvent, and medicinally as a laxative.

dominio.definicion: No raw material is consumed.
Hydrocarbon-based fuel that is either liquid or gas at standard temperature and pressure.
Any of numerous liquids with a smooth sticky feel that are immiscible with water (but miscible with organic solvents), flammable, and chemically neutral.
dominio.observaciones: For example, crude oil (or a refined product of this), lubricating oil, or vegetable oil.

dominio.definicion: A native mineral containing a precious or useful substance, especially metal, in such quantity and form as to make its extraction profitable.
Any of various usually small and sometimes stemless fan palms.
dominio.observaciones: For example, the dwarf fan palm of the Mediterranean (Chamaerops humilis), the Sabal palmetto, and Serenoa repens of the south-eastern United States.

dominio.definicion: Any tree or shrub of the large, chiefly tropical, monocotyledonous family Palmae, typically having an unbranched stem with a crown of very large leaves either palmate or pinnate in shape.
dominio.observaciones: Also, any of various palmlike plants of other families, such as cycads.

dominio.definicion: Material in the form of thin flexible (frequently white) sheets made from the pulp of wood or other fibrous matter which is dried, pressed, and often bleached.
dominio.observaciones: Used for writing, printing, or drawing on, or for wrapping and/or covering.

dominio.definicion: Small, smooth, rounded stones, that have been worn by the action of water, ice, and/or sand.
A dark viscous liquid consisting chiefly of hydrocarbons that is present in some rocks.
dominio.observaciones: It is usually refined before use (for example: as a fuel for heating, lighting, and in internal combustion engines) and may be used as a feedstock in chemical production.

dominio.definicion: Any of a large class of substances which are polymers based on synthetic resins or modified natural polymers.
dominio.observaciones: May be moulded, extruded, or cast while soft or liquid, and then set into a rigid or slightly elastic form, usually by heating or cooling.

dominio.definicion: An unstratified or igneous rock having a homogeneous groundmass containing larger crystals of one or more minerals (frequently feldspar).
dominio.observaciones: For example, a hard rock quarried in ancient Egypt, having crystals of white or red plagioclase feldspar in a fine red groundmass of hornblende or apatite. Loosely, any attractive red or purple stone taking a high polish.

dominio.definicion: A light spongy form of volcanic glass, usually of pyroclastic origin and with a high silica content.
dominio.observaciones: Used, for example, as an abrasive (for example: in cleaning, polishing, removing stains and/or dead skin) or as an absorbent for moisture.

dominio.definicion: A trigonal rock-forming mineral consisting of silica, massive or crystallizing in colourless or white hexagonal prisms.
dominio.observaciones: Found widely in igneous and metamorphic rocks. Often coloured by impurities (as amethyst, citrine, cairngorm).

dominio.definicion: Any material or combination of materials which spontaneously emits ionizing radiation (for example: nuclear particles and/or gamma rays).
Stones of any size.
Any of various artificial polymeric substances that are tough and elastic.
dominio.observaciones: Originally an organic substance made from the coagulated latex of various plants, especially Hevea brasiliensis, which in its natural state is thermoplastic.

dominio.definicion: A white or (when impure) reddish-brown mineral crystallizing in the cubic system (sodium chloride, NaCl).
dominio.observaciones: Obtained by mining or by evaporation of seawater and used especially for seasoning and preserving food.

dominio.definicion: Granular material consisting of small eroded fragments of (mainly siliceous) rocks, finer than gravel and larger than a coarse silt grain.
dominio.observaciones: Generally ranging between 0.074 millimetres (No. 200 sieve) and 4.76 millimetres (No. 4 sieve) in size. Often a major constituent of a beach, desert, or the bed of a river or sea. Used for various purposes, as in smoothing stone, founding, or as an ingredient in mortar.

dominio.definicion: Any of various sedimentary rocks composed of sand grains, especially of quartz, cemented together.
dominio.observaciones: Typically red, yellow, brown, grey, or white in colour.

dominio.definicion: Small fragments of wood, produced either intentionally (for example: chips for use in manufacturing pressed board) or as a waste (for example: dust made by sawing timber).
A coarse-grained pelitic metamorphic rock that has a structure marked by parallel layers of various minerals and can be split into thin irregular plates.
Rough masses resembling clinker, formed by the cooling of volcanic ejecta, and of a light aerated texture.
Discarded metal for reprocessing.
Any macroscopic marine alga that grow in long narrow ribbons.
dominio.observaciones: Algae may be moored or floating. For example, sea grass, kelp, or sargasso.

dominio.definicion: Waste, especially excremental, matter conveyed in sewers.
Calcareous remains of macroscopic marine animals, whole or in fragments.
A fine strong soft lustrous protein fibre produced by silkworms.
dominio.observaciones: Used to make thread for textiles. Also produced by various invertebrates, especially by the caterpillars of certain moths and by many spiders.

dominio.definicion: A precious metal which is characterized by its lustrous white colour and great malleability and ductility, and is a chemical element of the transition series, atomic number 47. (Symbol Ag.)
A mass of snow flakes (minute hexagonal ice crystals).
dominio.observaciones: Usually as the result of snow falling on the ground.

dominio.definicion: The material comprising the thin top layer of much of the Earth's land surface, composed of fragmented rock particles with humus, water, and air.
Accumulated remains of sponges consisting of the small pointed structures of calcite or silica that compose their skeletons.
Any of various primitive sessile aquatic (chiefly marine) animals of the phylum Porifera, which have porous baglike bodies with a skeleton of hard spicules or elastic fibres.
Any of numerous artificially produced alloys of iron containing up to 3 percent of other elements (including less than about 2.2 percent carbon) and having great strength and malleability.
dominio.observaciones: Able to be tempered to many different degrees of hardness. Used for making tools, weapons, and/or machinery.

dominio.definicion: Pieces of rock or mineral substance (other than metal) of definite form and size, usually artificially shaped, and used for some special purpose.
dominio.observaciones: Used, for example, for building, for paving, or in the form of a block, slab, or pillar set up as a memorial and/or a boundary-mark.

dominio.definicion: Any of the class of simple carbohydrates (for example: sucrose, glucose, lactose, and other saccharides) composed of one or more monosaccharide units, that are soluble in water, usually optically active, frequently sweet to the taste, and directly or indirectly fermentable.
dominio.observaciones: Obtained from various plants, especially the sugar cane and sugar beet, used in cookery, confectionery, and brewing.

dominio.definicion: A monoclinic hydrated silicate of magnesium, occurring as white, grey, or pale green masses or translucent laminae that are very soft and have a greasy feel.
Natural or synthetic fibres, filaments, threads, or yarns, and the cloth fabrics that are woven or bonded from such them.
Material used in thatching (for example: straw, reeds, and/or palm leaves).
A beam or piece of wood forming or capable of forming part of any structure.
A preparation of the dried leaves of the plants Nicotiana tabacum or Nicotiana rustica.
dominio.observaciones: It is smoked (for example: in pipes, cigarettes, and cigars), for its pleasantly relaxing effects, taken as snuff, or chewed.

dominio.definicion: A white or light-coloured concretionary limestone, usually hard and semi-crystalline, precipitated from water holding calcium carbonate in solution (for example: in hot springs).
dominio.observaciones: May be used for building.

dominio.definicion: A soft porous calcium carbonate rock formed by deposition around mineral springs.
dominio.observaciones: Also any friable porous stone formed of consolidated, often stratified material.

dominio.definicion: A heavy radioactive metallic chemical element of the actinide series, atomic number 92, which occurs in pitchblende and other ores. (Symbol U.)
dominio.observaciones: Important as the fissile material in nuclear reactors and weapons.

dominio.definicion: Vegetation used as the primary ingredient in a product.
dominio.observaciones: For example, reeds, wood, and grains.
