dominio.definicion: Having a structural frame shaped like the capital letter 'Y' when viewed from the side.
dominio.observaciones: Usually formed from truss-like elements bearing on the ground at four points for stability. When only one or two support points are used then guys may be employed.

dominio.definicion: A tall but relatively lightweight post (for example: a timber or a hollow cylinder of wood or metal).
dominio.observaciones: Often guyed in order to withstand wind loads.

dominio.definicion: In the shape of a tapering, four-sided pillar with a pyramidal apex.
A slender, more or less cylindrical post constructed from a variety of materials (for example: wood, metal, or fibre-glass) that is less substantial than a mast.
dominio.observaciones: May be guyed.

dominio.definicion: In the shape of a rectangular prism with the long faces oriented vertically and the base shaped as a rectangle (not as a square).
dominio.observaciones: Generally solid-faced.

dominio.definicion: In the shape of a rectangular prism with the long faces oriented vertically and the base shaped as a square.
dominio.observaciones: Generally solid-faced.

dominio.definicion: A three-legged tower.
A structure based on a series of trusses (diagonal frameworks) assembled in various configurations (for example: as an A-frame).
dominio.observaciones: For example, the Eiffel Tower.

dominio.definicion: A tall, heavyweight, hollow cylinder of metal that does not require guying and is capable of withstanding significant wind loads.
Consisting typically of a squat masonry brick or stone tower on top of which sits a roof or cap which can be turned to face the wind thus ensuring maximal effect on attached sails.
dominio.observaciones: A common form of windmill shape in the Netherlands.

definicion: The type of a tower based on its intended use(s).

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a tower type.

dominio.definicion: A tower and/or pylon from which the deck of a bridge is suspended.
A tower from which a watch is not habitually kept.
dominio.observaciones: May, for example, be used for scientific study.

dominio.definicion: A tower carrying a light as a navigational aid.
A tower supporting an elevated storage tank of water.
A tower on which a radio aerial is attached to increase its transmission range.
A tall tower for cooling hot water from an industrial process before reuse.
A tower on which a radar aerial is attached to increase its transmission range.
A tower from which a watch is habitually kept.
dominio.observaciones: There is often a small building on the top.

dominio.definicion: A tower on which a television aerial is attached to increase its transmission range.
A watchtower where a lookout is posted to watch for fires.
dominio.observaciones: Usually built on elevated terrain in forests and treed-tracts, especially in areas prone to naturally-occurring fires.

dominio.definicion: A pylon that supports one or more power lines.
dominio.observaciones: May occasionally also support communication lines, but usually only in the case of low voltage power distribution (typically less than one kilovolt).

dominio.definicion: A tower on which a LORAN aerial is attached to increase its transmission range.
dominio.observaciones: LORAN is a radio navigation system by which a position is calculated from the time delay between signals from two pairs of synchronized radio transmitters.

dominio.definicion: A tower that houses personnel and equipment used to control the flow of traffic on a transportation route (for example: an air, rail, or maritime route).
A tower on which a microwave aerial is attached to increase its effective range.
A tower used to support an aerial for transmitting and/or receiving electronic communication signals.
A tower used to support a set of aerials for transmitting and/or receiving Personal Communications Service (PCS) communication signals.
dominio.observaciones: In Canada and the United States, 'Personal Communications Service' (PCS) is the name for the 1900-MHz radio band used for digital mobile phone services. CDMA, GSM, and TDMA systems can all be used on PCS frequencies. 'World phones' (some of which are known as 'tri-band' phones, because they operate in three different frequency bands) support both European and North American frequencies. Outside the United States the term 'PCS' is used to refer to GSM-1900.

dominio.definicion: A tower used to support a set of aerials for transmitting and/or receiving telecommunication signals.
A tower from which a facility (for example: a prison) is guarded.
dominio.observaciones: There is often a small building on the top and the tower usually overlooks perimeter walls, fences, and/or gates.

dominio.definicion: A tower used in manufacturing (for example: a shot tower) and/or production (for example: fuel distillation).
dominio.observaciones: May also be used for research purposes (for example: simulation of microgravity by free-fall).

dominio.definicion: A tower used in training to simulate fall from a height (for example: aircraft exit, parachute handling, or landing).
A tower used with an array of heliostats to collect the energy of sunlight in the form of heat.
dominio.observaciones: The heat is used to drive a turbine to generate electricity. The heliostats (flat mirrors that track the position of the sun) serve to focus sunlight collected over a large area onto the much smaller tower.

dominio.definicion: A structure over a vertical mine shaft containing machinery (for example: a winding head or hoist) used to transport minerals, equipment, and/or workers between the surface and various levels within the mine.
dominio.observaciones: It is usually the most prominent structure at a shaft mining facility.

definicion: The total number of independent, parallel paths (for example: a railway track and/or a road lane) in both directions within a route.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of function, configuration, and/or management of a railway track.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a track type.

dominio.definicion: Designed to provide mobility for a travelling crane or a moveable gantry.
dominio.observaciones: Often aligned parallel to the face of a wharf in order that the crane may be used to load and unload cargo vessels.

dominio.definicion: Connects to a ladder track, over which locomotives and rail wagons move back and forth in switching.
Enters, or is located along side, a freight house.
dominio.observaciones: Rail wagons are moved to a house track for loading or unloading.

dominio.definicion: Owned, operated, or maintained by more than one operating railway company.
A series of turnouts providing access to any of several parallel tracks in a railway yard.

A pair of adjacent tracks where when two railway companies own single railway line and they have reached an agreement whereby one railway company services one railway track and the other company services the other railway track.
A small repair facility for rail wagons consisting of a single railway track in a small railway yard.
dominio.observaciones: The name is derived from 'Repair, Inspect and Paint'.

dominio.definicion: A stretch of railway track connected to a main railway and used for temporary storage, loading, and/or unloading.
A form of a side track connected to a running track at one end only, and protected at the other end by an obstruction (for example: a bumping post).
A track on which rail wagons are placed for the use of the public in loading or unloading freight.
A rotating platform with railway tracks used for turning locomotives and/or rail wagons.
A railway in which the track is a single rail, on or suspended from which vehicles run.
A railway using magnetic repulsion to support the train above the track.
dominio.observaciones: May also be used in an overhead monorail.

definicion: The annual difference between the values of all imported and all exported goods (surplus or deficit) within an area.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The monetary unit establishing a currency.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The unit of monetary exchange serving as legal tender in the United States, the dollar.

definicion: The type of traffic flow on a maritime route based on direction, origin, and/or destination.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a traffic flow.

dominio.definicion: Traffic flow is in a general direction toward a port or similar destination.
Traffic flow is in a general direction away from a port or similar point of origin.
Traffic flow is in one general direction only.
Traffic flow is in two generally opposite directions.

definicion: The type(s) of device(s) used to collect information regarding vehicular and/or pedestrian traffic.
descripcion: Such devices can collect, and through automatic analysis derive, traffic information such as volume, speed, inter-vehicular gap and vehicle classification.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain category denoting a traffic monitor type.

dominio.definicion: A mechanism for measuring traffic volumes moving past a survey point using one or more proximity sensors.
dominio.observaciones: The most common mechanisms are the pressure tube and the inductive loop, which are fixed across (or in) the road at the census point. A tube counter measures the impact of an axle and so traffic flow is derived from counting the number of impulses and dividing them by a factor representing the most common number of axles on a vehicle (for example: two), which can lead to inaccuracy. An inductive loop detects the presence of the vehicle by its metallic mass, whose passage over the loop induces a magnetic field in the loop and thus results in a single count for each vehicle. A combination of sensors may be employed to classify the type of vehicle by the number of axles.

dominio.definicion: A strategically placed camera is used to capture a series of images for either automatic or manual analysis.
dominio.observaciones: Cameras are significantly elevated in order to minimize obstruction of the longer view from vehicles located nearby. It is possible to survey up to 400 metres of road from a single vantage point.

dominio.definicion: A weigh-in-motion (WIM) device that is designed to capture and record truck axle weights and/or gross vehicle weights as the trucks drive over a sensor.
dominio.observaciones: Modern WIM systems do not require the trucks to stop (as in the past), making them much more efficient.

definicion: The reason for traffic restriction based on the nature of the route.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a traffic restriction type.

dominio.definicion: A device integrated with a railway track with which the rails may be switched to permit access to another railway track.
Reduction in the number of independent, parallel paths (for example: a railway track and/or a road lane) in either direction within a route.
A connection designed to provide traffic access from one road to another.
A curve along a land transportation route that may restrict vehicle traffic.
A stretch along a land transportation route where the slope is high enough to slow, hinder, or even stop traffic.
Prominences on a road, intentionally built to reduce speed of the traffic.
Depressions or hollows in a road surface caused by wear or subsidence.

definicion: The type of a traffic signal station based on the nature(s) of the controlled traffic.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a traffic signal station type.

dominio.definicion: Controls vessels within a port.
Controls vessels entering or leaving a port.
Displays International Port Traffic signals.
Controls vessels when berthing.
Controls vessels entering or leaving a dock.
Controls vessels entering or leaving a lock.
Controls vessels wishing to pass through a flood control barrage.
Controls vessels wishing to pass under a bridge.
Indicates when dredging is in progress.
Displays visual signal lights in a waterway to indicate to shipping the movements authorised at the time at which they are shown.

definicion: The number of firefighters that are specifically trained to combat the types of fires that may occur at an aerodrome.

datatype.definicion: A count domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a cardinal number or an ordinal number. For example, 4 (as in the number of legs of a cow).
datatype.nota: The realization of this count datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The altitude at or below which the vertical position of an aircraft is controlled by reference to altitudes.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of length equal to 0.3048 metres.

definicion: The lowest flight level available for use above the transition altitude.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: A quantity that is not related to any other quantity by a factor or formula.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A surface of constant atmospheric pressure that is related to a specific world-wide fixed pressure datum (1013.25 hectoPascal) and is separated from other such surfaces by specific pressure intervals.
unidadRecomendada.descripcion: It is conventionally given a numerical value to the nearest 1000 feet in units of 100 feet in accordance with the structure of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) Standard Atmosphere. For example, the 500-hPa level is written as "FL 180" where the corresponding ICAO standard height is 18,289 feet.

definicion: The estimated range of a non-optical electromagnetic transmission.
descripcion: The estimated range (distance) assumes 'in vacuo' transmission and a standard antenna height of 5 metres. It provides the mariner an estimate as to whether transmissions are likely to be received at his current range.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The type of a transportation block based on its method of action.
descripcion: May be used as a means of subtyping Feature: 'Transportation Block'.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a transportation block type.

dominio.definicion: Drops from overhead.
Rolls from alongside.

definicion: The type of a facility or building that is used for transportation purposes.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a transportation facility type.

dominio.definicion: A circular repair-shed for railway locomotives, with a turntable in the centre.
A building that is used for the servicing, repair, and/or storage of rail wagons and related equipment.
A place where vehicles (for example: buses or locomotives) are housed and maintained and from which they are dispatched for service.
A building used for keeping aircraft in a condition of good repair and/or efficiency.
dominio.observaciones: Usually located at an aerodrome and associated with a hangar.

dominio.definicion: A building for housing aircraft.
A site adjacent to a road usually having facilities for travellers and/or motor vehicles.
dominio.observaciones: Reference STANAG 2253.

dominio.definicion: A location at which equipment and supplies used to maintain and repair roads are stored.
A facility for owners and/or sailors of yachts.
A station that is equipped for observation and study.
A building beside a railway track from which signals are controlled.
dominio.observaciones: May have a signalman in attendance.

dominio.definicion: Houses the office of a local official who has charge of mooring and berthing of vessels, collecting harbour fees, and related functions.
Houses the authorized personnel established at a port to coordinate arrangements for logistic support and harbour services to vessels and to otherwise support the control of shipping.
Houses an authority, either governmental (maritime related) or associated with a harbour, providing specific services to vessels.
A distinctive structure on or off a coast exhibiting a major light designed to serve as an aid to navigation.
A building where trains regularly stop to take on and/or let off passengers.
Equipment that is used to determine the weight of motor vehicles.
A building located at an aerodrome that is used for disembarking and/or taking on passengers or cargo.
A building where buses and coaches regularly stop to take on and/or let off passengers, especially for long-distance travel.
dominio.observaciones: Usually located in an urban area, for example a town or city.

dominio.definicion: The office and/or headquarters of marine pilots.
dominio.observaciones: The place where the services of a marine pilot may be obtained.

dominio.definicion: A distinctive structure on shore from which personnel keep watch upon events at sea or along the coast.
A relatively small building that is separate from but is located near a main building and whose transportation use has not been determined.
A location at which taxi-cabs are authorized to wait.
A roadside shelter affording protection from the weather to passengers awaiting buses.
A location at which a bus regularly stops.
dominio.observaciones: Marked by a sign but not necessarily providing protection from the weather for passengers awaiting buses.

dominio.definicion: A building or facility located at or associated to a ferry station.
A building at, or in which, motor vehicles are refuelled, serviced, and sometimes repaired.
dominio.observaciones: Usually accompanied by several prominently placed petrol pumps.

dominio.definicion: A shelter for motor vehicles that is associated with a residence.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a garage for a car.

definicion: The effect of construction activities on vehicular traffic along a transportation route.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a transportation route construction effect.

dominio.definicion: No vehicle can proceed in either direction.
dominio.observaciones: For example, an immovable barrier may be put across the whole width of a road to ensure a road closure during construction activities.

dominio.definicion: The allowed height of vehicles is reduced.
dominio.observaciones: Temporary road signs may be used to indicate the reduced clearance.

dominio.definicion: The number of lanes available is reduced.
dominio.observaciones: Construction activities may affect one or more lanes. Lanes may be required for the storage or movement of materials, tools, equipment and/or workers.

dominio.definicion: Lanes are laterally repositioned to avoid construction activities.
dominio.observaciones: Normal lane positions are restored after construction.

dominio.definicion: Traffic is allowed in one direction only.
dominio.observaciones: Temporary road signs may be used to indicate the single allowed direction.

dominio.definicion: An assessment of quality of a road surface.
dominio.observaciones: Road surface also includes similar surfaces, for example, a parking lot.

dominio.definicion: The speed of vehicles must be reduced.
dominio.observaciones: The speed reduction may be based on legal requirement and/or physical conditions.

dominio.definicion: Normal traffic flow is reduced using traffic control measures.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a temporary traffic light, a flag man or a traffic calming device might be used for traffic control.

dominio.definicion: The allowed weight of a single vehicle is reduced.
dominio.observaciones: Construction activities may temporarily weaken the structure that supports the road.

dominio.definicion: The width of the transportation route is reduced.
dominio.observaciones: Construction activities may affect part of the road itself. Part of the road may be required for storage or movement of materials, tools, equipment and/or workers.

definicion: An indication that a standard vehicle for this transportation route (for example: a truck on a road) cannot leave the route.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The type of a transportation route protection structure based on its configuration and/or intended purpose.

datatype.nombre: Transportation Route Protection Shelter Type Code
datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a transportation route protection shelter type.

dominio.definicion: A protection structure, cut into the side of a hill, possessing a natural overhang or a constructed roof sloping upward onto the hill, with only one constructed side, built to protect a transportation route from snow and/or rock avalanches.
dominio.observaciones: Located where snow and/or rock avalanches can only happen on one side of a transportation route. The constructed side usually includes a series of openings for light and/or ventilation.

dominio.definicion: A protection structure with two constructed sides and a roof built to shield a section of a transportation route from rock slides.
dominio.observaciones: Located where rock avalanches can happen on both sides of a transportation route.

dominio.definicion: A protection structure with two constructed sides and a roof built to shield a section of a transportation route from snow slides, snow accumulations, and/or drifting snow.
dominio.observaciones: Located where snow avalanches can happen on both sides of a transportation route.

dominio.definicion: A protection structure with two constructed sides and a roof built to shield a section of a transportation route from landslides, avalanches, snow accumulations and/or drifting snow.
dominio.observaciones: Located where such phenomena can happen on both sides of a transportation route.

definicion: The type of a transportation system based on the type(s) of vehicles employed and/or the nature(s) of the objects transported.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a transportation system type.

dominio.definicion: Associated with the conveyance of passengers and their goods using aeroplanes.
Associated with a system of aqueducts for the conveyance of water.
dominio.observaciones: For example, as used for irrigation, industrial, or drinking purposes.

dominio.definicion: Associated with the conveyance of passengers and their goods using generally small and individually owned road vehicles.
Associated with the conveyance of passengers and their goods using large road vehicles running on fixed routes.
Associated with the conveyance of passengers and/or goods using canals.
dominio.observaciones: Usually as part of a network of inland waterways including lakes and/or rivers.

dominio.definicion: Associated with the conveyance of passengers and/or goods by caravan (for example: a company of merchants or pilgrims).
dominio.observaciones: Especially across the deserts of Asia and North Africa.

dominio.definicion: Associated with the conveyance of passengers and their goods using ships.
Not associated with a transportation system.
Associated with or adapted for walking or walkers.
dominio.observaciones: For example, footpaths and hiking trails.

dominio.definicion: Associated with the movement of gases, liquids, and/or slurries through a system of pipelines.
dominio.observaciones: The pipelines are often underground and extend over long distances.

dominio.definicion: Associated with the conveyance of boats and goods between two navigable waters.
Associated with a railway-based network for the conveyance of passengers and/or goods.
Associated with a road-based network for the conveyance of passengers and/or goods.
Associated with the conveyance of goods using large road vehicles.
Associated with the conveyance of passengers and their goods using underground railways.
dominio.observaciones: The railway passes especially beneath the streets and buildings of a city.

dominio.definicion: Associated with the conveyance of passengers and/or goods using a network of inland waterways.
Associated with trails for conveying passengers and/or goods by pack animal.
A defined path at an aerodrome established for the taxiing of aircraft and intended to provide a ground movement link between one part of the aerodrome and another.
dominio.observaciones: For example, providing access to/from runways and hard standings, aerodrome terminals, and service and/or other support operations for aircraft.

dominio.definicion: Associated with vehicle routes (for example: cart tracks) for conveying crews and equipment along the right-of-way of a pipeline to support its construction and/or maintenance.
Associated with vehicle routes (for example: cart tracks) for conveying crews and equipment along the right-of-way of a power line to support its construction and/or maintenance.
Associated with an unenclosed road or trail, due to the regular movement of animal herds.
dominio.observaciones: Chiefly for cattle and/or sheep.

dominio.definicion: A defined rectangular area on a land aerodrome prepared for the landing and take-off of aircraft.
dominio.observaciones: Contiguous with but excludes stopways.

dominio.definicion: Associated with the conveyance of passengers and/or goods using a bicycle.
Associated with vehicles that run on continuous tracks instead of wheels.
Associated with the conveyance of people, goods or equipment using carrier units suspended above the ground.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a ski-lift.

definicion: The primary use(s) of a transportation system.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a transportation use.

dominio.definicion: Used to transport livestock.
dominio.observaciones: For example, a drove.

dominio.definicion: Used to transport cargo (for example: automobiles or equipment), including bulk industrial materials (for example: cement, coal, or chemicals).
Used to transport passengers.
dominio.observaciones: May occasionally be used to transport cargo at off-peak hours.

dominio.definicion: Used to transport mineral ores.
There is no transportation use.
Used for a variety of transport purposes, including of passengers and/or goods, no particular purpose predominating.

datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The applicable direction of the aircraft turn.
descripcion: For example: left or right.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a turn direction.

dominio.definicion: Only right turns permitted.
Only left turns permitted.

dominio.etiqueta: Either Left Turn or Right Turn
dominio.definicion: Both left and right turns may be utilized.

definicion: The type of an airfield control station.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a type of control station.

definicion: An indication that information is known about the height to which a marine feature may be uncovered by the tide.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: Clearance below bridge, measured from the lowest surface level to the base of the lower of either a cross beam or the lowest bridge deck.

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The upper-value of a real-interval, the second member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity of a linear extent.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: The base unit in SI for the physical quantity "length", defined as the length of the path travelled by light in vacuum during a time interval of 1/299,792,458 of a second.

definicion: The ground slope of the floor of the entrance at the point of access for an underground feature (for example: a cave, tunnel or underground extraction mine) as a category.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting an underground access orientation.

dominio.definicion: Zero slope (0 arc degrees).
A negative slope other than vertical.
A vertical shaft directly down (-90 arc degrees).
A positive slope other than vertical.
A vertical shaft directly up (90 arc degrees).

definicion: The means by which an underground mine is accessed from the surface.
descripcion: For example, by a tunnel or a shaft.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a underground mine access.

dominio.definicion: The targeted mineral seam is located at or above local drainage and outcrops at the surface allowing main entry or access to the mine to be driven directly into the mineral seam.
dominio.observaciones: The entry is generally located on the slope of a hill and the removal of minerals (for example: coal) is often facilitated by the construction of a small-gauge railway, roadway or conveyer into the mine.

dominio.definicion: The targeted mineral seam is located below local drainage and does not outcrop at the surface, but is close enough to the surface to allow access to the mineral seam by means of a sloping tunnel.
dominio.observaciones: As with a drift mine, transportation of minerals, equipment and/or workers is often facilitated by the construction of a small-gauge railway, roadway or conveyer into the mine.

dominio.definicion: The targeted mineral seam is located below local drainage and does not outcrop at the surface, and is far enough below the surface as to require access to be by means of a vertical shaft.
dominio.observaciones: On the surface above the mine shaft stands a superstructure (termed a 'pit-head' or 'pit-head frame'), which historically contained a winding engine and in modern times contains an electric hoist controller. This raises and lowers a cage within the shaft that serves as a lift for the transportation of minerals, equipment and/or workers.

definicion: The type of an underground storage formation based on its geologic structure.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain category denoting an underground storage formation type.

dominio.definicion: A former underground mine that has been modified for the purpose of storage.
dominio.observaciones: Typically used to store packaged materials due to its original design and structure.

dominio.definicion: A natural aquifer that is overlaid with an impermeable cap rock.
dominio.observaciones: The water-bearing sedimentary rock formation is pressurized with gas, thus displacing the water and resulting in gas storage.

dominio.definicion: A depleted natural gas or oil field.
dominio.observaciones: Conversion of a depleted field from production to natural gas storage takes advantage of existing wells, gathering systems, and pipeline connections. Depleted oil and gas reservoirs are the most commonly used underground natural gas storage sites because of their wide availability. In the future they may also be used to store carbon dioxide for long-term sequestration.

dominio.definicion: A purpose-built cavern hollowed out of a generally non-porous rock (for example: granite).
dominio.observaciones: Generally used only when location is important, the required volume is not high, and a suitable rock formation is available. May require lining to reduce seepage and/or loss.

dominio.definicion: An artificially created cavern formed within a naturally-occurring salt formation.
dominio.observaciones: The salt formation may occur either as a layer (termed a 'salt bed') or as a diaper intruding into an overlying sedimentary stratum (termed a 'salt dome'). Depending on the nature of the salt formation the cavern may be created through a process of 'solution mining' in which injected fresh water is removed as brine and disposed of elsewhere, or using direct bulk-mining techniques.

definicion: The fraction of land within a defined area that is covered by undergrowth (for example: scrub, brush, and/or bush).

datatype.definicion: A real-interval domain value that is restricted to be completely contained in the range from 0 to 100, inclusive.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

campos.definicion: The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.

The lower-value of a real-interval, the first member of a pair of real numbers that represent all of the numbers between the two and possibly including one and/or the other depending on the interval closure.
The closure conditions of the two endpoints of the real number interval.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A scaled dimensionless measure denoting one part in every hundred.

definicion: The fraction of the total able workforce inhabitants residing within an area that are unemployed.

datatype.definicion: A real domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number. For example, 98.6 (as in the normal human body temperature in degrees Fahrenheit).
datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: A dimensionless quantity (a quantity with the dimension of 1).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A scaled dimensionless measure denoting one part in every hundred.

definicion: An indication that a feature is a UNESCO (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) World Heritage Site.
descripcion: A UNESCO World Heritage Site is a site (for example: a forest, mountain, lake, desert, monument, building, complex, or city) that is on the list maintained by the International World Heritage Programme administered by the UNESCO World Heritage Committee.

datatype.definicion: A Boolean domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is { TRUE, FALSE }, representing the true and false values in a two-valued logic system.
datatype.nota: The realization of this boolean datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The globally unique and persistent identifier of an entity (for example: feature or event) instance as specified by a Uniform Resource Name (URN) in accordance with the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) RFC2396 and RFC2141.
descripcion: It is based on the Uniform Resource Identifier (URI), a compact string of characters for identifying an abstract or physical resource. The term 'Uniform Resource Name' (URN) refers to the subset of URI that are required to remain globally unique and persistent even when the resource ceases to exist or becomes unavailable. The URN is drawn from one of a set of defined namespaces, each of which has its own set name structure and assignment procedures.

datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying a unique feature identifier.
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: Structured in accordance with IETF RFC2141 (URN Syntax); the namespace is managed by the NGA National Center for Geospatial Intelligence Standards (NCGIS).

definicion: The type of a United Nations (U.N.) controlled activty within an area.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a United Nations activity.

dominio.definicion: A facility established with free access for the population from crisis and war areas, where the maintenance of the necessities of life (for example: food, medical supply, fuel, clothes, shelters, and tools) are ensured.
A traffic route or strip kept clear and protected from armed or combat activities ensuring the secure access for relief and supporting activities as well as to regions free of conflicts.
A protected area where population and refugees of combat zones find shelter and security from the battles.

definicion: The type of a United Nations (U.N.) mission within an area.

datatype.definicion: A coded domain value denoting a United Nations mission.

dominio.definicion: United Nations (U.N.) resolution for presence of international troops before or during military conflicts.
United Nations (U.N.) resolution for presence of international troops in order to keep the peace after conflicts.
Material and logistical provision and distribution of aids in order to prevent and maintain people against distress.
Military but unarmed United Nations (U.N.) personal tasked to observe military activities.

definicion: The Universal Unique Identifier (UUID) that is assigned to a feature in order to uniquely identify it for the purpose of maintaining relationships between features (relational database) and version control.
descripcion: UUIDs are defined in ITU-T Rec. X.667 | ISO/IEC 9834-8.

datatype.definicion: A structured text value specifying a Universal Unique Identifier (UUID).
datatype.nota: The realization of this structuredText datatype is implementation-dependent.
datatype.estructura: The character-array representation of a Universal Unique Identifier (UUID), composed of five fields of hexadecimal characters. Each field has a fixed length, and fields are separated by the hyphen character, for a total of 36 characters.

definicion: The reason why the feature has been updated in a review process.

datatype.definicion: A text domain value that may contain lexical characters and is unconstrained in length.
datatype.nota: The realization of this text datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The upper limit of a range of postal address numbers associated with a feature.
descripcion: For example, a thoroughfare (or portion of a thoroughfare) or a building (for example: an apartment or office building) may have a range of assigned postal address numbers (for example: 3778 through 3884). If the postal address has only one number, the values of Attribute: 'Lower Address Number' and Attribute: 'Upper Address Number' are the same. Consideration should be given to the alternative use of Attribute: 'Address Number'.

datatype.definicion: An integer domain value.
datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is an integer. For example, 6 (as in the length of a fathom in feet).
datatype.nota: The realization of this integer datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: A dimensionless quantity (a quantity with the dimension of 1).

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A dimensionless physical quantity, one which has no unit of measure.

definicion: The height above water level on the upstream side.

datatype.descripcion: The domain of values is a real number interval.
datatype.nota: The realization of this complex datatype is implementation-dependent.

An area with buildings and facilities for service purposes.
An area with buildings and facilities for shopping purposes.
An area with buildings and facilities for disposal purposes.
An area with buildings and facilities for special functional purposes.
An area with buildings and facilities for mixed use purposes.

An area with buildings and facilities for administration purposes.
An area with buildings and facilities for weekend and holiday activities.
An area with buildings and facilities for residential purposes.
An area with buildings and facilities for parking purposes.
An area with buildings and facilities for traffic purposes.

descripcion: May be affected by external influences and is often lower than the rated flow capacity.

datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

cantidadFisica.definicion: The quantity (volume) of fluid which passes through a given surface per unit time.

unidadRecomendada.definicion: A conventional unit of measurement of volume flow that is approximately 0.0002777 cubic metres per second.

datatype.nota: The realization of this real datatype is implementation-dependent.

definicion: The interior length of a structure (for example: an aircraft bunker or a lock).
descripcion: The length is taken along the primary alignment of the structure. If the structure is irregular in shape the length is along its greatest horizontal dimension, else if the structure is regular in shape then a shape-specific rule may apply: for a rectangular structure, the length of the longer axis; for a round structure, the diameter.

definicion: The number of hours to be added or subtracted from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) to obtain local standard time.
